title: Risiko Emerging
section_path: ESG > Governance > Risiko yang Sedang Berkembang: Risiko Emerging > Risiko 1: Tata Kelola Pemanfaatan Platform AI Generatif > Potensi Dampak
text:
Risiko Emerging > Risiko 1: Tata Kelola Pemanfaatan Platform AI Generatif > Potensi Dampak

BKI berkomitmen untuk melaporkan, mengidentifikasi, mengevaluasi, dan mengelola risiko-risiko yang baru muncul (emerging risks) sebagai bagian dari pendekatan manajemen risiko jangka panjang yang komprehensif. Risiko-risiko ini diidentifikasi melalui proses penilaian risiko secara luas dan lintas fungsi. Pengungkapan risiko baru ini dalam dokumen publik mencakup potensi risiko yang belum pernah terjadi, namun berpotensi memberikan dampak jangka panjang yang signifikan terhadap operasional dan strategi perusahaan.

Perseroan saat ini belum menggunakan platform AI sebagai pengambil keputusan dalam proses survei, inspeksi, maupun penerbitan sertifikat. Saat ini pemanfaatan platform AI generatif masih terbatas sebagai alat bantu pada fungsi pendukung, seperti penyusunan dokumen, penerjemahan, peringkasan informasi, dan analisis data pada unit-unit supporting dan perencanaan korporat.

Namun, penggunaan platform publik tersebut memiliki karakter risiko yang berbeda dengan sistem informasi internal karena berada di luar kendali langsung Perseroan, tidak selalu melalui mekanisme pengadaan dan pengawasan resmi, serta dapat memproses data pada yurisdiksi lain dengan ketentuan layanan yang dapat berubah. Informasi yang dimasukkan pengguna, termasuk potensi dokumen klien, laporan inspeksi, hasil pengujian, maupun data teknis, berisiko kehilangan tingkat pengendalian yang diperlukan untuk menjamin kerahasiaan dan perlindungan informasi.

Risiko ini menjadi material karena keberlangsungan layanan Perseroan bergantung pada kepercayaan, independensi, dan kemampuan menjaga kerahasiaan informasi klien sebagai lembaga inspeksi dan sertifikasi. Tanpa tata kelola yang memadai, pemanfaatan kecerdasan artifisial berpotensi berkembang menjadi risiko kepatuhan, akreditasi, keamanan informasi, serta menurunkan kualitas pertimbangan profesional dalam pengambilan keputusan.

- Risiko pelanggaran perlindungan data pribadi dan kewajiban kerahasiaan informasi akibat penggunaan platform eksternal yang tidak sepenuhnya berada dalam kendali Perseroan.

- Potensi temuan ketidaksesuaian dalam asesmen akreditasi yang dapat berdampak pada pengakuan atau ruang lingkup layanan sertifikasi.

- Keputusan bisnis dan operasional yang kurang akurat akibat keluaran kecerdasan artifisial yang tidak tervalidasi secara memadai.
context: This excerpt comes from PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)’s ESG / Governance section on Emerging Risks, specifically “Risiko 1: Tata Kelola Pemanfaatan Platform AI Generatif / Governance of Generative AI Platform Use,” under a long-term Enterprise Risk Management (ERM / manajemen risiko perusahaan) approach. It explains the potential impacts of using external public AI platforms—though BKI is not yet using AI for decision-making in surveys, inspections, or certification—and highlights risks to data privacy, accreditation / akreditasi, and decision accuracy, tied to BKI’s client confidentiality needs.

title: Risiko Emerging
section_path: ESG > Governance > Risiko yang Sedang Berkembang: Risiko Emerging > Risiko 2: Ketahanan Operasional Jaringan Cabang di Wilayah Rawan Bencana > Kategori: Lingkungan | Jangka Waktu Dampak: 5–25 tahun
text:
Risiko Emerging > Risiko 2: Ketahanan Operasional Jaringan Cabang di Wilayah Rawan Bencana > Kategori: Lingkungan | Jangka Waktu Dampak: 5–25 tahun

- Keputusan bisnis dan operasional yang kurang akurat akibat keluaran kecerdasan artifisial yang tidak tervalidasi secara memadai.

- Ketergantungan terhadap penyedia platform eksternal yang dapat memengaruhi keberlangsungan proses kerja dan fleksibilitas operasional.

- Melakukan pemetaan penggunaan platform AI yang telah berjalan, mencakup pengguna, fungsi pekerjaan, jenis aktivitas, serta kategori informasi yang diproses sebagai dasar penyusunan pengendalian.

- Menetapkan kebijakan penggunaan kecerdasan artifisial yang mengatur klasifikasi data, batasan penggunaan, serta larangan memasukkan informasi rahasia klien, data pribadi, dan dokumen yang memiliki kewajiban kerahasiaan ke platform publik.

- Menerapkan pengendalian akses melalui perangkat dan jaringan kerja untuk membatasi penggunaan layanan kecerdasan artifisial yang belum disetujui serta meningkatkan visibilitas aktivitas penggunaan.

- Melaksanakan program literasi penggunaan platform AI bagi pekerja untuk meningkatkan pemahaman terkait keamanan informasi, batasan penggunaan, risiko keluaran yang tidak akurat, serta praktik penggunaan yang bertanggung jawab.

- Mengintegrasikan risiko pemanfaatan platform AI ke dalam sistem manajemen risiko korporat serta mengembangkan kerangka tata kelola berdasarkan prinsip SNI ISO/IEC 42001:2023 dan referensi tata kelola AI yang relevan.

- Menetapkan dedicated personil yang memiliki kompetensi dibidang cyber security dan Artificial Intelligence (AI)

- Penguatan infrastruktur Hardware dan Software yang sesuai dengan perkembangan teknologi terbaru (Advanced Technology) dalam rangka memastikan keamanan data dan informasi perusahaan.

Jaringan operasi Perseroan memiliki konsentrasi yang cukup tinggi di wilayah Kalimantan, khususnya melalui cabang Samarinda, Balikpapan, Banjarmasin, dan Pontianak. Wilayah tersebut memiliki karakteristik geografis yang menyebabkan paparan terhadap berbagai risiko kebencanaan dan perubahan iklim yang saling berkaitan, seperti kebakaran hutan dan lahan beserta kabut asap, banjir dan rob di wilayah dataran rendah, penurunan muka tanah pada area tertentu, serta potensi aktivitas kegempaan di sekitar wilayah timur Kalimantan.
context: Chunk ini merupakan bagian dari laporan tata kelola dan manajemen risiko BKI (Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia) pada topik **Emerging Risk / Risiko Emerging**. Secara spesifik membahas **Risiko 2: Ketahanan Operasional Jaringan Cabang di Wilayah Rawan Bencana** (kategori **Environment/Lingkungan**) dengan **jangka waktu dampak 5–25 tahun**, mencakup langkah pengendalian pemanfaatan **AI/Artificial Intelligence (kecerdasan artifisial)** dan ketergantungan platform eksternal, serta penjelasan konsentrasi jaringan cabang di Kalimantan (Samarinda, Balikpapan, Banjarmasin, Pontianak).

title: Risiko Emerging
section_path: ESG > Governance > Risiko yang Sedang Berkembang: Risiko Emerging > Risiko 2: Ketahanan Operasional Jaringan Cabang di Wilayah Rawan Bencana > Potensi Dampak
text:
Risiko Emerging > Risiko 2: Ketahanan Operasional Jaringan Cabang di Wilayah Rawan Bencana > Potensi Dampak

Risiko ini memiliki karakter yang berbeda dari risiko kebencanaan biasa karena dampaknya bersifat berulang, berlangsung dalam jangka panjang, dan dapat terjadi secara bersamaan. Sebagai perusahaan yang mengandalkan kehadiran tenaga surveyor di lapangan, perubahan kondisi iklim secara langsung dapat memengaruhi keberlangsungan operasional. Peningkatan suhu dan tekanan panas dapat mengurangi waktu kerja aman pada lokasi seperti galangan, dermaga, tongkang, maupun area industri terbuka, sehingga berpotensi menurunkan produktivitas kegiatan survei. Di sisi lain, kejadian akut seperti kabut asap dan banjir dapat menghambat mobilisasi personel akibat gangguan transportasi udara maupun jalur pelayaran sungai.

Selain berdampak pada kegiatan operasional internal, risiko iklim di wilayah Kalimantan juga memiliki keterkaitan dengan kondisi bisnis pelanggan Perseroan. Sebagian besar aktivitas cabang Kalimantan melayani sektor yang memiliki ketergantungan tinggi terhadap kondisi lingkungan dan cuaca, seperti pertambangan batubara, kelapa sawit, kehutanan, serta industri galangan dan armada pendukungnya. Dengan demikian, gangguan akibat perubahan iklim dan kebencanaan tidak hanya berpotensi menghambat kemampuan Perseroan dalam memberikan layanan, tetapi juga dapat menurunkan aktivitas ekonomi pelanggan yang menjadi sumber permintaan jasa.

Kombinasi antara konsentrasi geografis, ketergantungan terhadap sektor usaha tertentu, dan meningkatnya intensitas risiko iklim menjadikan wilayah Kalimantan sebagai area yang perlu mendapatkan perhatian khusus dalam penguatan ketahanan operasional dan keberlanjutan pendapatan cabang Perseroan.

- Penurunan produktivitas kegiatan survei akibat berkurangnya waktu kerja efektif di lapangan pada kondisi tekanan panas tinggi, meskipun tidak terjadi bencana secara langsung.

- Penurunan pendapatan cabang Kalimantan yang berkontribusi terhadap pendapatan Perseroan, serta potensi timbulnya penalti atau risiko pemutusan kontrak akibat keterlambatan penyelesaian pekerjaan.

- Kerusakan aset operasional, peralatan uji, serta dokumen teknis akibat kejadian kebencanaan, dengan potensi risiko keterbatasan cakupan perlindungan asuransi terhadap gangguan usaha.
context: Chunk ini berasal dari dokumen ESG/Governance BKI (Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia/Indonesian Classification Bureau) yang membahas Emerging Risk dalam manajemen risiko dan keberlanjutan pada layanan TICCS (Testing, Inspection, Certification, Classification and Statutory). Bagian ini spesifik pada “Risiko 2: Ketahanan Operasional Jaringan Cabang di Wilayah Rawan Bencana” serta dampaknya terhadap produktivitas survei dan pendapatan cabang Kalimantan. Keterkaitan operasional juga dengan regulasi maritim seperti SOLAS/ISM/ISPS, termasuk layanan inspeksi di area dermaga/galangan.

- Penurunan permintaan jasa inspeksi, sertifikasi, dan survei akibat terganggunya aktivitas pelanggan utama pada sektor komoditas yang memiliki keterkaitan kuat dengan kondisi iklim.

- Risiko tidak tercapainya target pendapatan dan kinerja operasional pada tingkat cabang maupun konsolidasi akibat gangguan operasional yang berlangsung secara berulang.

- Melakukan analisis skenario dampak iklim terhadap keberlangsungan bisnis, termasuk estimasi pendapatan yang terpapar risiko pada tingkat cabang, serta mengintegrasikan hasil analisis ke dalam proses penyusunan RKAP dan perencanaan bisnis.

- Memperkuat fleksibilitas operasional melalui skema dukungan antar cabang, pengembangan kapasitas alternatif, serta pemanfaatan teknologi seperti survei jarak jauh dan sertifikat elektronik untuk menjaga kesinambungan layanan.

- Meningkatkan ketahanan aset dan fasilitas melalui evaluasi perlindungan terhadap risiko kebakaran, banjir, rob, dan gempa, termasuk penguatan struktur bangunan, sistem proteksi, serta penyediaan sumber daya listrik cadangan.

- Mengurangi ketergantungan terhadap sektor usaha tertentu melalui diversifikasi portofolio pendapatan cabang dan pengembangan peluang jasa pada sektor infrastruktur, kawasan industri, dan sektor ekonomi baru di Kalimantan.

- Untuk wilayah terdampak bencana akan dilakukan kajian terkait pelaksanaan Medical Check Up (MCU) secara berkala.

title: Pengelolaan Emisi Gas Rumah Kaca
section_path: ESG > Environment > Inventarisasi Emisi Gas Rumah Kaca: Pengelolaan Emisi Gas Rumah Kaca > Emisi Scope 1
text:
Pengelolaan Emisi Gas Rumah Kaca > ESG > Environment > Inventarisasi Emisi Gas Rumah Kaca: Pengelolaan Emisi Gas Rumah Kaca > Emisi Scope 1

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI berkomitmen untuk mengelola dan mengurangi emisi Gas Rumah Kaca (GRK) yang dihasilkan dari kegiatan operasional maupun aktivitas dalam rantai nilai perusahaan. Sebagai bagian dari komitmen tersebut, BKI melakukan inventarisasi emisi GRK untuk mengidentifikasi sumber emisi utama, memantau perkembangan kinerja emisi, serta menjadi dasar dalam menentukan langkah-langkah efisiensi dan pengurangan emisi secara berkelanjutan.

Perhitungan emisi GRK BKI dikelompokkan berdasarkan emisi langsung (Scope 1), emisi tidak langsung dari energi yang dibeli dan digunakan (Scope 2), serta emisi tidak langsung lainnya yang berasal dari rantai nilai perusahaan (Scope 3). Pada tahun 2025, cakupan inventarisasi emisi GRK BKI telah mencapai 100% dari cakupan pelaporan yang ditetapkan perusahaan.

Emisi Scope 1 merupakan emisi GRK yang berasal secara langsung dari sumber yang dimiliki atau berada dalam kendali operasional BKI. Sumber emisi tersebut mencakup kendaraan operasional, penggunaan bahan bakar pada genset, dan refrigeran.

Pada tahun 2025, total emisi Cakupan 1 BKI tercatat sebesar 683,05 ton CO2e, meningkat 4,47% dibandingkan 653,81 ton CO2e pada tahun sebelumnya. Kenaikan ini seluruhnya berasal dari pembakaran bergerak, yang naik 4,47% menjadi 683,05 ton CO2e seiring bertambahnya konsumsi bahan bakar kendaraan operasional untuk kegiatan survei dan inspeksi lapangan. Sebaliknya, emisi dari pembakaran stasioner turun 33,37% menjadi 4,21 ton CO2e akibat berkurangnya penggunaan genset sebagai sumber daya cadangan sepanjang 2025, sementara emisi fugitif refrigeran relatif stabil pada 31,38 ton CO2e.

text:
Pengelolaan Emisi Gas Rumah Kaca > Emisi Scope 1 > Emisi Scope 2

***Inventarisasi emisi di tingkat organisasi baru mulai dilaksanakan pada tahun 2024.**

Untuk mengendalikan emisi Cakupan 1, BKI menjalankan berbagai upaya, antara lain pengoperasian delapan unit kendaraan listrik sebagai kendaraan dinas Direksi pada 2025 yang didukung pemasangan Stasiun Pengisian Kendaraan Listrik Umum (SPKLU) di lingkungan kantor pusat, penggantian kompor berbahan bakar gas dengan kompor listrik pada fasilitas penunjang, optimalisasi penggunaan kendaraan operasional, serta perawatan kendaraan dan peralatan secara berkala. Perluasan armada kendaraan listrik menjadi sepuluh unit direncanakan pada 2026, disertai perluasan opsi kendaraan listrik bagi seluruh tingkatan struktural Perusahaan.

Emisi Scope 2 merupakan emisi tidak langsung yang timbul dari energi yang dibeli dan dikonsumsi oleh BKI, terutama penggunaan listrik untuk mendukung kegiatan perkantoran dan operasional perusahaan. Mengingat karakteristik bisnis BKI yang sebagian besar berbasis jasa, penggunaan listrik menjadi salah satu sumber penting emisi GRK dalam kegiatan operasional perusahaan.

Pada tahun 2025, emisi Cakupan 2 BKI berdasarkan pendekatan location-based tercatat sebesar 3.151,82 ton CO2e, meningkat 0,58% dibandingkan 3.133,54 ton CO2e pada tahun sebelumnya. Kenaikan ini terjadi meskipun konsumsi listrik Perusahaan justru menurun 0,55% menjadi 3.467.957,27 kWh Perhitungan location-based menggambarkan emisi berdasarkan rata-rata faktor emisi jaringan listrik pada lokasi penggunaan energi.

text:
Pengelolaan Emisi Gas Rumah Kaca > Emisi Scope 1 > Emisi Scope 3

*Inventarisasi emisi di tingkat organisasi baru mulai dilaksanakan pada tahun 2024.

Pada tahun 2025, total emisi Cakupan 3 BKI tercatat sebesar 1.415,81 ton CO2e, terdiri atas Kategori 6 sebesar 1.199,14 ton CO2e dan Kategori 7 sebesar 216,67 ton CO2e. Angka ini tidak dapat diperbandingkan secara langsung dengan 154,88 ton CO2e pada 2024, karena cakupan inventarisasi Cakupan 3 mengalami perluasan yang signifikan. Perluasan tersebut mencakup tiga hal. Pertama, jumlah unit kerja yang melaporkan data perjalanan bisnis bertambah dari cakupan 74,77% menjadi 92%, meliputi 49 dari 53 unit kerja dengan 4.118 perjalanan tercatat. Kedua, moda transportasi yang diinventarisasi bertambah, dari semula hanya pesawat udara dan kereta api menjadi mencakup pula mobil dan taksi. Ketiga, Kategori 7 diinventarisasi untuk pertama kalinya pada tahun pelaporan 2025.

Pada tahun 2025, Perusahaan belum menetapkan target kuantitatif penurunan emisi maupun peta jalan (roadmap) pengurangan emisi per cakupan, mengingat fokus utama periode 2025–2026 diarahkan pada penguatan inventarisasi serta pencatatan data emisi secara lebih komprehensif. Kontribusi penurunan emisi dari masing-masing inisiatif juga belum dihitung secara terpisah. Peta jalan serta target reduksi emisi yang terukur direncanakan disusun pada periode 2027–2028 sebagai bagian dari Kajian Climate Change Vulnerability & Sustainability Assessment (CCSA), dan akan diselaraskan dengan penyusunan roadmap Net Zero Emission IDSurvey Group pada tahun 2027 yang menetapkan tahun dasar (base year), target antara (interim target), serta strategi dekarbonisasi lintas cakupan emisi secara terintegrasi. Untuk periode berjalan, intensitas emisi digunakan sebagai indikator utama pemantauan kinerja iklim Perusahaan.

title: LABOR PRACTICES
section_path: ESG > Social > Employee Support Programs: LABOR PRACTICES > Right to Leave
text:
LABOR PRACTICES > ESG > Social > Employee Support Programs: LABOR PRACTICES > Right to Leave

BKI recruits employees in accordance with the Company’s workforce requirements and available positions. The recruitment process takes into account the qualifications of each candidate and is conducted fairly and transparently while upholding human rights. BKI prohibits the recruitment of underage individuals, respects the diverse backgrounds of all candidates, and ensures that the recruitment process is free from discrimination based on social group, ethnicity, religion, or gender.

With respect to remuneration, PT BKI (Persero) has established a formal wage structure and scale to ensure that all employees receive compensation above the applicable minimum wage in their respective operational areas, amounting to at least 1,2 times the applicable Regency or City Minimum Wage. The minimum wage established by the Company is reviewed annually and adjusted based on benchmarking against comparable industries and changes in macroeconomic factors, including inflation.

Furthermore, in support of the principle of equality, BKI is committed to maintaining equal remuneration for male and female employees performing comparable work or holding equivalent positions, in accordance with the formally established wage structure and scale. Periodic monitoring is conducted by comparing the ratios of base salary and total remuneration between male and female employees across various job levels. The results of this monitoring serve as a basis for the continuous evaluation and improvement of remuneration policies and other employee benefits, thereby ensuring that equitable remuneration practices are consistently maintained throughout all levels of the organization.

| **Keterangan** | **Ratio (%)** |
|---|---|

| Mean Gender Pay Gap Ratio | 41% |

| Median Gender Pay Gap Ratio | 81% |

| Mean Bonus Gap Ratio | 16% |

| Median Bonus Gap Ratio | 20% |

BKI employees are entitled to 12 (twelve) working days of annual leave after completing 12 (twelve) consecutive months of service with the Company, in accordance with applicable national regulations. BKI encourages employees to exercise their leave entitlements to support their well-being and work-life balance.

Furthermore, as a form of recognition for employee loyalty and dedication, BKI provides long-service leave once every five years, calculated from the commencement of employment with the Company. Employees are entitled to 12 (twelve) working days of long-service leave, in addition to their annual leave entitlement, as well as an allowance equivalent to one month’s salary. The Company also grants maternity leave for female employees for 3 months (12 weeks), as well as permission for male employees to accompany their wives during childbirth (paternity leave) for 2 working days.

It specifies figures and benefits: 12 working days annual leave after 12 months, long-service leave every 5 years (12 working days plus 1 month’s salary allowance), and maternity leave of 3 months (12 weeks) plus paternity leave of 2 working days.

title: LABOR PRACTICES
section_path: ESG > Social > Employee Support Programs: LABOR PRACTICES > Employee Social Welfare Support: Relocation
text:
LABOR PRACTICES > ESG > Social > Employee Support Programs: LABOR PRACTICES > Employee Social Welfare Support: Relocation

All Company employees work eight hours per day and 40 hours per week. Working hours are monitored daily through BKI Time, a platform used by employees to record their clock-in and clock-out times. Any discrepancies or unusual instances of excessive working hours are followed up in accordance with applicable Company regulations.

The Company also guarantees full compensation for all approved overtime hours, including additional allowances for employees who work on national public holidays. Overtime performed pursuant to an Overtime Work Order (Surat Perintah Lembur) and verified through BKI Time is compensated in accordance with Company regulations and applicable laws.

In the event of exceptional circumstances requiring employees to work extended overtime hours, the overtime arrangement is adjusted through the implementation of a shift system. This measure is intended to ensure that each employee’s overtime hours remain within reasonable limits.

BKI regularly facilitates two-way communication between the Company and its employees through forums organized by the Bipartite Cooperation Institution (Lembaga Kerja Sama Bipartit/LKS Bipartit). These forums are held quarterly and serve as a platform for employees, whether represented by a labor union or otherwise, to submit grievances, provide feedback, and discuss current employment-related issues that may contribute to improved employee performance and well-being within the Company.

BKI provides occupational health and safety protection that is proportionate to the level of risk exposure inherent in each job function. As an extension of the mandatory social protection programs administered by the Government, namely BPJS Employment and BPJS Health, BKI also provides additional protection based on the occupational risk profiles of different employee groups.

Surveyors and inspectors, in particular, face higher occupational risks due to the technical and field-based nature of their work. The Company therefore provides these employees with additional health and accident insurance coverage through private insurance policies.

Annual medical checkups are also provided to permanent employees. Other healthcare needs, including inpatient care, outpatient care, dental treatment, vision care, and other eligible medical expenses, are covered by the Company in accordance with applicable provisions.

BKI recognizes that the Company has an extensive operational presence and that employee relocation may have significant implications for the employees concerned. Relocation to another work location is sometimes unavoidable due to operational requirements and requires employees to make various preparations when transferring for an extended period. BKI remains committed to supporting employees throughout the relocation process to ensure that it is carried out smoothly, fairly, and comfortably.

section_path: ESG > Social > Employee Support Programs: LABOR PRACTICES > Retirement Preparation Program
text:
LABOR PRACTICES > ESG > Social > Employee Support Programs: LABOR PRACTICES > Retirement Preparation Program

Relocation support includes financial assistance for moving employees’ personal belongings, as well as transportation assistance for employees and their families, where applicable. This assistance covers travel tickets, employee travel allowances, and hotel accommodation for the first seven days following relocation. The Company also covers housing rental costs for the first two years to support employees and their families in adapting to their new environment.

For employees with families and school-age children, BKI also provides financial assistance for school transfers to support the continuity and quality of their children’s education.

As part of its commitment to employee well-being and respect for human dignity, the Company provides bereavement assistance in the form of financial support to employees and their families during periods of loss. This assistance is intended to alleviate the financial burden associated with funeral arrangements and other related needs. Such support reflects BKI’s recognition that genuine care for employees extends beyond the workplace and encompasses some of the most difficult moments in their personal lives.

BKI highly values the loyalty and dedication of employees who continue to contribute to the Company. As a form of appreciation and recognition, permanent employees are awarded precious metals, with the weight determined according to the applicable service milestone, upon completing 15 years and 25 years of service, as well as upon retirement.

BKI implements the Retirement Preparation Program (Masa Persiapan Pensiun or MPP) as part of the Company’s support for employees transitioning into retirement. The program is provided to employees approaching retirement age to equip them with the knowledge and skills required to prepare for life after employment.

The MPP is conducted periodically and covers topics such as personal financial management, post-retirement activity planning, and the development of business opportunities aligned with employees’ interests and potential. In implementing the program, the Company may engage relevant professionals or practitioners to share practical insights and experience. Employees may also participate in the program together with their spouses as part of a more comprehensive approach to retirement preparation.

This assistance is intended to alleviate the financial burden associated with funeral arrangements and other related needs. Such support reflects BKI’s recognition that genuine care for employees extends beyond the workplace and encompasses some of the most difficult moments in their personal lives.

BKI highly values the loyalty and dedication of employees who continue to contribute to the Company. As a form of appreciation and recognition, permanent employees are awarded precious metals, with the weight determined according to the applicable service milestone, upon completing 15 years and 25 years of service, as well as upon retirement.

BKI implements the Retirement Preparation Program (Masa Persiapan Pensiun or MPP) as part of the Company’s support for employees transitioning into retirement. The program is provided to employees approaching retirement age to equip them with the knowledge and skills required to prepare for life after employment.

The MPP is conducted periodically and covers topics such as personal financial management, post-retirement activity planning, and the development of business opportunities aligned with employees’ interests and potential. In implementing the program, the Company may engage relevant professionals or practitioners to share practical insights and experience. Employees may also participate in the program together with their spouses as part of a more comprehensive approach to retirement preparation.

Pengelolaan limbah dilakukan dengan mempertimbangkan jenis, karakteristik, dan metode penanganan masing-masing limbah. Limbah yang masih memiliki nilai guna diarahkan untuk digunakan kembali, didaur ulang, atau melalui bentuk pemulihan material lainnya. Sementara itu, limbah yang tidak dapat dimanfaatkan lebih lanjut dikelola melalui mekanisme pembuangan yang sesuai dengan karakteristik limbah dan ketentuan yang berlaku.

Dalam pelaksanaannya, BKI bekerja sama dengan pihak ketiga dalam pengelolaan limbah Bahan Berbahaya dan Beracun (B3) maupun non-B3. Limbah yang dikategorikan sebagai waste disposed merupakan limbah yang diserahkan kepada pihak ketiga untuk selanjutnya dikelola dan diarahkan ke fasilitas pengolahan atau pembuangan akhir yang sesuai. Mekanisme ini memastikan bahwa limbah yang tidak dapat dimanfaatkan kembali tetap ditangani secara bertanggung jawab sesuai dengan jenis dan karakteristiknya.

title: Pengelolaan Limbah dan Polutan
section_path: ESG > Environment > Pengelolaan Limbah: Pengelolaan Limbah dan Polutan > Upaya Pengurangan dan Pemanfaatan Kembali Limbah
text:
Pengelolaan Limbah dan Polutan > ESG > Environment > Pengelolaan Limbah: Pengelolaan Limbah dan Polutan > Upaya Pengurangan dan Pemanfaatan Kembali Limbah

Sebagai bagian dari upaya meningkatkan efisiensi sumber daya dan mendukung penerapan prinsip ekonomi sirkular, BKI menjalankan prinsip 3R (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle) melalui inisiatif-inisiatif berikut:

1. **Digitalisasi dokumen dan pengurangan penggunaan kertas : **Penggunaan kertas dikendalikan melalui sistem e-office, pencetakan bolak-balik, dan pemanfaatan sisi kosong kertas bekas sesuai arahan surat edaran holding IDSurvey mengenai penerapan prinsip green building. Pada tahun 2025, penggunaan kertas turun 8,8% menjadi 411 rim atau 1.023 kilogram, dibandingkan 451 rim atau 1.123 kilogram pada tahun 2024.
2. **Pemilahan sampah sejak sumber :** Limbah dipilah berdasarkan kategori organik, anorganik, dan residu, serta dipisahkan dari limbah B3 yang disimpan di TPS Limbah B3 berizin dengan pelabelan dan pencatatan manifes.
3. **Pengurangan plastik sekali pakai : **Perusahaan menerbitkan surat edaran yang mengatur pengurangan penggunaan kantong plastik dan pelarangan penggunaan styrofoam, serta mewajibkan penggunaan peralatan makan non-plastik berbahan kaca pada setiap kegiatan internal.
4. **Daur ulang dan pengolahan biologis melalui kemitraan : **Sampah organik dan anorganik disalurkan melalui bank sampah untuk didaur ulang dan digunakan kembali; sebagian sampah organik diolah menjadi pupuk kompos dan sebagian lainnya melalui budidaya larva Black Soldier Fly (BSF).

Rangkaian inisiatif pengelolaan limbah non-B3 sepanjang 2025 yang meliputi pemilahan sejak sumber, penyaluran sampah organik dan anorganik melalui bank sampah, pengomposan, serta pengolahan biologis melalui BSF, merupakan tahapan menuju pencapaian zero waste to landfill.

Melalui penerapan inisiatif tersebut, BKI mendorong agar material yang masih memiliki nilai guna tidak langsung diarahkan ke pembuangan akhir, tetapi terlebih dahulu dipertimbangkan untuk digunakan kembali, didaur ulang, atau dipulihkan sesuai dengan karakteristik material dan ketersediaan fasilitas pengelolaan.

Sebagai bagian dari upaya meningkatkan efisiensi sumber daya dan mendukung penerapan prinsip ekonomi sirkular, BKI menjalankan prinsip 3R (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle) melalui inisiatif-inisiatif berikut:

1. **Digitalisasi dokumen dan pengurangan penggunaan kertas : **Penggunaan kertas dikendalikan melalui sistem e-office, pencetakan bolak-balik, dan pemanfaatan sisi kosong kertas bekas sesuai arahan surat edaran holding IDSurvey mengenai penerapan prinsip green building. Pada tahun 2025, penggunaan kertas turun 8,8% menjadi 411 rim atau 1.023 kilogram, dibandingkan 451 rim atau 1.123 kilogram pada tahun 2024.
2. **Pemilahan sampah sejak sumber :** Limbah dipilah berdasarkan kategori organik, anorganik, dan residu, serta dipisahkan dari limbah B3 yang disimpan di TPS Limbah B3 berizin dengan pelabelan dan pencatatan manifes.
3. **Pengurangan plastik sekali pakai : **Perusahaan menerbitkan surat edaran yang mengatur pengurangan penggunaan kantong plastik dan pelarangan penggunaan styrofoam, serta mewajibkan penggunaan peralatan makan non-plastik berbahan kaca pada setiap kegiatan internal.
4. **Daur ulang dan pengolahan biologis melalui kemitraan : **Sampah organik dan anorganik disalurkan melalui bank sampah untuk didaur ulang dan digunakan kembali; sebagian sampah organik diolah menjadi pupuk kompos dan sebagian lainnya melalui budidaya larva Black Soldier Fly (BSF).

Rangkaian inisiatif pengelolaan limbah non-B3 sepanjang 2025 yang meliputi pemilahan sejak sumber, penyaluran sampah organik dan anorganik melalui bank sampah, pengomposan, serta pengolahan biologis melalui BSF, merupakan tahapan menuju pencapaian zero waste to landfill.

Melalui penerapan inisiatif tersebut, BKI mendorong agar material yang masih memiliki nilai guna tidak langsung diarahkan ke pembuangan akhir, tetapi terlebih dahulu dipertimbangkan untuk digunakan kembali, didaur ulang, atau dipulihkan sesuai dengan karakteristik material dan ketersediaan fasilitas pengelolaan.

title: Pengelolaan Limbah dan Polutan
section_path: ESG > Environment > Pengelolaan Limbah: Pengelolaan Limbah dan Polutan > Target dan Peningkatan Kinerja
text:
Pengelolaan Limbah dan Polutan > ESG > Environment > Pengelolaan Limbah: Pengelolaan Limbah dan Polutan > Target dan Peningkatan Kinerja

Melalui penerapan inisiatif tersebut, BKI mendorong agar material yang masih memiliki nilai guna tidak langsung diarahkan ke pembuangan akhir, tetapi terlebih dahulu dipertimbangkan untuk digunakan kembali, didaur ulang, atau dipulihkan sesuai dengan karakteristik material dan ketersediaan fasilitas pengelolaan.

Untuk limbah yang pengelolaannya dilakukan melalui pihak ketiga, BKI terus mendorong peningkatan ketertelusuran metode pengelolaan akhir limbah sehingga perusahaan dapat memperoleh informasi yang lebih komprehensif mengenai jumlah limbah yang didaur ulang, dimanfaatkan kembali, maupun diarahkan ke metode pembuangan lainnya.

Hingga tahun pelaporan 2025, BKI belum menetapkan target kuantitatif tahunan untuk total limbah yang dibuang maupun proporsi limbah yang didaur ulang, mengingat cakupan pencatatan data limbah baru diperluas pada tahun berjalan hingga mencakup Kantor Cabang. Arah kebijakan Perusahaan mengacu pada pencapaian zero waste to landfill, dan penetapan target kuantitatif akan dilakukan setelah data dasar (baseline) pada cakupan yang telah diperluas terkonfirmasi stabil. Ke depan, BKI akan terus memperkuat sistem pengelolaan limbah melalui peningkatan kualitas dan cakupan pencatatan data, penguatan pemilahan limbah dari sumbernya, pengurangan timbulan limbah, serta peningkatan proporsi limbah yang dapat digunakan kembali atau didaur ulang. Upaya tersebut diharapkan dapat mengurangi jumlah limbah yang diarahkan ke pembuangan akhir sekaligus mendukung pemanfaatan sumber daya secara lebih efisien dan berkelanjutan.

It notes that as of 2025, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) has not yet set quantitative annual targets for total waste disposed or recycled because waste data coverage was expanded to include Kantor Cabang, with targets planned after baseline stabilization.

Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (BKI) is the national classification society of Indonesia, established in 1964 to strengthen the country's maritime independence. For more than six decades, BKI has been trusted for its independence, integrity, and expertise in safeguarding assets across the maritime, energy, infrastructure, and industrial sectors. As a Classification Society, BKI develops and applies technical standards for the design, construction, and survey of ships and offshore structures. Vessels built and maintained in accordance with these standards are awarded a Classification Certificate, confirming compliance with recognized international safety and quality benchmarks.

BKI also carries out statutory survey and certification services on behalf of the Government of Indonesia and foreign flag states. These include Load Line, ISM Code, and ISPS Code certification, ensuring compliance with IMO conventions and global maritime regulations. Over the years, BKI has evolved into a comprehensive TICCS service provider (Testing, Inspection, Certification, Classification, and Statutory), supporting industries through inspection, testing, consultancy, and certification services. Our solutions are designed to ensure safety, reliability, and sustainability across multiple sectors. Headquartered in Jakarta with branch offices in major Indonesian ports and Singapore, BKI also maintains cooperative agreements with leading international classification societies, including mutual recognition and dual class arrangements.

title: About Us
section_path: BKI Officially Becomes the Holding Company for Survey Services
text:
About Us > BKI Officially Becomes the Holding Company for Survey Services

The Government of Indonesia issued Government Regulation No. 1 of 1977, transforming BKI from a state-owned enterprise into a Limited Liability Company (Persero). This marked the beginning of BKI's journey as a modern classification society. Since then, BKI's scope has expanded beyond ship classification to also cover non-classification services.

BKI pioneered non-classification business activities, including consultancy and supervision services in maritime, industrial, and other engineering sectors. This division later became known as Commercial Services.

Through Notarial Deed of Neneng Salmiah No. 11 dated March 14, 2003, BKI amended its Articles of Association to expand its objectives and business fields, aligning with the principles of Good Corporate Governance (GCG). This change was recorded in the Supplement of the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 11847 of 2003.

As a co-founder of the Asian Classification Societies (ACS), BKI hosted the Extraordinary ACS Executives Meeting, strengthening collaboration among Asian classification societies.

Specifically for Indonesian-flagged vessels operating internationally.

BKI was elected as the Chairman of the Asian Classification Societies (ACS).

Based on Government Regulation No. 66 of 2021 regarding the additional state capital investment in PT BKI (Persero), and the Deed of Shareholders' Resolution, PT BKI (Persero) became the parent company of the Survey Services Holding (IDSurvey), with subsidiaries: PT Sucofindo & PT Surveyor Indonesia.

section_path: BKI as the Internationally Recognized National Classification Authority
text:
About Us > BKI as the Internationally Recognized National Classification Authority

In October 2022, BKI signed a Memorandum of Understanding with several state-owned enterprises including Pertamina, PLN, Perum Perhutani, Semen Indonesia, Pupuk Indonesia, MIND ID, PTPN, and EMI to support decarbonization initiatives.

Minister Erick Thohir endorsed the collaboration between IDSurvey and the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) in supporting the national carbon trading system. This partnership accelerates SOEs' decarbonization efforts and contributes to achieving Net Zero Emissions by 2060.

On August 23, 2024, BKI held the Pre-Launch of the Maritime Cloud Platform (MCP) at Marina Batavia Sunda Kelapa, attended by the Minister of SOEs. The initiative supports Indonesia's Net Zero Carbon Emission 2060 target and included the signing of a Letter of Intent for the SOEs' Voluntary Carbon Market (VCM).

Today, PT BKI (Persero) remains the only national classification society in Indonesia recognized internationally to provide classification and certification in the maritime sector. BKI continues to strengthen Indonesia's maritime sovereignty while maintaining global recognition.

section_path: ESG > Social > Program Pendukung Kesejahteraan Karyawan: PRAKTIK KETENAGAKERJAAN > Upah yang Layak, Adil, dan Setara
text:
PRAKTIK KETENAGAKERJAAN > ESG > Social > Program Pendukung Kesejahteraan Karyawan: PRAKTIK KETENAGAKERJAAN > Upah yang Layak, Adil, dan Setara

Dalam aspek pengupahan, PT BKI (Persero) menetapkan struktur dan skala upah yang memastikan seluruh karyawan menerima kompensasi di atas standar upah minimum yang berlaku di wilayah operasional masing-masing, setidak-tidaknya 1,2x di atas UMK (Upah Minimum Kabupaten/Kota). Nilai upah minimum yang ditetapkan Perusahaan akan dikaji setiap tahun dan disesuaikan berdasarkan benchmarking terhadap industri sejenis serta perubahan faktor makroekonomi seperti nilai inflasi.

Selain itu, dalam rangka mendukung prinsip kesetaraan, BKI berkomitmen menjaga kesetaraan remunerasi antara karyawan laki-laki dan perempuan untuk posisi yang sejenis dan setara, dengan mengacu pada struktur dan skala upah yang ditetapkan secara formal. Pemantauan dilakukan secara berkala melalui rasio mean dan median terkait gender pay gap serta mean dan median bonus gap. Hasil pemantauan tersebut menjadi dasar evaluasi dan perbaikan berkelanjutan terhadap kebijakan pengupahan dan manfaat lainnya, sehingga prinsip keadilan pengupahan dapat terus terjaga di seluruh jenjang organisasi.

text:
PRAKTIK KETENAGAKERJAAN > ESG > Social > Program Pendukung Kesejahteraan Karyawan: PRAKTIK KETENAGAKERJAAN > Hak Atas Cuti

Karyawan BKI memiliki hak atas cuti selama 12 (dua belas) hari kerja setiap tahunnya setelah bekerja di Perusahaan selama 12 (dua belas) Bulan secara berturut-turut sesuai dengan regulasi nasional yang berlaku. BKI mendukung karyawan untuk mengambil hak cuti tersebut untuk mendukung kesejahteraan dan keseimbangan hidup karyawan. Selain itu, sebagai bentuk penghargaan atas loyalitas dan dedikasi karyawan, BKI juga memberikan cuti besar untuk karyawan setiap 5 tahun sekali, terhitung dari masa karyawan bekerja di Perusahaan. Cuti besar diberikan selama 12 (dua belas) hari kerja (di luar cuti tahunan) dalam satu tahun, ditambah tunjangan senilai 1 (satu) kali gaji bulanan. Perusahaan juga memberikan hak cuti melahirkan (maternity leave) bagi karyawan perempuan selama 3 bulan (12 minggu), serta izin bagi karyawan laki-laki (paternity leave) untuk mendampingi istri melahirkan selama 2 hari kerja.

Pemantauan Jam Kerja dan Mekanisme Lembur

Seluruh karyawan Perusahaan bekerja dengan ketentuan waktu kerja 8 (delapan) jam per hari dan 40 (empat puluh) jam per minggu. Pemantauan jam kerja dilakukan setiap hari melalui BKI Time, sebuah platform untuk karyawan melakukan absensi masuk dan pulang, dan setiap ketidaksesuaian atau kelebihan jam kerja yang tidak wajar akan ditindaklanjuti sesuai peraturan perusahaan yang berlaku.

Selain itu, perusahaan menjamin pembayaran penuh atas jam lembur yang telah disetujui, termasuk pemberian tunjangan tambahan bagi karyawan yang bekerja pada hari libur nasional. Setiap lembur yang dilakukan atas Surat Perintah Lembur (SPL) dan terverifikasi melalui BKI Time akan dibayarkan sesuai peraturan perusahaan dan regulasi yang berlaku. Dalam hal terdapat kejadian insidentil yang mengharuskan karyawan lembur secara intensif, mekanisme lembur disesuaikan dengan mengimplementasikan sistem shift untuk memastikan jam lembur setiap karyawan tetap pada batas yang wajar.

section_path: ESG > Social > Program Pendukung Kesejahteraan Karyawan: PRAKTIK KETENAGAKERJAAN > Dukungan Kesejahteraan Sosial Karyawan: Relokasi
text:
PRAKTIK KETENAGAKERJAAN > ESG > Social > Program Pendukung Kesejahteraan Karyawan: PRAKTIK KETENAGAKERJAAN > Dukungan Kesejahteraan Sosial Karyawan: Relokasi

BKI secara rutin melakukan komunikasi dua arah antara pihak Perusahaan dan Karyawan melalui forum yang diadakan oleh LKS (Lembaga Kerja Sama) Bipartit. Forum LKS Bipartit dilakukan secara rutin setiap 3 (tiga) bulan sekali, dimana forum ini bertujuan untuk menjadi wadah bagi pihak karyawan, baik yang diwakili serikat pekerja maupun yang tidak, untuk menyampaikan keluhan dan masukan, serta isu ketenagakerjaan terbaru yang dapat mendukung kinerja dan kesejahteraan kehidupan karyawan di lingkungan Perusahaan.

Perlindungan Kesehatan dan Keselamatan Kerja BKI disesuaikan secara proporsional dengan eksposur risiko yang melekat pada masing-masing fungsi pekerjaan. Sebagai bentuk perluasan perlindungan sosial di luar program wajib yang diselenggarakan pemerintah (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan dan BPJS Kesehatan), BKI turut menyediakan perlindungan tambahan yang disesuaikan dengan tingkat risiko pekerjaan masing-masing kelompok karyawan. Khusus bagi surveyor dan inspektor, yang dalam menjalankan tugasnya menghadapi risiko kerja lebih tinggi karena sifat pekerjaan teknis dan lapangan, Perusahaan menyediakan perlindungan tambahan berupa asuransi kesehatan dan kecelakaan melalui polis asuransi swasta.

Dukungan Medical Check Up (MCU) juga diberikan kepada karyawan tetap setiap tahun, dan keperluan kesehatan lainnya seperti Rawat Inap, Rawat Jalan, kebutuhan kesehatan gigi dan kacamata, serta pengobatan mandiri lainnya ditanggung oleh Perusahaan sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku.

BKI menyadari bahwa wilayah operasional Perusahaan sangat luas, dan hal ini berpotensi menimbulkan dampak bagi karyawan. Pemindahan lokasi kerja karyawan menjadi hal yang tidak terelakkan dalam operasional Perusahaan, dan tentunya banyak hal yang harus dipersiapkan karyawan ketika akan berpindah lokasi kerja untuk waktu yang lama. BKI terus berkomitmen untuk mendukung proses perpindahan karyawan agar bisa terlaksana dengan lancar, adil, dan nyaman.

Di sini BKI menyoroti forum bipartit LKS (Lembaga Kerja Sama) yang berlangsung rutin tiap 3 bulan, dukungan perlindungan kesehatan dan keselamatan di luar BPJS (termasuk asuransi swasta untuk surveyor/inspektor), serta dukungan tahunan Medical Check Up (MCU) dan bantuan saat perpindahan lokasi kerja (relokasi).

section_path: ESG > Social > Program Pendukung Kesejahteraan Karyawan: PRAKTIK KETENAGAKERJAAN > Masa Persiapan Pensiun
text:
PRAKTIK KETENAGAKERJAAN > ESG > Social > Program Pendukung Kesejahteraan Karyawan: PRAKTIK KETENAGAKERJAAN > Masa Persiapan Pensiun

Dukungan diberikan kepada karyawan dalam bentuk bantuan dana untuk mendukung keperluan pemindahan barang-barang karyawan, serta bantuan dana transportasi untuk karyawan dan keluarga (jika sudah berkeluarga) yang melingkupi tiket keberangkatan, upah perjalanan karyawan, serta akomodasi hotel untuk tujuh hari ketika karyawan pertama kali pindah ke lokasi kerja baru, dan biaya sewa rumah untuk 2 tahun pertama, untuk mendukung percepatan karyawan dan keluarga beradaptasi dengan lingkungan baru.

Dalam situasi karyawan telah berkeluarga dan memiliki anak yang memasuki usia wajib sekolah, BKI juga memberikan dukungan berupa bantuan dana pindah sekolah untuk mendukung pendidikan yang kontinyu dan berkualitas bagi anak dari karyawan BKI.

Sebagai wujud komitmen terhadap kesejahteraan dan penghargaan atas martabat karyawan, Perusahaan menyediakan bantuan duka berupa dukungan finansial kepada karyawan dan keluarganya dalam menghadapi masa kehilangan. Bantuan ini diberikan untuk meringankan beban yang timbul sehubungan dengan pengurusan dan penyelenggaraan prosesi pemakaman serta kebutuhan terkait lainnya. Dukungan ini mencerminkan kesadaran BKI bahwa kepedulian yang sesungguhnya terhadap karyawan tidak berhenti di lingkungan kerja, melainkan juga pada momen-momen paling berat dalam kehidupan pribadi karyawan.

BKI sangat menghargai loyalitas dan dedikasi Karyawan yang senantiasa terus berkarya dan berkontribusi bersama Perusahaan. Apresiasi dan rekognisi kami berikan kepada karyawan tetap yang telah lama membersamai Perusahaan dalam bentuk pemberian logam mulia kepada karyawan dengan gramasi yang disesuaikan ketika memasuki masa bakti 15 Tahun, 25 Tahun, dan masa purnabakti.

BKI menyelenggarakan Program Masa Persiapan Pensiun (MPP) sebagai bentuk dukungan Perusahaan dalam membantu karyawan mempersiapkan masa transisi menuju purna tugas. Program ini diberikan kepada karyawan yang mendekati masa pensiun untuk membekali mereka dengan pengetahuan dan keterampilan yang diperlukan dalam menghadapi fase kehidupan setelah bekerja.

Isinya menjelaskan dukungan finansial untuk relokasi (biaya pindah barang, transport, akomodasi hotel 7 hari, sewa rumah 2 tahun), dukungan pindah sekolah, bantuan duka, serta rekognisi logam mulia pada 15 tahun, 25 tahun, dan masa purnabakti.

title: Waste and Pollutant Management
section_path: ESG > Environment > Waste Management: Waste and Pollutant Management > Waste Management Performance
text:
Waste and Pollutant Management > ESG > Environment > Waste Management: Waste and Pollutant Management > Waste Management Performance

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) or BKI is committed to managing waste responsibly and improving resource efficiency as part of its efforts to minimize the environmental impacts of its operational activities. Given the nature of BKI’s business, which primarily operates in the services and office-based sectors, the waste generated mainly originates from office activities and supporting operational activities, including hazardous and toxic waste (B3) and non-hazardous waste generated from the Company’s operations.

BKI monitors and records the waste generated from its operational activities, including the respective management methods, to support the evaluation of waste management performance, identify opportunities for waste reduction, and maximize the reuse of materials that retain economic or functional value. In 2025, waste data collection achieved 100% coverage, encompassing all operational units within the Company’s defined reporting scope.

title: Waste and Pollutant Management
section_path: ESG > Environment > Waste Management: Waste and Pollutant Management > Waste Reduction and Reuse Initiatives
text:
Waste and Pollutant Management > ESG > Environment > Waste Management: Waste and Pollutant Management > Waste Reduction and Reuse Initiatives

As part of its efforts to improve resource efficiency and support the implementation of circular economy principles, BKI applies the 3R principles (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle) through the following initiatives:

1. **Document Digitalization and Paper Reduction : **Paper consumption is managed through the implementation of an e-office system, double-sided printing practices, and the utilization of unused sides of previously used paper in accordance with the holding company IDSurvey’s circular letter on the implementation of green building principles. In 2025, paper consumption decreased by 8.8% to 411 reams or 1,023 kilograms, compared to 451 reams or 1,123 kilograms in 2024.
2. **Waste Segregation at Source : **Waste is segregated based on organic, inorganic, and residual categories, while hazardous and toxic waste (B3 waste) is separately managed and stored at a licensed hazardous waste temporary storage facility (TPS Limbah B3) with proper labeling and manifest documentation.
3. **Reduction of Single-Use Plastics :** The Company has issued internal circulars regulating the reduction of plastic bag usage and prohibiting the use of styrofoam, as well as requiring the use of non-plastic glass-based tableware for internal activities.
4. **Recycling and Biological Processing through Partnerships : **Organic and inorganic waste is channelled through waste banks for recycling and reuse. A portion of organic waste is processed into compost, while other organic waste is managed through Black Soldier Fly (BSF) larvae cultivation.

The series of non-hazardous waste management initiatives implemented throughout 2025, including waste segregation at source, the distribution of organic and inorganic waste through waste banks, composting, and biological processing through BSF, represents a step toward achieving zero waste to landfill.

Through these initiatives, BKI promotes the utilization of materials with remaining value before disposal by prioritizing opportunities for reuse, recycling, or recovery based on material characteristics and available waste management facilities.

For waste managed through third parties, BKI continues to encourage improvements in the traceability of final waste management methods to obtain more comprehensive information regarding the quantity of waste recycled, reused, or managed through other disposal methods.

title: Potential use of hydrogen as one of the alternative fuels in Indonesia
text:
Potential use of hydrogen as one of the alternative fuels in Indonesia

The shipping and maritime transport industry plays an important role in the global economy, with about 80% of international trade by sea. However, this sector also contributes greatly to greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, particularly CO2 and NO

The shipping and maritime transport industry plays an important role in the global economy, with about 80% of international trade by sea. However, this sector also contributes greatly to greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, particularly CO2 and NOx, which risk polluting the environment and human health. The development of Alternative Fuels is part of the effort to reduce dependence on fossil fuels and reduce greenhouse gas emissions in accordance with the targets listed in the Paris Agreement as well as the issuance of MARPOL 73/76 Annex VI and Minister of Transportation Regulation No. 29 of 2014 regarding the limits of sulfur content in ship fuel.

Hydrogen, as an energy source with high energy content, is now receiving attention as an environmentally friendly alternative fuel. When used, hydrogen only produces water vapor (H2O) as the final product, making it a potential solution to replace fossil fuels in the shipping sector.

In Indonesia, the development of hydrogen use as an energy source is currently dominated by PT. PLN, where there are currently 21 Green Hydrogen Power Plants spread throughout Indonesia which are currently used as coolants for power plant generators, and it is hoped that they can be utilized for other purposes, one of which is related to the potential of hydrogen as a fuel. The development of hydrogen as a ship fuel not only supports environmental preservation and the sustainability of the shipping industry but also opens new business opportunities. PT. Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (BKI) has an important role in this transition, through the development of safety standards, technology testing, and certification of hydrogen-fueled ships.

Purpose of recommendation:
To provide recommendations to the regulations and applications development team regarding the development of guidelines for the use of hydrogen as an alternative fuel on ships.

**Content of Recommendation**
The following are the things that need to be considered in the use of hydrogen as a fuel: Hydrogen is very possible as an alternative fuel, viewed from safety robustness, technology robustness, and resource availability.

However, several things need to be a safety focus, among them are:

The flammable nature of hydrogen with low ignition energy causes a high risk of fire and explosion, thus requiring gas detectors, good ventilation, and special firefighting systems.

title: Potential use of hydrogen as one of the alternative fuels in Indonesia
text:
Potential use of hydrogen as one of the alternative fuels in Indonesia

The flammable nature of hydrogen with low ignition energy causes a high risk of fire and explosion, thus requiring gas detectors, good ventilation, and special firefighting systems.

High combustion speed increases the risk of detonation, thus requiring a pressure relief system and special attention to the hydrogen storage and distribution system from damage due to high pressure, heat, and mechanical impacts that may occur due to leaks or explosions...

The low boiling point of liquid hydrogen can clog pipes with contaminants, thus requiring thermal insulation and the design of a routine cleaning system.

Hydrogen embrittlement in materials requires the use of hydrogen-resistant materials such as special alloys.

High-pressure release risks causing spontaneous ignition, thus requiring double piping and pressure control.

Accumulation in enclosed spaces increases the risk of explosion, thus requiring optimal ventilation and strategic gas detectors.

Extreme cooling due to LH2 leakage can cause structural damage, thus a thermal insulation system and real-time temperature monitoring are needed.

The risk of asphyxia due to leakage requires monitoring of oxygen levels and hydrogen leakage alarms.

These guidelines can refer to the Guidelines for Using Gas or other low flash point fuels, with some specific additions for hydrogen fuel.

The following is a proposed outline for the Guidelines for using hydrogen as fuel:

Sec. 3. General

Scope of Guidelines

Discusses the scope of the use of guidelines for new constructions as well as existing ships.

Definitions

The use of terms in the guidelines can be made in this sub-section; if there are not too many terms then this sub-section can be omitted.

Notations

For Notations, it is divided based on the levels that can be achieved by the shipowner; this aims for the shipowner to be able to meet the requirements of the guidelines.

With the proposed notation:

LFF+SF/DF/FC/+Hydrogen+Lv.

The Level is measured based on readiness.

Lv.1: Drawing/Design Approval

Lv. 2: Materials and Components of hydrogen-fueled ships

Lv. 3: Installation on hydrogen-fueled ships

Plans and Data to be Submitted

Contains a list of data required to be attached in the submission, including design plans, risk assessment, to ensure compliance with the guidelines.

References

This section lists the relevant documents, standards, and regulations that form the basis for the requirements set forth in the guidelines.

Sec. 4. Goal and Functional Requirement

Goal: Contains the purpose and benefits of the Guidelines.

Goal: Contains the purpose and benefits of the Guidelines.

Functional Requirement: This section discusses the essential functions that must be fulfilled by the hydrogen system in ship operations, ensuring compliance with safety and performance standards.

Sec. 5. Safety Assessment

Discusses the risk assessment aspects of using hydrogen fuel on ships, from hazard identification, risk analysis, to risk assessment.

Sec. 6. Ship Design and Arrangement

Provides guidelines regarding optimal design and space arrangement for hydrogen systems on board, with a focus on safety and operational efficiency which includes General Arrangement, Hydrogen Fuel Tank Location, Hydrogen Fuel Tank Storage Arrangement, Tank Connection Space, Fuel Preparation Room, Fuel Bunkering Station, Machinery Spaces, Gas valve units spaces, Bilge system, Drip Trays.

Sec. 7. Control Atmosphere

Discusses the requirements for maintaining a safe atmosphere in areas where hydrogen is present, including ventilation strategies and inerting procedures.

Sec. 8. Materials and General Pipe Design

Explains material specifications suitable for hydrogen service as well as general design principles for piping systems to ensure safety and reliability.

Sec. 9. Bunkering

Provides guidelines on safe bunkering practices, detailing procedures for transferring hydrogen fuel to the ship by minimizing the risk of leaks or accidents.

Sec. 10. Fuel Containment System

Provides requirements for designing an effective fuel containment system to prevent leaks and ensure the safe storage of hydrogen on board.

Sec. 11. Venting and Pressure Relief System

Explains the requirements for ventilation systems and pressure relief mechanisms to safely manage excess pressure in hydrogen storage tanks.

Sec. 12. Hydrogen Piping and Equipment System

Details design standards for piping systems and equipment used in the transportation of hydrogen fuel within the ship, ensuring integrity under operational conditions.

Sec. 13. Machinery, Electricity and Fire Protection

Provides guidelines related to machinery that uses hydrogen fuel, electrical systems in hazardous areas, as well as fire protection measures.

Sec. 14. Control, Monitoring and Safety System

Emphasizes the need for a robust monitoring system to detect leaks or failures in the hydrogen system, ensuring a swift response capability.

Sec. 15. Onboard Testing

This section discusses the requirements for hydrogen pipes that will be used on the ship.

Sec. 16. Survey and Certification

This section discusses the survey process required for the certification of hydrogen systems on board to ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

Sec. 17. Training, Drills and Emergency Exercises

title: OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY COMMITMENT
section_path: ESG > Social > Occupational Health and Safety Commitment: OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY COMMITMENT
text:
OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY COMMITMENT > ESG > Social > Occupational Health and Safety Commitment: OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY COMMITMENT

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) places occupational health and safety (OHS/K3) as one of its top priorities in carrying out its operational activities. The nature of the Company's activities, which cover classification services, inspection, and technical assignments across various work locations, presents differing hazard profiles and risk levels. Therefore, OHS management is implemented as an integral part of the business process to protect employees, non-employee workers whose work and/or workplace is under the Company's control, as well as other parties who may be affected by the Company's activities. Environmental aspects and impacts are managed within the framework of Occupational Health, Safety, and Environmental Protection (K3LL) to support the protection of assets, the environment, and operational continuity.

This commitment is set out in the Occupational Health, Safety, and Environmental Protection Policy, which is established and signed by the President Director. This policy serves as a framework for the Company to comply with laws, regulations, and other requirements; provide safe and healthy working conditions; eliminate hazards and reduce OHS risks; prevent work-related injuries and illnesses; control environmental aspects and impacts; ensure the consultation and participation of workers and/or their representatives; and continually improve the performance of the K3LL management system.

In the 2025 reporting period, the implementation of this policy referred to Law Number 1 of 1970 on Occupational Safety, Government Regulation Number 50 of 2012 on the Implementation of the Occupational Health and Safety Management System, ISO 45001:2018, and ISO 14001:2015, as well as other provisions relevant to the Company's activities. These requirements are internalized into BKI's HSE Manual and elaborated through policies, procedures, work programs, and operational controls tailored to the risk profile of each activity and work location.

The implementation of the Occupational Health and Safety Management System (SMK3) is carried out through policy setting, OHS planning, plan implementation, performance monitoring and evaluation, as well as continuous review and improvement. Its implementation covers hazard identification and risk assessment, operational control, competency development, emergency preparedness and response, incident reporting and investigation, internal inspection, performance monitoring, internal audit, and management review. Risk control is carried out following the control hierarchy, namely elimination, substitution, engineering controls, administrative controls, and the use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as the final layer of control.

title: OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY COMMITMENT

text:
OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY COMMITMENT > ESG > Social > Occupational Health and Safety Commitment: OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY COMMITMENT

As a forum for worker consultation and participation, PT BKI (Persero) has established an Occupational Health and Safety Committee (P2K3), which was approved through Decree of the Head of the Manpower, Transmigration, and Energy Office of DKI Jakarta Province Number 738 of 2024. The P2K3 is chaired by the President Director, with its membership structured as stipulated in that decree. The P2K3 functions as a cooperation forum between management and workers to provide advice and recommendations on OHS matters, evaluate work methods and the work environment, collect and process OHS data, and recommend corrective actions. During 2025, the P2K3 prepared work programs and submitted quarterly activity reports to the manpower authority in accordance with the regulations in effect at that time.

PT BKI (Persero) has set Zero Accident as the target and direction for K3LL prevention efforts. This target covers the prevention of fatal accidents, serious work-related injuries, injuries resulting in lost workdays, occupational illnesses, property damage, and significant environmental impacts. Its achievement is monitored through both lagging and leading indicators, including data on fatalities, high-consequence work-related injuries, recordable work-related injuries, lost time injuries, occupational illnesses, K3LL inspections, HSE inductions, HSE talks/briefings, observation cards, emergency response simulations, and the completion of corrective actions.

The reporting of near-miss incidents is encouraged as a source of learning and prevention before more serious consequences arise. Therefore, the effectiveness of near-miss management is not assessed solely by the low number of reports, but also by the openness of reporting, the timeliness of investigations, the quality of root cause identification, the dissemination of lessons learned, and the completion of corrective actions.

Based on internal data collected within the Company's reporting scope, no fatalities, high-consequence work-related injuries, or recordable work-related injuries were recorded during the 2022-2025 period. The Lost Time Injury Rate (LTIR) and Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) were also reported at 0, in accordance with the calculation methodology used by the Company. These results are evaluated alongside leading indicators to ensure that the zero figures achieved are supported by the quality of reporting, the effectiveness of risk controls, and follow-up on every finding and unsafe condition.

It also sets the “Zero Accident / Nol Kecelakaan” K3LL prevention target and explains monitoring via lagging and leading indicators, with results reported as zero LTIR/LTIFR for 2022–2025.

text:
OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY COMMITMENT > ESG > Social > Occupational Health and Safety Commitment: OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY COMMITMENT

The commitment to continuous improvement is further demonstrated through the external certification audit for ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018, conducted on 31 October 2024 by an audit team from the British Standards Institution (BSI). The audit results showed that the Company had satisfactorily met the requirements, although several minor findings were identified and followed up as part of the continuous improvement of the environmental and OHS management systems.

The Company's OHS commitment is also reflected in the implementation of HSE inductions and HSE talks/briefings, firefighting training, First Aid (P3K), confined space entry, emergency response simulations, K3LL inspections, management walkthroughs, K3LL consultations, and the sharing of lessons learned. These programs are carried out according to competency needs and the level of job risk, to strengthen awareness, preparedness, and safe work behavior.

Through a clear policy, a structured management system, worker participation, tiered risk controls, performance monitoring, and independent verification, PT BKI (Persero) continues to strengthen its K3LL culture and ensure that the results of inspections, observations, near misses, incidents, and audits are translated into corrective actions. In this way, OHS is positioned not merely as an administrative obligation, but as part of decision-making and shared responsibility in every business process of the Company.

title: KOMITMEN KESELAMATAN DAN KESEHATAN KERJA
section_path: ESG > Social > Komitmen Kesehatan & Keselamatan Kerja: KOMITMEN KESELAMATAN DAN KESEHATAN KERJA
text:
KOMITMEN KESELAMATAN DAN KESEHATAN KERJA > ESG > Social > Komitmen Kesehatan & Keselamatan Kerja: KOMITMEN KESELAMATAN DAN KESEHATAN KERJA

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) menempatkan Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3) sebagai salah satu prioritas utama dalam menjalankan kegiatan operasional. Sifat kegiatan Perusahaan yang mencakup jasa klasifikasi, inspeksi, dan penugasan teknis di berbagai lokasi kerja memiliki profil bahaya dan tingkat risiko yang berbeda. Oleh karena itu, pengelolaan K3 dilaksanakan sebagai bagian integral dari proses bisnis untuk melindungi karyawan, pekerja bukan karyawan yang pekerjaan dan/atau tempat kerjanya berada dalam kendali Perusahaan, serta pihak lain yang dapat terdampak oleh aktivitas Perusahaan. Aspek dan dampak lingkungan dikelola dalam kerangka Keselamatan, Kesehatan Kerja, dan Lindung Lingkungan (K3LL) guna mendukung perlindungan aset, lingkungan, dan keberlangsungan operasional.

Komitmen tersebut dituangkan dalam Kebijakan Keselamatan, Kesehatan Kerja, dan Lindung Lingkungan yang ditetapkan dan ditandatangani oleh Direktur Utama. Kebijakan ini menjadi kerangka bagi Perusahaan untuk memenuhi peraturan perundang-undangan dan persyaratan lainnya; menyediakan kondisi kerja yang aman dan sehat; menghilangkan bahaya dan mengurangi risiko K3; mencegah cedera dan penyakit akibat kerja; mengendalikan aspek dan dampak lingkungan; memastikan konsultasi dan partisipasi pekerja dan/atau perwakilannya; serta meningkatkan kinerja sistem manajemen K3LL secara berkelanjutan.

Pada periode pelaporan tahun 2025, penerapan kebijakan tersebut mengacu pada Undang-Undang Nomor 1 Tahun 1970 tentang Keselamatan Kerja, Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 50 Tahun 2012 tentang Penerapan Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja, ISO 45001:2018, dan ISO 14001:2015, serta ketentuan lain yang relevan dengan kegiatan Perusahaan. Persyaratan tersebut diinternalisasikan ke dalam Manual HSE BKI dan dijabarkan melalui kebijakan, prosedur, program kerja, serta pengendalian operasional sesuai dengan profil risiko masing-masing aktivitas dan lokasi kerja.

Penerapan Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (SMK3) dilaksanakan melalui penetapan kebijakan, perencanaan K3, pelaksanaan rencana, pemantauan dan evaluasi kinerja, serta peninjauan dan peningkatan berkelanjutan. text:
KOMITMEN KESELAMATAN DAN KESEHATAN KERJA > ESG > Social > Komitmen Kesehatan & Keselamatan Kerja: KOMITMEN KESELAMATAN DAN KESEHATAN KERJA

PT BKI (Persero) menetapkan Zero Accident sebagai sasaran dan arah pencegahan K3LL. Sasaran tersebut mencakup pencegahan kecelakaan fatal, cedera kerja berdampak serius, cedera yang menyebabkan kehilangan waktu kerja, penyakit akibat kerja, kerusakan properti, dan dampak lingkungan yang signifikan. Pencapaiannya dipantau melalui indikator hasil maupun indikator pencegahan, antara lain data fatality, high-consequence work-related injury, recordable work-related injury, lost time injury, penyakit akibat kerja, inspeksi K3LL, HSE induction, HSE talk/briefing, kartu observasi, pelaksanaan simulasi tanggap darurat, serta penyelesaian tindakan korektif.

Pelaporan kejadian nyaris celaka atau near miss didorong sebagai sumber pembelajaran dan pencegahan sebelum timbul konsekuensi yang lebih serius. Oleh karena itu, efektivitas pengelolaan near miss tidak semata-mata dinilai dari rendahnya jumlah laporan, tetapi juga dari keterbukaan pelaporan, ketepatan waktu investigasi, kualitas identifikasi akar penyebab, penyebarluasan lesson learned, dan penyelesaian tindakan korektif.

Berdasarkan data internal yang dihimpun dalam cakupan pelaporan Perusahaan, sepanjang periode 2022–2025 tidak tercatat fatality, high-consequence work-related injury, maupun recordable work-related injury. Nilai Lost Time Injury Rate (LTIR) dan Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) juga dilaporkan sebesar 0 sesuai dengan metodologi perhitungan yang digunakan Perusahaan. Hasil tersebut dievaluasi bersama indikator pencegahan untuk memastikan bahwa pencapaian angka nihil didukung oleh kualitas pelaporan, efektivitas pengendalian risiko, dan tindak lanjut atas setiap temuan maupun kondisi tidak aman.

Komitmen terhadap perbaikan berkelanjutan turut dibuktikan melalui audit eksternal sertifikasi ISO 14001:2015 dan ISO 45001:2018 yang dilaksanakan pada 31 Oktober 2024 oleh tim auditor British Standards Institution (BSI). Hasil audit menunjukkan bahwa Perusahaan telah memenuhi persyaratan dengan baik, meskipun terdapat beberapa temuan minor yang ditindaklanjuti sebagai bagian dari peningkatan berkelanjutan sistem manajemen lingkungan dan K3.

Disebutkan bahwa pada periode **2022–2025** tidak terdapat fatality atau recordable injury, serta audit eksternal **ISO 45001:2018** dan **ISO 14001:2015** oleh **British Standards Institution (BSI)** pada **31 Oktober 2024**, dengan temuan minor yang ditindaklanjuti.

title: DATA PRIVACY PROTECTION
section_path: ESG > Social > Data Privacy Protection: DATA PRIVACY PROTECTION > Availability of Opt-Out Options
text:
DATA PRIVACY PROTECTION > ESG > Social > Data Privacy Protection: DATA PRIVACY PROTECTION > Availability of Opt-Out Options

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) has a Privacy Notice published on the Company's official channels as a form of transparency in the management of personal data of service users. The initiative is in line with Law No. 27 of 2022 concerning Personal Data Protection (PDP Law) and other related statutory provisions. The explanation regarding customer privacy information is set out as follows:

PT BKI (Persero) transparently details the categories and types of personal data processed, covering personal profile identification data (full name, National ID Number/NIK, Tax ID Number/NPWP, biometric data, photograph, and signature), correspondence data (address, email, phone number, emergency contact), education and employment data, family data, financial data, digital activity data (geolocation, IP address, activity on applications), as well as other personal data such as health information and communication preferences. This data is obtained either directly from users, from the results of interaction with service use, cooperation with business partners, or through cookies and official correspondence.

The use of personal data by PT BKI (Persero) is directed toward various purposes disclosed explicitly, among others the provision and development of services, profiling and scoring activities for automated decision-making, marketing purposes, the conduct of business operations including consultation with professional advisors and external auditors, fulfillment of the know-your-customer principle and risk mitigation, compliance with legal obligations and reporting to regulators, as well as research and statistical analysis.

PT BKI (Persero) grants users the right to object to the use of data for direct marketing as well as processing based on other legitimate interests, and the right to restrict data processing proportionally where relevant. However, the controls available are general in nature, submitted through a request to the Company's official channels, and do not yet cover granular preference mechanisms (such as direct settings by the user over the specific type of data collected or its retention period).

The Company provides a consent withdrawal (opt-out) option specifically for direct marketing, whether through electronic or non-electronic media, which can be submitted through the official channels listed in the Contact Us section. Upon such a withdrawal request, the Company will provide confirmation of receipt and stop the processing of data for the intended purpose.

It describes categories of personal data and processing purposes (including profiling/scoring) and the right to object/restrict direct marketing, using “Contact Us / Hubungi Kami” as the channel, including opt-out withdrawal confirmation.

title: DATA PRIVACY PROTECTION
section_path: ESG > Social > Data Privacy Protection: DATA PRIVACY PROTECTION > Protection of Information
text:
DATA PRIVACY PROTECTION > ESG > Social > Data Privacy Protection: DATA PRIVACY PROTECTION > Protection of Information

PT BKI (Persero) affirms that marketing messages will only be sent if the user has agreed to be contacted through electronic or non-electronic means, reflecting the application of the opt-in principle for marketing activities. In addition, consent is also one of several bases for personal data processing recognized by the Company, alongside other processing bases such as the performance of an agreement and legal obligation.

Users have the right to obtain access to and request a copy of their personal data, including in a commonly used format or one readable by electronic systems, with the possibility of a reasonable fee being charged by the Company to fulfill such a request.

Requests for Data Transfer to Other Service Providers The user's right to obtain data in a format readable by electronic systems also opens up the possibility of data portability, although the Privacy Notice has not yet explicitly mentioned a mechanism or procedure for the direct transfer of user data to other third-party service providers.

PT BKI (Persero) grants users the right to request correction of inaccurate data, to complete incomplete personal data, and to update their personal data, with the exception where such a change would potentially violate applicable statutory provisions.

Users are entitled to request the cessation of processing, deletion, and/or destruction of their personal data if such data is no longer needed for the established purpose or has no other legal basis for processing. Upon such a request, the Company will provide confirmation of receipt as well as confirmation once the deletion/destruction process has been completed.

PT BKI (Persero) stores users' personal data for as long as the user remains a customer or user of the Company's services, and thereafter it is stored for 5 (five) years after the end of the relationship with the user, or longer if required by applicable statutory provisions.

The Company implements procedures and electronic systems with an adequate level of security in accordance with applicable provisions, including restricting access to personal data only to authorized parties based on the need-to-know principle, a dedicated unit handling the protection of personal data security, as well as additional security requirements such as a login password, transaction MPIN, and/or biometric access before users can access the service.

Presiden Komisaris

Komisaris

Irmawaty Habie, S.H.

Komisaris

Irmawaty Habie, S.H., is a legal professional with experience in Notarial Law, Land Deeds (PPAT), and Corporate Legal Compliance.

She currently works as a Notary and Land Deed Official (PPAT), drafting, validating, and registering legal documents, facilitating property transactions, and providing civil, contract, and property legal consultations.

Her career spans over three decades, including serving as a Resource Assistant for the World Bank from 1997 to 2000, where she assisted in the preparation and evaluation of development projects funded by the Government of Indonesia.

She also served as the Manager of Human Resources Development and General Affairs at PT. Nayaka Realtindo.

Irmawaty has a strong academic background, having completed the Notarial and Land Law Specialist Program from the University of Indonesia after earning her Bachelor of Laws (S.H.) from Hasanuddin University.

She has demonstrated strong organizational leadership as Head of Inter-Institutional Relations for the Indonesian Muslim Notaries Association (since 2017), previously serving as Deputy Head (2015–2018), and holding various vice chair positions in university and student representative councils.

Juriadi, S.Pd.

Komisaris

Juriadi, S.Pd., is a highly experienced community development and consulting professional who currently serves as the Director of CV. Adi Karya Konsultan (since 2022).

His career includes over a decade of intensive experience as a City Coordinator for major national community empowerment and urban development programs.

He led the KOTAKU (City Without Slums Program) in Deli Serdang from 2016 to 2022 and the PNPM Mandiri Perkotaan program across Medan and Tanjung Balai from 2008 to 2016.

Juriadi is certified as a Training of Trainer (TOT) for both PNPM MP and KOTAKU national programs, bringing expert knowledge in handling urban slum areas.

Academically, he holds a Master’s degree (S2) in Economics from Universitas Islam Sumatera Utara (UISU).

Komisaris Independen

He possesses a deep understanding of Indonesia's public procurement regulations (LKPP) and holds formal certification from Bappenas.

He is skilled in developing ISO 9001 and LKPP-compliant standard operating procedures.

His career highlights include significant tenures at PT. INDOSAT and PT. Satelindo, where he progressed from procurement staff to managerial roles.
