title: BKI Advances Risk-Based Ship Classification to Strengthen Maritime Safety
text:
BKI Advances Risk-Based Ship Classification to Strengthen Maritime Safety

BKI held a workshop to launch its Risk Assessment Guidelines, advancing a risk-based ship classification system supported by the Dewaruci RBA digital platform to enhance Indonesia’s maritime safety and efficiency.

Jakarta, October 29, 2025 — In a continued effort to enhance maritime safety and efficiency, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) or BKI organized a workshop titled “Implementation Strategy for BKI Risk Assessment Guidelines” on October 28–29, 2025, at its Head Office in Jakarta.![DSC06362.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_06362_6e7571f5d8.JPG)
![DSC06370.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_06370_d4e3db947f.JPG)
![DSC06548.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_06548_2239225e78.JPG)
The two-day workshop, hosted by BKI’s Classification and Statutory Research and Development Division, featured maritime safety experts from the Sepuluh Nopember Institute of Technology (ITS) Surabaya and marked a key step in BKI’s transition toward a modern, risk-based ship classification system.

As Indonesia’s national classification society, BKI plays a central role in ensuring that all vessels meet national and international safety and seaworthiness standards. During the workshop, BKI introduced its Risk Assessment Guidelines (Part 8, Vol. A) — a new framework designed for vessels and floating structures operating in domestic waters, including rivers and lakes. The guidelines emphasize a risk-based approach that enables early identification of potential hazards throughout a vessel’s operational life, allowing for timely and effective preventive actions.

The session also featured the introduction of Dewaruci Risk-Based Assessment (RBA), a digital tool developed by BKI to support shipowners and surveyors in identifying, evaluating, and managing operational risks. The platform enhances the transparency and accuracy of assessments while ensuring that all documentation is recorded digitally.

Around 80 participants from across BKI’s internal divisions took part in the workshop, including representatives from Survey, Design Approval, Business Research and Development, and the Risk Assessment Working Group.
The event was attended by Arief Budi Permana, Director of Classification Business Operations, and Arief Nurtjahjo, Deputy Director of Nusantara Classification Business.

Speakers included:

- Prof. Dr. Ketut Buda Artana, S.T., M.Sc., Department of Marine Engineering, ITS – “Philosophy of Ship Safety Risk Assessment.”

- Dr. Eng. Fadilla Indrayuni Prastyasari, M.Sc., Department of Marine Engineering, ITS – “Familiarization of Risk Assessment Guidelines: Academic Perspective.”

- Sukron Makmun, S.T., M.T., Senior Manager of National Regulation Development and Applications, BKI – “Familiarization of BKI Risk Assessment Guidelines: BKI’s Perspective.”

- M. Irfan, S.T., M.T., together with Dewaruci RBA application vendor – “Socialization and Implementation of the Dewaruci RBA Application.”

The workshop aimed to deepen participants’ understanding of maritime risk assessment concepts and align perspectives across divisions to ensure the effective adoption of risk-based ship classification practices.

The introduction of risk-based classification and digital assessment tools reflects BKI’s broader digital transformation agenda in maritime services. This initiative supports national efforts to promote safe, efficient, and sustainable sea transport while enhancing the global competitiveness of Indonesia’s shipping industry.
Through these developments, BKI reaffirms its commitment to accelerating ship classification processes, improving transparency in technical decision-making, and fostering a stronger safety culture across the maritime sector.

BKI held a workshop to launch its Risk Assessment Guidelines, advancing a risk-based ship classification system supported by the Dewaruci RBA digital platform to enhance Indonesia’s maritime safety and efficiency.

Jakarta, October 29, 2025 — In a continued effort to enhance maritime safety and efficiency, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) or BKI organized a workshop titled “Implementation Strategy for BKI Risk Assessment Guidelines” on October 28–29, 2025, at its Head Office in Jakarta.![DSC06362.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_06362_6e7571f5d8.JPG)
![DSC06370.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_06370_d4e3db947f.JPG)

The two-day workshop, hosted by BKI’s Classification and Statutory Research and Development Division, featured maritime safety experts from the Sepuluh Nopember Institute of Technology (ITS) Surabaya and marked a key step in BKI’s transition toward a modern, risk-based ship classification system.

As Indonesia’s national classification society, BKI plays a central role in ensuring that all vessels meet national and international safety and seaworthiness standards. During the workshop, BKI introduced its Risk Assessment Guidelines (Part 8, Vol. A) — a new framework designed for vessels and floating structures operating in domestic waters, including rivers and lakes. The guidelines emphasize a risk-based approach that enables early identification of potential hazards throughout a vessel’s operational life, allowing for timely and effective preventive actions.

The session also featured the introduction of Dewaruci Risk-Based Assessment (RBA), a digital tool developed by BKI to support shipowners and surveyors in identifying, evaluating, and managing operational risks. The platform enhances the transparency and accuracy of assessments while ensuring that all documentation is recorded digitally.

Around 80 participants from across BKI’s internal divisions took part in the workshop, including representatives from Survey, Design Approval, Business Research and Development, and the Risk Assessment Working Group.
The event was attended by Arief Budi Permana, Director of Classification Business Operations, and Arief Nurtjahjo, Deputy Director of Nusantara Classification Business.

- Prof. Dr. Ketut Buda Artana, S.T., M.Sc., Department of Marine Engineering, ITS – “Philosophy of Ship Safety Risk Assessment.”

This initiative supports national efforts to promote safe, efficient, and sustainable sea transport while enhancing the global competitiveness of Indonesia’s shipping industry.
Through these developments, BKI reaffirms its commitment to accelerating ship classification processes, improving transparency in technical decision-making, and fostering a stronger safety culture across the maritime sector.

title: IDSurvey Group Berangkatkan 1.400 Pemudik ke 10 Kota dalam Program Mudik Bersama 2026
text:
IDSurvey Group Berangkatkan 1.400 Pemudik ke 10 Kota dalam Program Mudik Bersama 2026

BKI sebagai bagian dari IDSurvey berpartisipasi dalam Program Mudik Bersama BUMN sebagai bagian dari komitmen perusahaan dalam menjalankan program Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan (TJSL) serta memberikan manfaat nyata bagi masyarakat.

Jakarta, 17 Maret 2026 – IDSurvey bersama tiga entitas usahanya, yakni PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia, PT Sucofindo, dan PT Surveyor Indonesia, terus berpartisipasi aktif dari tahun ke tahun dalam Program Mudik Bersama BUMN sebagai bagian dari komitmen perusahaan dalam menjalankan program Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan (TJSL) serta memberikan manfaat nyata bagi masyarakat.

Program Mudik Bersama BUMN merupakan inisiatif strategis yang diselenggarakan secara kolaboratif oleh BUMN bersama berbagai pemangku kepentingan guna menghadirkan perjalanan mudik yang aman, nyaman, dan terjangkau bagi masyarakat. Pada tahun 2026, program ini menargetkan pengangkutan lebih dari 100.000 pemudik ke berbagai daerah di Indonesia melalui moda transportasi bus, kereta api, dan kapal laut.

![DSC00377.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_00377_7f9ee57236.JPG)
![DSC00407.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_00407_a4eb1b2b7f.JPG)

Penyelenggaraan tahun ini juga didukung oleh inovasi berupa integrasi basis data pemudik lintas BUMN dan Kementerian Perhubungan menggunakan single data NIK, guna mencegah pendaftaran ganda sekaligus meningkatkan akurasi data peserta. Melalui integrasi tersebut, program diharapkan dapat berjalan lebih efektif, tepat sasaran, dan tetap mengedepankan aspek keselamatan, kenyamanan, serta efisiensi pengelolaan sumber daya negara.

Dalam pelaksanaan Program Mudik Bersama 2026, IDSurvey Group menargetkan 1.400 peserta mudik yang berasal dari berbagai lapisan masyarakat. Peserta program ini meliputi masyarakat umum, masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasional perusahaan, serta para frontliners IDSurvey seperti petugas keamanan, resepsionis, petugas kebersihan, dan pengemudi.

title: IDSurvey Group Berangkatkan 1.400 Pemudik ke 10 Kota dalam Program Mudik Bersama 2026
text:
IDSurvey Group Berangkatkan 1.400 Pemudik ke 10 Kota dalam Program Mudik Bersama 2026

Untuk mendukung kelancaran perjalanan, IDSurvey Group menyediakan 22 armada bus serta layanan kereta api dengan sejumlah tujuan kota di berbagai wilayah Indonesia. Moda transportasi bus melayani sepuluh kota tujuan, yaitu Semarang, Yogyakarta (via selatan), Yogyakarta (via Pantura), Wonogiri, Solo/Surakarta, Surabaya, Malang, Lampung, Palembang, dan Padang, sementara moda kereta api melayani perjalanan menuju Surabaya.

Rangkaian keberangkatan peserta mudik dijadwalkan dimulai pada 16 Maret 2026 untuk moda kereta api dari Stasiun Pasar Senen, Jakarta, sedangkan keberangkatan bus akan dilakukan pada 17 Maret 2026 dari Ring Road Gelora Bung Karno (GBK), Senayan, Jakarta, serta dari kantor entitas IDSurvey Group.

Direktur Utama BKI, R. Benny Susanto menindaklanjuti arahan CEO IDSurvey, BKI bersama IDSurvey Group berkomitmen memberikan kontribusi sosial yang menyentuh langsung kebutuhan masyarakat. Program Mudik Bersama ini hadir untuk memberikan solusi perjalanan mudik yang aman, nyaman, dan efisien. Fokus kami adalah membantu kelancaran arus mudik nasional sekaligus memastikan masyarakat dapat berkumpul bersama keluarga di hari kemenangan dengan penuh kemudahan.

Melalui sinergi antar entitas dalam ekosistem IDSurvey Group, program ini sekaligus menjadi bagian dari upaya perusahaan dalam mengoptimalkan pengelolaan sumber daya secara berkelanjutan, meningkatkan kesejahteraan masyarakat, serta mendukung pertumbuhan ekonomi yang inklusif.

Sebagai holding BUMN jasa Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) di Indonesia, IDSurvey terus berkomitmen menghadirkan berbagai program sosial yang memberikan manfaat nyata bagi masyarakat, sekaligus memperkuat peran BUMN dalam mendukung pembangunan nasional yang berkelanjutan.

Rangkaian berangkat dimulai 16 Maret 2026 (kereta dari Stasiun Pasar Senen) dan 17 Maret 2026 (bus dari Ring Road GBK/Senayan dan kantor entitas).

title: SOLAS
section_path: Safety Construction
text:
SOLAS > Safety Construction

The International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) is the single most important international treaty concerning the safety of merchant ships. Its primary objective is to specify the minimum standards for the construction, equipment, and operation of ships, compatible with their safety.

As a fully authorized Recognized Organization (RO) for numerous Flag Administrations, BKI provides the comprehensive statutory services required to ensure your vessels comply with every applicable SOLAS requirement. Our expert surveyors and technical staff are dedicated to upholding these critical safety standards, protecting your crew, your cargo, and your assets.

A Commitment to the Safety of Life at Sea

Partner with BKI to embed SOLAS-grade safety into every voyage—from shore-based systems to shipboard realities.

BKI audits both shoreside SMS and onboard implementation, leading to the issuance of the Document of Compliance (DOC) and Safety Management Certificate (SMC).

Approval of the Ship Security Plan (SSP) and onboard audits to verify implementation, culminating in the International Ship Security Certificate (ISSC).

Review and approval for vessels carrying noxious liquid substances, covering cargo handling and tank cleaning procedures.

Effective safety goes beyond hardware. It requires robust management systems to ensure a culture of safety and security is practiced every day.

Full-spectrum onboard surveys certifying construction, equipment, and communication systems against SOLAS standards.

Ensuring the safety of your cargo is just as important as the safety of your ship. We certify safe loading and transport across cargo types.

Expert review and approval for specialized vessels and complex operations.

Note on Cargo Ship Certification:

Fitness-for-purpose verification for vessels carrying solid bulk cargoes with the required documentation.

Certification under the Code of Safety for OSVs, aligning unique design and equipment with demanding operations.

Inspection of GMDSS-compliant radio installations and issuance of the Safety Radio Certificate.

Review and approval of STS plans for oil tankers—critical for preventing spills and accidents during transfers.

Full certification under the International Convention on Load Lines (ICLL), preventing overloading and safeguarding stability.

For cargo ships, the Safety Construction, Safety Equipment, and Safety Radio requirements are often combined into a single Cargo Ship Safety Certificate. BKI is fully authorized to conduct the integrated surveys required to issue this comprehensive certificate.

Comprehensive verification of passenger ship compliance with all relevant SOLAS requirements.

Surveys against construction and equipment requirements for packaged dangerous goods; issuance of a Document of Compliance.

Certification of lifesaving appliances and fire-fighting systems through detailed readiness and condition surveys.

Surveys of hull, machinery, and equipment to verify compliance with SOLAS construction standards; issuance of the Safety Construction Certificate.

title: BKI Accelerates Transformation to Strengthen Competitiveness and Global Expansion with IDSurvey in the Danantara Era
text:
BKI Accelerates Transformation to Strengthen Competitiveness and Global Expansion with IDSurvey in the Danantara Era

BKI is accelerating its business transformation through stronger governance, strategic initiatives, and closer collaboration with IDSurvey to enhance competitiveness in the Danantara era.

JAKARTA — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) is accelerating its business transformation to strengthen competitiveness and drive sustainable growth as Indonesia's State-Owned Enterprise (SOE) ecosystem evolves under the Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara (Danantara). The company is advancing this transformation through stronger governance, strategic alignment, and the execution of priority initiatives designed to create long-term value.

As a member of the IDSurvey Group, BKI has already undertaken a range of transformation initiatives to enhance its technical capabilities, improve service quality, and reinforce its competitive position. The establishment of Danantara provides fresh momentum to accelerate these efforts through a more integrated strategic framework.

This direction is reflected in BKI's 2026–2030 Long-Term Corporate Plan (RJPP), which aligns with IDSurvey's strategic roadmap. The plan prioritises initiatives that not only strengthen internal capabilities but also unlock new business opportunities and reinforce the company's position in both domestic and international markets.

To support these ambitions, BKI has identified three flagship strategic initiatives, or "Iconic Moves." The first is securing membership in the International Association of Classification Societies (IACS), which will enhance international recognition, strengthen technical excellence, and improve the company's competitiveness in the global classification industry.

The second initiative focuses on expanding geospatial-based services through the use of high-resolution satellite imagery, enabling BKI to diversify its business portfolio and support the growing demand for digital mapping solutions.

The third is BKI's "Go Global" strategy, which includes establishing a representative office in China to strengthen its international presence and provide closer support to customers in key global maritime markets.

Complementing these initiatives, BKI has also designated the Map Production Center (MPC) as one of its flagship programmes. The MPC supports the Indonesian Government's strategic agenda by strengthening the provision of geospatial information and mapping services that underpin national development and spatial planning.

BKI measures the success of its transformation not only by the completion of strategic programmes but also by the value they deliver to the business. To ensure effective execution, the company has strengthened its transformation governance through clearly defined Key Operational Metrics, supported by regular monitoring and evaluation of programme implementation.

Looking ahead, BKI will continue to build on the progress it has achieved by strengthening its core business, advancing technological capabilities, accelerating digital transformation, and expanding its international presence. These priorities will enable the company to respond to evolving industry demands while capturing new growth opportunities.

Backed by the strengthening of Indonesia's SOE ecosystem through Danantara and the strategic synergies within the IDSurvey Group, BKI is confident that it is well positioned to continue its transformation with a stronger foundation and clearer strategic direction. Through these efforts, the company remains committed to becoming a more agile, globally competitive organisation that delivers greater value to Indonesia's maritime industry and the broader national economy.

title: Dari Kampus ke Industri: BKI dan Universitas Pattimura Selenggarakan Pelatihan Marine Surveyor
text:
Dari Kampus ke Industri: BKI dan Universitas Pattimura Selenggarakan Pelatihan Marine Surveyor

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)/BKI bekerja sama dengan Fakultas Teknik Universitas Pattimura menyelenggarakan Pelatihan Marine Surveyor pada 19 November 2025 di Ambon sebagai upaya menjembatani dunia pendidikan dan industri maritim.

Ambon, 19 November 2025 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI bekerja sama dengan Fakultas Teknik Universitas Pattimura (Unpatti) menyelenggarakan Pelatihan Marine Surveyor sebagai upaya meningkatkan kompetensi mahasiswa dalam bidang survei kelautan dan pemeriksaan teknis maritim. Pelatihan yang berlangsung di Fakultas Teknik Unpatti ini dirancang untuk membekali peserta dengan kemampuan dasar yang relevan dengan kebutuhan dunia industri maritim

title: Dari Kampus ke Industri: BKI dan Universitas Pattimura Selenggarakan Pelatihan Marine Surveyor
text:
Dari Kampus ke Industri: BKI dan Universitas Pattimura Selenggarakan Pelatihan Marine Surveyor

Wakil Dekan Fakultas Teknik Unpatti, Nil Edwin Maitimu, S.T., M.T., menyampaikan bahwa kebutuhan tenaga terampil bersertifikat terus meningkat, terutama pada proyek-proyek industri besar, termasuk perusahaan yang beroperasi di Blok Masela. Ia menegaskan bahwa ijazah saja tidak lagi memadai untuk memenuhi tuntutan kompetensi industri.
“Yang utama adalah keahlian yang dimiliki,” tegasnya. Ia berharap pelatihan marine surveyor ini dapat membantu mahasiswa memenuhi standar kompetensi industri sekaligus memperluas peluang kerja mereka.
Dosen Bidang Keahlian Marine Engineering, Fakultas Teknik Unpatti, Novitha L. Th. Thenu, menjelaskan bahwa pelatihan ini merupakan bagian dari skema kedua Beasiswa Indonesia Emas yang diselenggarakan oleh IDSurvey Group, Holding BUMN Jasa Survei yang terdiri dari PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero), PT SUCOFINDO (Persero), dan PT Surveyor Indonesia (Persero).
Pelatihan Marine Surveyor dilaksanakan oleh BKI Academy dengan menghadirkan instruktur berpengalaman dari berbagai daerah. Kegiatan ini diikuti 20 peserta dari tiga program studi terkait, dengan materi yang mencakup testing, inspection, dan certification sebagai tiga elemen utama profesi marine surveyor.
Selain itu, peserta mendapatkan pemahaman tambahan terkait konstruksi kapal (hull construction), regulasi International Maritime Organization (IMO), serta aturan internasional lainnya di bidang perkapalan.
Pada akhir pelatihan, peserta akan memperoleh sertifikat resmi dari BKI sebagai bukti kompetensi profesional yang dapat digunakan ketika memasuki industri maritim. Sertifikat ini menjadi nilai tambah penting bagi lulusan Fakultas Teknik Unpatti dalam menghadapi persaingan tenaga kerja yang semakin ketat dan berbasis keahlian.

text:
Pemetaan Pemenuhan Kriteria Independensi Anggota Dewan Komisaris PT BKI (Persero). > ESG > Governance > Independensi Dewan Komisaris: Pemetaan Pemenuhan Kriteria Independensi Anggota Dewan Komisaris PT BKI (Persero).

Sebagai Badan Usaha Milik Negara, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) berkomitmen untuk memperkuat penerapan Good Corporate Governance (GCG), termasuk prinsip independensi dalam pelaksanaan fungsi pengawasan oleh Dewan Komisaris. Komitmen tersebut sejalan dengan Aspirasi Pemegang Saham Menteri BUMN RI melalui Surat No. S-468/MBU/09/2024 tentang Penyusunan Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Perusahaan Tahun 2025, khususnya dalam mendorong implementasi praktik ESG guna mendukung penciptaan nilai jangka panjang perusahaan.

Bagi PT BKI (Persero), independensi Dewan Komisaris menjadi landasan penting dalam memastikan bahwa pengawasan terhadap pengelolaan Perusahaan, pemberian nasihat kepada Direksi, serta proses pengambilan keputusan dilakukan secara objektif, profesional, transparan, dan bebas dari benturan kepentingan. Pemetaan ini dilakukan dengan mengacu pada ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, prinsip GCG BUMN, serta standar praktik tata kelola yang relevan. Melalui penilaian tersebut, Perusahaan dapat memastikan bahwa setiap anggota Dewan Komisaris menjalankan fungsi pengawasan secara independen, berintegritas, dan profesional. Adapun kriteria berikut menjadi dasar pemetaan pemenuhan independensi Komisaris PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero).

title: BKI dan PT PAL Indonesia Perkuat Kerja Sama Operasi dan Pengembangan Bisnis untuk Dukung Kemajuan Industri Maritim Nasional
text:
BKI dan PT PAL Indonesia Perkuat Kerja Sama Operasi dan Pengembangan Bisnis untuk Dukung Kemajuan Industri Maritim Nasional

BKI dan PT PAL Indonesia menandatangani MoU untuk memperkuat kerja sama operasi dan pengembangan bisnis, mengoptimalkan kapabilitas kedua perusahaan, serta mendukung pertumbuhan dan daya saing industri maritim nasional.

Surabaya, 5 September 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI memperkuat sinergi dengan PT PAL Indonesia melalui kerja sama di bidang operasi dan pengembangan bisnis dalam rangka mendukung kemajuan industri maritim nasional. title: BKI dan PT PAL Indonesia Perkuat Kerja Sama Operasi dan Pengembangan Bisnis untuk Dukung Kemajuan Industri Maritim Nasional
text:
BKI dan PT PAL Indonesia Perkuat Kerja Sama Operasi dan Pengembangan Bisnis untuk Dukung Kemajuan Industri Maritim Nasional

Direktur Utama BKI, R. Benny Susanto, menyampaikan bahwa kolaborasi antara BKI dan PT PAL Indonesia merupakan bagian dari upaya memperkuat peran perusahaan nasional dalam membangun industri maritim yang semakin mandiri dan berdaya saing.

“Kita ingin industri maritim Indonesia tumbuh dengan kekuatan sendiri. Karena itu, kompetensi dan kapasitas perusahaan nasional harus terus diperkuat dan dihubungkan agar dapat menciptakan nilai yang lebih besar. Bagi BKI, kerja sama dengan PT PAL merupakan langkah penting untuk mengoptimalkan potensi yang dimiliki kedua perusahaan sekaligus memberikan kontribusi terhadap kemajuan industri maritim nasional,” ujar Benny.

Direktur Utama PT PAL Indonesia, Kaharuddin Djenod juga menambahkan bahwa industri maritim Indonesia membutuhkan kolaborasi antar pelaku industri nasional. Pasalnya, industri maritim memiliki rantai nilai yang panjang dan melibatkan banyak kompetensi. Kekuatan yang kita miliki perlu dihubungkan agar menghasilkan nilai yang lebih besar. Melalui kerja sama dengan BKI, kami ingin mengoptimalkan kapabilitas masing-masing dan meningkatkan daya saing industri Indonesia, baik untuk kebutuhan nasional maupun peluang di pasar global,” tegas Kaharuddin.

Sebagai perusahaan yang memiliki peran strategis dalam ekosistem industri maritim nasional, BKI terus mendorong penguatan kolaborasi dengan berbagai pemangku kepentingan dan pelaku industri. Melalui kerja sama dengan PT PAL Indonesia, BKI berkomitmen untuk terus mengembangkan potensi bisnis dan mengoptimalkan kapabilitas perusahaan guna memberikan kontribusi yang lebih besar terhadap pertumbuhan industri maritim nasional.

Ke depan, BKI dan PT PAL Indonesia berkomitmen untuk menindaklanjuti Nota Kesepahaman melalui berbagai peluang kerja sama yang dapat dikembangkan di bidang operasi dan pengembangan bisnis. Sinergi tersebut diharapkan mampu menciptakan nilai tambah, memperluas peluang usaha, serta memperkuat kapasitas dan daya saing industri maritim nasional.

text:
SALURAN KOMUNIKASI YANG TERBUKA > ESG > Social > Kanal Komunikasi yang dapat Diakses: SALURAN KOMUNIKASI YANG TERBUKA > Proses Pengintegrasian Umpan Balik Pelanggan ke dalam Pengembangan Produk dan Layanan

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) berkomitmen untuk membangun hubungan yang responsif dan transparan dengan pelanggan melalui penyediaan berbagai kanal komunikasi yang mudah diakses, guna memastikan setiap masukan, pertanyaan, maupun keluhan pelanggan dapat diterima, ditindaklanjuti, dan diselesaikan secara tepat waktu. Komitmen tersebut ditunjukkan melalui beberapa inisiatif sebagai berikut:

Sebagai wujud keterbukaan dalam menerima umpan balik pelanggan, PT BKI (Persero) menyediakan alamat surat elektronik (email) khusus yang dapat digunakan pelanggan untuk menyampaikan masukan maupun keluhan kepada Perusahaan. Selain itu, Perusahaan juga menyediakan saluran telepon khusus (dedicated phone line) untuk memastikan setiap masukan pelanggan dapat diterima dan ditindaklanjuti oleh tim kerja terkait secara langsung. Bagi pelanggan yang membutuhkan layanan tatap muka, PT BKI (Persero) turut menyediakan layanan pelanggan secara langsung (in-person) di Kantor Pusat, di mana setiap pertanyaan akan dijawab langsung oleh divisi terkait sesuai dengan kebutuhan customer.

Untuk memastikan umpan balik pelanggan benar-benar dimanfaatkan sebagai bahan perbaikan berkelanjutan, PT BKI (Persero) secara rutin melaksanakan survei kepuasan pelanggan guna menangkap persepsi, pengalaman, dan tingkat kepuasan atas layanan yang diberikan. Hasil survei ini menjadi instrumen evaluasi layanan yang digunakan untuk mengidentifikasi area perbaikan dalam perencanaan dan pengembangan layanan Perusahaan ke depan.

Setiap keluhan yang disampaikan pelanggan kepada PT BKI (Persero), baik melalui korespondensi resmi, email, maupun telepon. Seluruh keluhan akan dicatat, diverifikasi, dan ditindaklanjuti melalui proses verifikasi awal untuk memastikan penanganan yang tepat. Mekanisme ini menjamin bahwa setiap laporan yang masuk mendapatkan konfirmasi penerimaan serta ditangani sesuai dengan prosedur yang berlaku.

Proses penanganan keluhan di PT BKI (Persero) dilaksanakan secara transparan. Laporan yang telah terverifikasi dan dapat langsung ditangani akan direspons oleh unit kerja penerima laporan. Sementara itu, keluhan yang memerlukan koordinasi lintas unit akan didokumentasikan melalui Customer Complaint Action Request (CCAR) dan diteruskan kepada unit kerja terkait. Sebagai bagian dari mekanisme kontrol dan evaluasi berkala, PT BKI (Persero) turut mencatat seluruh keluhan yang dilaporkan dalam Customer Complaint Log Book, guna memastikan pelanggan menerima pembaruan status penanganan keluhan secara tepat waktu.

Dalam pelaksanaannya, Direksi dan seluruh karyawan PT BKI (Persero) memikul tanggung jawab bersama untuk menjaga integritas praktik ketenagakerjaan melalui 8 (delapan) pilar utama sebagai berikut:

1. **Pengupahan yang Adil dan Setara **melalui penerapan struktur dan skala upah yang transparan, wajar, dan berkeadilan, serta memastikan kesetaraan remunerasi antara pekerja laki-laki dan perempuan tanpa adanya diskriminasi dalam penetapan kompensasi.
2. **Pengaturan Waktu Kerja yang Bertanggung Jawab** melalui pengelolaan waktu kerja dan pelaksanaan lembur yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan operasional, dengan tetap memperhatikan batas maksimum jam kerja serta ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.
3. **Pemenuhan Hak Cuti dan Keseimbangan Kehidupan Kerja** melalui pemberian hak cuti tahunan maupun cuti lainnya kepada seluruh karyawan sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku sebagai bentuk penghormatan terhadap kesejahteraan dan keseimbangan antara kehidupan profesional dan pribadi.
4. **Pengelolaan Pemutusan Hubungan Kerja yang Transparan dan Berkeadilan** melalui penerapan mekanisme pemberitahuan, konsultasi, dan proses pelaksanaan pemutusan hubungan kerja sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku, dengan tetap menjunjung prinsip transparansi, penghormatan terhadap hak pekerja, dan perlakuan yang manusiawi.
5. **Lingkungan Kerja yang Inklusif dan Bebas Diskriminasi **melalui komitmen perusahaan dalam menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang menghormati martabat manusia serta mencegah segala bentuk diskriminasi, pelecehan, maupun perlakuan tidak adil terhadap seluruh pekerja.
6. **Mekanisme Pengaduan Ketenagakerjaan yang Aman dan Terpercaya** melalui penyediaan saluran pelaporan yang dapat diakses oleh pekerja secara aman, rahasia, objektif, dan bebas dari tindakan pembalasan (retaliation) terhadap pihak yang menyampaikan laporan atau keluhan.
7. **Peningkatan Kompetensi dan Kesadaran Praktik Ketenagakerjaan yang Bertanggung Jawab **melalui pelaksanaan sosialisasi, edukasi, dan pelatihan secara berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan pemahaman seluruh karyawan terhadap hak, kewajiban, serta ketentuan ketenagakerjaan yang berlaku.
8. **Penegakan Kepatuhan dan Tindakan Korektif** melalui tindak lanjut terhadap setiap pelanggaran kebijakan ketenagakerjaan secara adil, objektif, dan profesional, termasuk penerapan tindakan korektif maupun disipliner sesuai dengan tingkat pelanggaran yang terjadi.

Entitas kunci: Direksi dan seluruh karyawan BKI, dengan angka “8 pilar” sebagai nomor referensi.

title: PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) Lanjutkan tren Positif pada 2025, Perkuat Fundamental Bisnis Bersama IDSurvey dan Danantara
text:
PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) Lanjutkan tren Positif pada 2025, Perkuat Fundamental Bisnis Bersama IDSurvey dan Danantara

BKI mencatatkan pertumbuhan kinerja keuangan yang positif di tengah penguatan transformasi dan perubahan struktur pengelolaan BUMN melalui Danantara.

Jakarta – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI mencatatkan pertumbuhan kinerja keuangan yang positif di tengah penguatan transformasi dan perubahan struktur pengelolaan Badan Usaha Milik Negara (BUMN) melalui Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara (Danantara).

Momentum ini menjadi bagian dari perjalanan transformasi BKI untuk memperkuat fundamental perusahaan, meningkatkan efisiensi operasional, serta mengoptimalkan penciptaan nilai bagi pemegang saham dan seluruh pemangku kepentingan.

Penguatan ekosistem BUMN melalui Danantara juga menjadi momentum bagi BKI untuk mempertajam fokus dan strategi bisnis sebagai entitas yang mandiri. Dengan struktur pengelolaan yang lebih fokus, BKI dapat mengarahkan sumber daya dan kapabilitasnya secara optimal guna memperkuat bisnis inti di bidang klasifikasi dan statutoria kapal. Bersamaan dengan itu, BKI juga mengembangkan peluang usaha di sektor Testing, Inspection, Certification, Consultancy, Classification, and Statutory atau TICCS.

Fokus yang semakin tajam tersebut sejalan dengan upaya BKI untuk terus meningkatkan efisiensi, produktivitas, dan kualitas layanan. Hal ini tercermin dari kinerja keuangan perusahaan sepanjang tahun 2025 yang menunjukkan pertumbuhan positif, serta kemampuan BKI dalam menjaga momentum pertumbuhan di tengah perubahan struktural dalam ekosistem BUMN.

Sepanjang 2025, BKI membukukan pendapatan sebesar Rp1,5 triliun, tumbuh 13,6% dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya sebesar Rp1,3 triliun. Dari sisi profitabilitas, laba operasi inti perusahaan meningkat 27,67% dibandingkan periode sebelumnya.

Peningkatan kinerja ini juga terlihat dari operating profit margin yang naik dari 19,44% menjadi 21,84%. Sementara itu, arus kas dari aktivitas operasi tumbuh 51,76%, yang menunjukkan semakin kuatnya kemampuan perusahaan dalam menghasilkan arus kas dari kegiatan operasional.

Sebagai entitas yang semakin fokus mengembangkan bisnis secara mandiri, BKI terus melakukan optimalisasi sumber daya dan penguatan efisiensi operasional. Rasio efisiensi kas operasional meningkat dari 15,38% menjadi 20,54%. Hal ini mencerminkan kemampuan perusahaan dalam menghasilkan nilai yang lebih tinggi dari setiap rupiah pendapatan, sekaligus memperkuat kualitas kinerja operasional.

Kinerja positif tersebut menjadi pijakan penting bagi BKI untuk melanjutkan transformasi perusahaan di bawah penguatan ekosistem BUMN melalui Danantara. Dengan fundamental bisnis yang semakin solid dan fokus usaha yang semakin tajam, BKI siap mempercepat pengembangan bisnis pada sektor-sektor strategis yang memiliki prospek pertumbuhan jangka panjang.

Ke depan, BKI akan terus memperkuat bisnis inti sekaligus menangkap peluang pertumbuhan di sektor ekonomi hijau, digitalisasi industri, dan ekspansi global. Pengalaman serta kapabilitas yang telah dibangun selama berada dalam ekosistem IDSurvey menjadi modal penting bagi BKI untuk meningkatkan daya saing dan mewujudkan pertumbuhan yang berkelanjutan.

Transformasi melalui penguatan ekosistem BUMN dan kehadiran Danantara menjadi momentum bagi BKI untuk melangkah dengan struktur yang lebih fokus, strategi yang lebih terarah, serta kapabilitas yang semakin kuat. Dengan fondasi tersebut, BKI optimistis dapat terus meningkatkan kinerja, memperluas kontribusi bagi industri nasional, dan menciptakan nilai jangka panjang bagi Indonesia.

Disebutkan BKI meraih pendapatan Rp1,5 triliun (tumbuh 13,6%), laba operasi inti naik 27,67%, operating profit margin dari 19,44% menjadi 21,84%, arus kas aktivitas operasi naik 51,76%, serta rasio efisiensi kas operasional meningkat dari 15,38% menjadi 20,54%.

title: BKI and PT PAL Indonesia Strengthen Cooperation to Advance the National Maritime Industry
text:
BKI and PT PAL Indonesia Strengthen Cooperation to Advance the National Maritime Industry

BKI and PT PAL Indonesia have signed an MoU to strengthen cooperation in operations and business development, leveraging their respective capabilities, resources, and networks.

Surabaya, September 5, 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero), or BKI, is strengthening its cooperation with PT PAL Indonesia in operations and business development to support the advancement of Indonesia’s maritime industry. The partnership was formalised through the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the two companies in Surabaya.

![2026-09-04 PENANDATANGANAN MOU DENGAN BKI (24 of 52).jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/2026_09_04_PENANDATANGANAN_MOU_DENGAN_BKI_24_of_52_759bb36f6f.jpg)

The MoU was signed by BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto and PT PAL Indonesia President Director Kaharuddin Djenod. The partnership marks a strategic step for both companies to optimise their respective capabilities and resources, particularly in strengthening operational activities and developing business opportunities that can create greater value for the national maritime industry.

Under the MoU, BKI and PT PAL Indonesia will explore opportunities to collaborate by leveraging their respective competencies, resources, networks, and business opportunities. The partnership is also expected to create new avenues for cooperation and support the development of business initiatives that contribute to the growth and competitiveness of Indonesia’s maritime industry.

BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto said the partnership forms part of BKI’s efforts to strengthen the role of national companies in building a more self-reliant and competitive maritime industry.

“We want Indonesia’s maritime industry to grow from its own strengths. To achieve this, the capabilities and capacity of national companies need to be continuously strengthened and connected to create greater value. For BKI, our partnership with PT PAL is an important step towards unlocking the potential of both companies while contributing to the advancement of the national maritime industry,” said Benny.

PT PAL Indonesia President Director Kaharuddin Djenod said collaboration among national industry players is essential to advancing Indonesia’s maritime industry, given its extensive value chain and diverse range of required competencies.

“The maritime industry encompasses a long value chain and a wide range of competencies, making collaboration among national industry players essential. By connecting our respective strengths, we can create greater value. Through this partnership with BKI, we aim to optimise our capabilities and strengthen the competitiveness of Indonesia’s maritime industry, while responding to domestic needs and pursuing opportunities in the global market,” said Kaharuddin.

As a company with a strategic role in Indonesia’s maritime industry ecosystem, BKI continues to strengthen partnerships with stakeholders and industry players. Through its cooperation with PT PAL Indonesia, BKI aims to expand business opportunities and optimise its capabilities to make a greater contribution to the growth and development of the national maritime industry.

Looking ahead, BKI and PT PAL Indonesia will follow up on the MoU by exploring and developing collaborative opportunities in operations and business development. The partnership is expected to create greater value, expand business opportunities, and strengthen the capacity and competitiveness of Indonesia’s maritime industry.

title: KOMITMEN KETENAGAKERJAAN
section_path: ESG > Social > Labour Policy: KOMITMEN KETENAGAKERJAAN > LABOUR COMMITMENT
text:
KOMITMEN KETENAGAKERJAAN > ESG > Social > Labour Policy: KOMITMEN KETENAGAKERJAAN > LABOUR COMMITMENT

As a manifestation of social responsibility and sustainable corporate governance, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) is committed to implementing labor practices that are fair, ethical, and responsible throughout its entire operational environment. This commitment affirms that every worker is entitled to working conditions that are decent, safe, equal, and free from exploitative treatment, in line with national labor law provisions as well as internationally applicable human rights standards. This policy has been signed by the President Director as a form of the Company's highest commitment to the welfare of its workforce.

In its implementation, the Board of Directors and all employees of PT BKI (Persero) bear shared responsibility for maintaining the integrity of labor practices through the following 8 (eight) main pillars:

1. **Fair and Equal Remuneration **through the implementation of a transparent, reasonable, and equitable remuneration structure and scale, while ensuring equal pay between male and female employees without any discrimination in determining compensation.

title: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC, 2006)
section_path: Our MLC Approval Services
text:
Maritime Labour Convention (MLC, 2006) > Our MLC Approval Services

- The Maritime Labour Convention (MLC, 2006), established by the International Labour Organization (ILO), is a comprehensive international standard that protects the rights and working conditions of the world's seafarers. Compliance is not only a moral and legal obligation but a commercial necessity, as Port State Control (PSC) enforces MLC standards rigorously.

- As a fully authorized Recognized Organization (RO), BKI offers end-to-end services to guide you through the two critical stages of compliance: initial approval of your plans and ongoing audits to maintain certification. Our goal is to make the process clear, efficient, and effective.

This is a standardized document issued by the ship's Flag State Administration. It outlines the national requirements and laws that implement the MLC, 2006.

This is a customized document completed by the shipowner. It details the specific measures and procedures that have been put in place on board to ensure ongoing compliance with the national requirements listed in Part I.

“BKI provides comprehensive approval and audit services to ensure your fleet meets the global standard for seafarers' rights, safeguarding both your crew and your operations.”

A full inspection is carried out to verify that the ship complies with the MLC requirements and that the measures in the DMLC Part II are being implemented. A successful audit leads to the issuance of the initial Maritime Labour Certificate.

This inspection takes place between the second and third anniversary dates of the certificate. It ensures that the standards of compliance are being maintained and remain effective.

A comprehensive audit is conducted before the expiry of the existing certificate to ensure continued compliance, allowing for the issuance of a new five-year Maritime Labour Certificate.

With an approved DMLC in place, the next step is to verify its implementation through a series of onboard audits. Successful completion leads to the issuance and maintenance of the Maritime Labour Certificate, which is valid for five years.

Audit Stage

Statutory Compliance

Partner with BKI to ensure your vessels are not just certified, but are truly safe and supportive environments for your crew, protecting your most valuable asset and securing your license to trade globally.

Before a vessel can be certified, it must have a Declaration of Maritime Labour Compliance (DMLC). This is a two-part document that forms the basis for all inspections and audits.

A BKI-approved DMLC Part II is your foundational step towards full MLC certification.

BKI's crucial role is to meticulously review and approve your DMLC Part II. Our experienced team will verify that the measures you have documented are robust and sufficient to meet the standards of the convention.

We will assess the documented procedures for all 14 key areas, including:

- Minimum age of seafarers

- Medical certification

- Seafarers' employment agreements (SEAs)

- Payment of wages

- Hours of work and rest

- Accommodation, recreational facilities, food, and catering

- On-board medical care

- Health and safety protection and accident prevention

- On-board complaint procedures

It highlights statutory compliance and approval of DMLC Part II across 14 key areas.

title: Fokus Transformasi BKI Memperkuat Daya Saing dan Ekspansi Global Bersama IDSurvey di Era Danantara
text:
Fokus Transformasi BKI Memperkuat Daya Saing dan Ekspansi Global Bersama IDSurvey di Era Danantara

BKI mempercepat transformasi bersama IDSurvey dan Danantara guna memperkuat daya saing, ekspansi global, serta pertumbuhan bisnis berkelanjutan.

JAKARTA – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI terus mempercepat transformasi bisnis dan penguatan daya saing seiring dengan penguatan ekosistem BUMN melalui Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara (Danantara). Transformasi yang telah berjalan sebelumnya kini semakin mudah untuk dijalankan melalui penyelarasan strategi, penguatan tata kelola, serta implementasi sejumlah program prioritas yang berorientasi pada pertumbuhan jangka panjang dan penciptaan nilai.

Sebagai bagian dari IDSurvey, BKI sebelumnya telah melakukan berbagai inisiatif transformasi untuk meningkatkan daya saing, memperkuat kapabilitas teknis, dan meningkatkan kualitas layanan. Kehadiran Danantara menjadi momentum untuk melanjutkan kesinambungan transformasi tersebut dengan arah strategis yang lebih terintegrasi.

Penguatan arah transformasi ini tercermin dalam penyusunan Rencana Jangka Panjang Perusahaan (RJPP) 2026–2030 yang selaras dengan strategi holding. BKI juga menetapkan sejumlah program strategis sebagai prioritas. Dengan pendekatan ini, transformasi BKI tidak hanya berfokus pada perbaikan internal, tetapi juga diarahkan untuk membuka peluang pertumbuhan baru serta memperkuat posisi perusahaan di tingkat nasional dan global.

Dalam rangka mempercepat target tersebut, BKI menjalankan tiga "Iconic Moves" strategis.
Pertama, BKI menargetkan menjadi anggota International Association of Classification Societies (IACS) untuk meningkatkan pengakuan internasional, memperkuat kapabilitas teknis, dan memperluas daya saing di pasar global. Kedua, BKI memanfaatkan teknologi citra satelit resolusi tinggi untuk mengembangkan layanan berbasis geospasial sekaligus memperluas portofolio bisnis perusahaan.
Ketiga, BKI menjalankan strategi "Go Global" dengan rencana pembukaan kantor cabang di Tiongkok sebagai langkah untuk memperluas akses pasar internasional dan memperkuat jejak BKI di pasar global.Sejalan dengan itu, BKI juga menetapkan "Map Production Center" sebagai Program Unggulan.

Program ini mendukung agenda strategis Pemerintah dalam penyediaan layanan pemetaan dan informasi geospasial untuk pembangunan nasional.Keberhasilan transformasi tidak hanya diukur dari jumlah program yang dijalankan, tetapi juga dari dampak nyata terhadap kinerja dan daya saing perusahaan. Untuk itu, BKI memperkuat tata kelola transformasi melalui penetapan Key Operational Metrics serta monitoring dan evaluasi berkala terhadap implementasi program strategis kedepan, BKI akan terus mempercepat transformasi dengan mengoptimalkan kekuatan yang telah dibangun.

Penguatan bisnis inti, pengembangan teknologi, digitalisasi proses, serta ekspansi ke pasar internasional akan menjadi pilar utama strategi perusahaan dalam menghadapi dinamika industri dan menangkap peluang pertumbuhan baru.

Dengan dukungan penguatan ekosistem BUMN melalui Danantara dan sinergi strategi bersama IDSurvey, BKI optimistis dapat melanjutkan transformasi dengan fondasi yang lebih kuat dan arah yang semakin fokus. Langkah ini menjadi bagian dari komitmen BKI untuk tumbuh sebagai perusahaan yang adaptif, kompetitif, dan mampu memberikan kontribusi lebih besar bagi industri nasional dan perekonomian Indonesia.

title: Determination of Material Sustainability Topics
section_path: ESG > Governance > Sustainability Topics: Determination of Material Sustainability Topics > Integration with Enterprise Risk Management
text:
Determination of Material Sustainability Topics > ESG > Governance > Sustainability Topics: Determination of Material Sustainability Topics > Integration with Enterprise Risk Management

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) conducts a materiality assessment as part of its commitment to ensuring that the sustainability issues managed by the Company remain relevant to business developments, stakeholder expectations, and changes in the external environment.

The material sustainability topics determination process is conducted periodically and reviewed annually to ensure the relevance of sustainability issues with the Company’s strategy, emerging risks and opportunities, and stakeholder expectations. Through this approach, PT BKI (Persero) ensures that economic, environmental, and social aspects that significantly influence the Company’s sustainability and stakeholders are identified and managed effectively.

In determining material sustainability topics, PT BKI (Persero) considers various factors, including the Company’s internal and external context, business strategy, sustainability policies, and relevant risks and opportunities associated with its operational activities.

The identification process of material sustainability topics consists of the following stages:

- Identification of internal and external contexts, including industry developments, regulations, Company strategy, and relevant sustainability issues;

- Identification of actual and potential impacts, including impacts on the Company and external stakeholders;

- Assessment of impact significance, considering the magnitude of impacts on the Company and the level of importance of issues to stakeholders;

- Prioritization of material sustainability topics based on assessment results and stakeholder inputs; and

- Review and approval by management responsible for the Company’s sustainability matters.

PT BKI (Persero) involves both internal and external stakeholders in the material sustainability topics determination process to obtain a comprehensive understanding of sustainability issues that are considered significant.

Stakeholder engagement is conducted by gathering input from various stakeholder groups, including management, employees, customers, business partners, regulators, and other relevant parties. The feedback obtained serves as one of the key considerations in determining sustainability priorities and issues requiring further attention by the Company.

The results of the material sustainability topics determination process serve as one of the considerations in managing the Company’s sustainability-related risks and opportunities. Identified material topics are used as references in understanding issues that may influence the achievement of the Company’s strategic objectives.

Through the integration of materiality assessment results with the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, PT BKI (Persero) strengthens its risk management approach by incorporating sustainability considerations into risk identification, evaluation, monitoring, and strategic decision-making processes.

This approach enables the Company to create long-term value through more comprehensive management of sustainability-related risks and opportunities while remaining aligned with stakeholder expectations.

title: BKI Sustains Strong Growth in 2025, Strengthening Business Fundamentals with IDSurvey and Danantara
text:
BKI Sustains Strong Growth in 2025, Strengthening Business Fundamentals with IDSurvey and Danantara

BKI recorded strong financial growth in 2025, driven by improved operational efficiency and strengthened business fundamentals as it advanced its corporate transformation within Indonesia's evolving SOE ecosystem under Danantara.

Jakarta, July 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) delivered strong financial performance in 2025 while advancing its corporate transformation amid the restructuring of Indonesia's State-Owned Enterprise (SOE) ecosystem through the Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara (Danantara).

The milestone marks an important phase in BKI's transformation, reinforcing its business fundamentals, improving operational efficiency, and creating greater long-term value for shareholders and stakeholders.

The strengthening of the SOE ecosystem through Danantara also provides BKI with greater strategic focus as an independent business entity. With a more streamlined governance structure, the company is sharpening its focus on its core strengths in ship classification and statutory services while expanding its capabilities across the TICCS (Testing, Inspection, Certification, Consultancy, Classification, and Statutory) sector.

This strategic direction has translated into stronger operational performance and sustained business growth throughout 2025, despite the ongoing transformation of the national SOE landscape.

For the full year, BKI recorded revenue of IDR 1.5 trillion, representing a 13.6% year-on-year increase from IDR 1.3 trillion in 2024. Core operating profit grew 27.67%, reflecting continued improvements in operational efficiency and profitability.

The company's operating profit margin also strengthened from 19.44% to 21.84%, while cash flow from operating activities increased by 51.76%, highlighting BKI's growing ability to generate healthy cash flow from its core operations.

As the company continues to strengthen its independent business development strategy, BKI has further enhanced resource utilization and operational efficiency. Its operating cash efficiency ratio improved from 15.38% to 20.54%, demonstrating greater value creation from every rupiah of revenue while reinforcing overall operational performance.

These achievements provide a solid foundation for BKI to accelerate its transformation within Indonesia's evolving SOE ecosystem. Supported by stronger business fundamentals and a sharper strategic direction, the company is well positioned to expand into high-growth sectors and capture long-term business opportunities.

Looking ahead, BKI will continue to strengthen its core business while pursuing new opportunities in the green economy, industrial digitalisation, and international markets. Drawing on the expertise and synergies developed within the IDSurvey ecosystem, the company aims to further enhance its competitiveness and deliver sustainable growth.

As Indonesia's SOE landscape continues to evolve through Danantara, BKI remains committed to advancing with a more focused organisation, a stronger strategic direction, and enhanced capabilities. Building on this momentum, the company is confident in its ability to deliver sustained business growth, contribute to national industrial development, and create lasting value for Indonesia.

BKI recorded strong financial growth in 2025, driven by improved operational efficiency and strengthened business fundamentals as it advanced its corporate transformation within Indonesia's evolving SOE ecosystem under Danantara.

Jakarta, July 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) delivered strong financial performance in 2025 while advancing its corporate transformation amid the restructuring of Indonesia's State-Owned Enterprise (SOE) ecosystem through the Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara (Danantara).

The milestone marks an important phase in BKI's transformation, reinforcing its business fundamentals, improving operational efficiency, and creating greater long-term value for shareholders and stakeholders.

The strengthening of the SOE ecosystem through Danantara also provides BKI with greater strategic focus as an independent business entity. With a more streamlined governance structure, the company is sharpening its focus on its core strengths in ship classification and statutory services while expanding its capabilities across the TICCS (Testing, Inspection, Certification, Consultancy, Classification, and Statutory) sector.

This strategic direction has translated into stronger operational performance and sustained business growth throughout 2025, despite the ongoing transformation of the national SOE landscape.

For the full year, BKI recorded revenue of IDR 1.5 trillion, representing a 13.6% year-on-year increase from IDR 1.3 trillion in 2024. Core operating profit grew 27.67%, reflecting continued improvements in operational efficiency and profitability.

The company's operating profit margin also strengthened from 19.44% to 21.84%, while cash flow from operating activities increased by 51.76%, highlighting BKI's growing ability to generate healthy cash flow from its core operations.

As the company continues to strengthen its independent business development strategy, BKI has further enhanced resource utilization and operational efficiency. Its operating cash efficiency ratio improved from 15.38% to 20.54%, demonstrating greater value creation from every rupiah of revenue while reinforcing overall operational performance.

These achievements provide a solid foundation for BKI to accelerate its transformation within Indonesia's evolving SOE ecosystem. Supported by stronger business fundamentals and a sharper strategic direction, the company is well positioned to expand into high-growth sectors and capture long-term business opportunities.

Looking ahead, BKI will continue to strengthen its core business while pursuing new opportunities in the green economy, industrial digitalisation, and international markets. Drawing on the expertise and synergies developed within the IDSurvey ecosystem, the company aims to further enhance its competitiveness and deliver sustainable growth.

As Indonesia's SOE landscape continues to evolve through Danantara, BKI remains committed to advancing with a more focused organisation, a stronger strategic direction, and enhanced capabilities. Building on this momentum, the company is confident in its ability to deliver sustained business growth, contribute to national industrial development, and create lasting value for Indonesia.

title: BKI Strengthens Industry Trust in Verifying and Certifying Indonesian Vessels
text:
BKI Strengthens Industry Trust in Verifying and Certifying Indonesian Vessels

PT BKI (Persero) strengthened its mandate as a recognized organization for surveying and certifying Indonesian-flagged vessels through a renewed cooperation agreement with the Directorate General of Sea Transportation.

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) has further strengthened its role as a trusted authority for the survey, verification, and statutory certification of Indonesian-flagged vessels following the signing of a Cooperation Agreement (Perjanjian Kerja Sama/PKS) with the Directorate General of Sea Transportation, Ministry of Transportation.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-01-13 at 11.48.35 (1).jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Whats_App_Image_2026_01_13_at_11_48_35_1_4d76962ef6.jpeg)

The agreement was signed on January 12, 2026, at the Ministry of Transportation Headquarters in Jakarta by the Director General of Sea Transportation, Muhammad Masyhud, and BKI President Director, R. Benny Susanto. The cooperation reaffirms the government’s delegation of authority to BKI to conduct inspections, testing, surveys, verification, and statutory certification of Indonesian-flagged ships in accordance with prevailing laws and international standards.
Benny Susanto emphasized BKI’s continued commitment to supporting the government in strengthening shipping safety and improving service quality across the national maritime sector. He expressed confidence that the extension of this cooperation would deliver tangible benefits for the nation, particularly in enhancing vessel safety and ensuring reliable services for all maritime stakeholders.
He also noted that the collaboration is expected to foster stronger communication and synergy among regulators, classification societies, shipowners, shipping companies, and seafarers to build a shipping safety system that is reliable, efficient, and globally competitive.
Meanwhile, Director General Muhammad Masyhud reaffirmed the Ministry of Transportation’s commitment to strengthening national maritime safety governance through professional, transparent, and accountable partnerships. He explained that in 2026, the government officially extended BKI’s mandate as a recognized organization authorized to carry out statutory surveys and certification on behalf of the state for Indonesian-flagged vessels.
Masyhud highlighted BKI’s strategic role in supporting government oversight, particularly for Indonesian ships operating on international routes. He expressed hope that this cooperation would ensure consistent compliance with international safety standards and help maintain Indonesia’s position on the Tokyo MoU White List, thereby strengthening global confidence in the country’s maritime safety regime.
The cooperation is implemented in accordance with Law No. 17 of 2008 on Shipping, which requires vessels of certain types and sizes to be classified by a recognized classification body, and aligns with the implementation of the IMO Recognized Organization (RO) Code as stipulated under Maritime Safety Committee resolutions.
Through this strengthened partnership, BKI and the Directorate General of Sea Transportation reaffirm their shared commitment to enhancing ship quality, safeguarding maritime safety, and supporting the sustainable growth of Indonesia’s shipping industry.

It highlights the signing on January 12, 2026 in Jakarta by DG Muhammad Masyhud and BKI President Director R. title: Penentuan Topik Material Keberlanjutan
section_path: ESG > Governance > Topik Materialitas: Penentuan Topik Material Keberlanjutan > Integrasi dengan Manajemen Risiko Perusahaan
text:
Penentuan Topik Material Keberlanjutan > ESG > Governance > Topik Materialitas: Penentuan Topik Material Keberlanjutan > Integrasi dengan Manajemen Risiko Perusahaan

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) melakukan penilaian materialitas sebagai bagian dari komitmen untuk memastikan bahwa isu keberlanjutan yang dikelola Perusahaan tetap relevan dengan perkembangan bisnis, ekspektasi pemangku kepentingan, serta perubahan lingkungan eksternal.

Proses penentuan topik material dilakukan secara berkala dan ditinjau secara tahunan untuk memastikan kesesuaian isu keberlanjutan dengan strategi Perusahaan, risiko dan peluang yang berkembang, serta kebutuhan pemangku kepentingan. Melalui pendekatan ini, PT BKI (Persero) memastikan bahwa aspek ekonomi, lingkungan, dan sosial yang memiliki pengaruh signifikan terhadap keberlanjutan Perusahaan maupun pemangku kepentingan dapat teridentifikasi dan dikelola secara efektif.

Dalam melakukan penentuan topik material keberlanjutan, PT BKI (Persero) mempertimbangkan berbagai faktor, termasuk konteks internal dan eksternal Perusahaan, strategi bisnis, kebijakan keberlanjutan, serta risiko dan peluang yang relevan dengan kegiatan operasional.

Proses identifikasi topik material dilakukan melalui beberapa tahapan, yaitu:

- Identifikasi konteks internal dan eksternal, termasuk perkembangan industri, regulasi, strategi Perusahaan, serta isu keberlanjutan yang relevan;

- Identifikasi dampak aktual dan potensial, baik dampak terhadap Perusahaan maupun terhadap pemangku kepentingan;

- Penilaian tingkat signifikansi dampak, dengan mempertimbangkan besarnya dampak terhadap Perusahaan serta tingkat kepentingan isu bagi pemangku kepentingan;

- Penentuan prioritas topik material berdasarkan hasil penilaian dan masukan dari pemangku kepentingan; dan

- Review dan persetujuan oleh manajemen yang bertanggung jawab terhadap aspek keberlanjutan Perusahaan.

PT BKI (Persero) melibatkan pemangku kepentingan internal maupun eksternal dalam proses penentuan topik material untuk memperoleh pemahaman yang komprehensif mengenai isu-isu keberlanjutan yang memiliki tingkat kepentingan tinggi.

Pelibatan tersebut dilakukan melalui pengumpulan masukan dari berbagai kelompok pemangku kepentingan, termasuk manajemen, karyawan, pelanggan, mitra kerja, regulator, dan pihak terkait lainnya. Masukan yang diperoleh menjadi salah satu dasar dalam menentukan prioritas isu keberlanjutan yang perlu menjadi perhatian Perusahaan.

Hasil penentuan topik material keberlanjutan menjadi salah satu pertimbangan dalam pengelolaan risiko dan peluang keberlanjutan Perusahaan. Topik material yang telah teridentifikasi digunakan sebagai referensi dalam memahami isu-isu yang berpotensi memengaruhi pencapaian tujuan strategis Perusahaan.

Melalui integrasi antara hasil materiality assessment dan kerangka Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), PT BKI (Persero) memperkuat pendekatan pengelolaan risiko dengan mempertimbangkan aspek keberlanjutan dalam proses identifikasi, evaluasi, pemantauan, dan pengambilan keputusan strategis. Pendekatan ini mendukung Perusahaan dalam menciptakan nilai jangka panjang melalui pengelolaan risiko dan peluang yang lebih komprehensif serta selaras dengan kebutuhan pemangku kepentingan.

title: BKI and PLN Indonesia Power Collaborate to Advance Sustainable Energy Programs
text:
BKI and PLN Indonesia Power Collaborate to Advance Sustainable Energy Programs

BKI and PLN Indonesia Power signed an MoU to explore strategic collaboration focused on technical certification, asset management, and decarbonization for Indonesia's power infrastructure.

Jakarta, April 27, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with PT PLN Indonesia Power (PLN-IP) to explore strategic collaboration across a range of technical services, including certification, inspection, non-destructive testing, laboratory services, surveys, engineering, and decarbonisation initiatives. The signing, held at PLN Indonesia Power’s office in Jakarta, marks an initial step toward strengthening cooperation to support safe, reliable, and sustainable power generation.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-27 at 17.17.07.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Whats_App_Image_2026_04_27_at_17_17_07_b3525a7f24.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-27 at 17.16.47.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Whats_App_Image_2026_04_27_at_17_16_47_cdeb45be99.jpeg)

The MoU establishes a framework for both parties to assess potential collaboration opportunities, including technical support and regulatory compliance, while identifying associated benefits, risks, and implementation pathways for future initiatives.

The agreement was signed in the presence of BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto, accompanied by Director of Commercial Business Operations Erwin Ernanto Hoesni and VP of CoE Energy R. Sapto Agung Pramusinto. PLN Indonesia Power was represented by its President Director, Bernadus Sudarmanta, along with senior management.

During the signing, R. Benny Susanto reaffirmed BKI’s commitment as a strategic technical partner. "BKI is prepared to leverage its deep technical expertise, independence, and competence to ensure that PLN Indonesia Power’s facilities—from operations to maintenance—adhere to the highest international standards for safety, quality, and regulatory compliance," Susanto stated.

Bernadus Sudarmanta, President Director of PT PLN Indonesia Power, highlighted the evolving role of BKI. He noted that BKI is now a vital partner in the broader energy sector, moving beyond its traditional maritime roots. This shift is crucial for PLN-IP, which manages over 400 generating units providing approximately 25% of the nation’s electricity.

"BKI offers the sophisticated inspection and certification capabilities essential to our business transformation and asset management," said Sudarmanta. "As we scale our renewable energy projects and navigate complex operational dynamics, this collaboration is a strategic step toward strengthening our long-term performance and sustainability."

A key focus of the collaboration is decarbonisation, with BKI expected to provide engineering solutions and feasibility studies to support the transition toward more environmentally sustainable power generation systems. This aligns with broader efforts to achieve Net Zero Emissions and strengthen the resilience of Indonesia’s energy sector.

Through this partnership, BKI reinforces its role as a trusted provider of testing, inspection, certification, and statutory services, supporting risk mitigation, operational reliability, and national energy security.

title: HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY
section_path: ESG > Social > Human Rights Policy: HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY
text:
HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY > ESG > Social > Human Rights Policy: HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY

As an integral part of the national and global business ecosystem, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (BKI) (Persero) fully recognizes that respect for, protection of, and fulfillment of Human Rights (HR) are the fundamental pillars of sustainable and ethical business operations. This policy serves as a formal commitment and guiding framework for all employees of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) and business partners to ensure that all activities and decisions consistently uphold universal human rights values. Therefore, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) is committed to:

1. Upholding Human Rights by complying with applicable national laws and regulations, including the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, Law No. 39 of 1999 on Human Rights, Law No. 26 of 2000 on the Human Rights Court, as well as other relevant regulations. This commitment is further reinforced by the application of international standards such as the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR), the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP), the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR), the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (ICESCR), and other applicable global human rights instruments. The company is committed to ensuring its operations do not violate or contribute to human rights violations in any form.
2. Strictly prevent and eliminate practices that violate workers’ rights throughout the entire operational and supply chain, including but not limited to:

1. Strictly prohibit all forms of human trafficking and forced labor. All work must be performed voluntarily, and workers have the right to leave their jobs subject to reasonable notice.
2. Prohibit the use of child labor in accordance with the minimum age limits established by national laws and regulations and international standards.
3. Respect the right of all employees of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) to form and join labor unions or workers’ representatives of their choice, as well as the right to engage in collective bargaining peacefully, without fear of retaliation, discrimination, or intimidation.

1. Ensuring equal opportunity for all employees of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) and prohibiting all forms of discrimination regardless of ethnicity, religion, race, skin color, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, political views, disability status, or other background in the recruitment, placement, compensation, training, promotion, and termination of employment processes.
2. Requiring all business partners, including suppliers, contractors, and other third parties, to understand, accept, and implement human rights standards equivalent to those set forth in this policy.
3. Establish a clear and confidential escalation process for reporting incidents of violations and ensure protection for whistleblowers against any form of retaliation.
4. Any employee of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) found to have committed a human rights violation will be subject to firm corrective or disciplinary action in accordance with the Company’s regulations and applicable laws and regulations.

It references key legal and international frameworks (e.g., Law No. 39/1999 on Human Rights, Law No. 26/2000, UDHR, UNGP) and prohibits forced labor, child labor, and discrimination, with an escalation/whistleblower process.

HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY > ESG > Social > Human Rights Policy: HUMAN RIGHTS POLICY

As an integral part of the national and global business ecosystem, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (BKI) (Persero) fully recognizes that respect for, protection of, and fulfillment of Human Rights (HR) are the fundamental pillars of sustainable and ethical business operations. This policy serves as a formal commitment and guiding framework for all employees of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) and business partners to ensure that all activities and decisions consistently uphold universal human rights values. Therefore, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) is committed to:

1. Upholding Human Rights by complying with applicable national laws and regulations, including the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, Law No. 39 of 1999 on Human Rights, Law No. 26 of 2000 on the Human Rights Court, as well as other relevant regulations. This commitment is further reinforced by the application of international standards such as the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR), the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP), the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR), the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (ICESCR), and other applicable global human rights instruments. The company is committed to ensuring its operations do not violate or contribute to human rights violations in any form.
2. Strictly prevent and eliminate practices that violate workers’ rights throughout the entire operational and supply chain, including but not limited to:

1. Strictly prohibit all forms of human trafficking and forced labor. All work must be performed voluntarily, and workers have the right to leave their jobs subject to reasonable notice.
2. Prohibit the use of child labor in accordance with the minimum age limits established by national laws and regulations and international standards.
3. Respect the right of all employees of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) to form and join labor unions or workers’ representatives of their choice, as well as the right to engage in collective bargaining peacefully, without fear of retaliation, discrimination, or intimidation.

1. Ensuring equal opportunity for all employees of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) and prohibiting all forms of discrimination regardless of ethnicity, religion, race, skin color, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, political views, disability status, or other background in the recruitment, placement, compensation, training, promotion, and termination of employment processes.
2. Requiring all business partners, including suppliers, contractors, and other third parties, to understand, accept, and implement human rights standards equivalent to those set forth in this policy.
3. Establish a clear and confidential escalation process for reporting incidents of violations and ensure protection for whistleblowers against any form of retaliation.
4. Any employee of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) found to have committed a human rights violation will be subject to firm corrective or disciplinary action in accordance with the Company’s regulations and applicable laws and regulations.

title: Efisiensi Energi untuk Kapal
section_path: Tindakan penanggulangan
text:
Efisiensi Energi untuk Kapal > Tindakan penanggulangan

Peringkat tahunan A–E berdasarkan data DCS IMO: pelaporan ≤ 3 bulan; SoC ≤ 5 bulan; rencana korektif jika peringkat E (1 tahun) atau D (3 tahun berturut-turut).

EEDI mendorong kapal baru yang lebih efisien dan rendah emisi untuk ≥ 400 GT.

Prinsip-prinsip yang mirip EEDI berlaku untuk kapal yang beroperasi di atas 400 GT, memastikan armada memenuhi standar iklim.

Sejalan dengan SDG 13, IMO telah menerapkan langkah-langkah wajib untuk mengurangi emisi gas rumah kaca dari pelayaran melalui MARPOL Lampiran VI. Sebagai Organisasi yang Diakui (RO), BKI membantu armada Anda mematuhi aturan, efisien, dan kompetitif.

Efisiensi Energi untuk Kapal

Standar efisiensi energi untuk kapal baru ≥ 400 GT, yang beroperasi pada tahap perancangan dan selama uji coba laut sebelum diterbitkan oleh IEEC.

Implementasi prinsip efisiensi pada kapal yang ada ≥ 400 GT. Termasuk solusi seperti SHAPOLI/EPL dan penerbitan ulang IEEC.

Bagian I, II (IMO DCS), dan III (CII): perencanaan, pengumpulan data konsumsi bahan bakar, dan peningkatan kinerja berkelanjutan.

- Verifikasi Berkas Teknis EEDI (Pendahuluan & Akhir)

- Persetujuan EEXI & Penerbitan Ulang IEEC

- Perjanjian SEEMP Bagian I, II, dan III

- Penerbitan Konfirmasi Kepatuhan (CoC) untuk SEEMP

- Verifikasi Data Bahan Bakar & SoC Tahunan untuk IMO DCS

- Perhitungan & verifikasi CII tahunan

- Persetujuan Rencana Tindakan Korektif untuk peringkat D/E

Layanan

Verifikasi EEDI pada tahap perancangan sebelum konstruksi.

Survei selama uji coba laut untuk mengonfirmasi nilai EEDI & penerbitan IEEC.

Bandingkan EEXI yang Dicapai vs. yang Diperlukan; ambil tindakan jika tidak terpenuhi.

A

Implementasi SHAPOLI/EPL atau solusi lainnya, dengan panduan & persetujuan dari BKI.

B

title: OPEN COMMUNICATION CHANNELS
section_path: ESG > Social > Accessible Communication Channels: OPEN COMMUNICATION CHANNELS > Information Channel
text:
OPEN COMMUNICATION CHANNELS > ESG > Social > Accessible Communication Channels: OPEN COMMUNICATION CHANNELS > Information Channel

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) is committed to building a responsive and transparent relationship with customers through the provision of various easily accessible communication channels, to ensure that every customer input, question, or complaint can be received, followed up, and resolved in a timely manner. This commitment is demonstrated through the following initiatives:

As a form of openness in receiving customer feedback, PT BKI (Persero) provides a dedicated email address that customers can use to submit input or complaints to the Company. In addition, the Company also provides a dedicated phone line to ensure that every customer input can be received and followed up directly by the relevant work team. For customers who require face-to-face service, PT BKI (Persero) also provides in-person customer service at the Head Office, where every question is answered directly by the Corporate Marketing Division.

To ensure that customer feedback is genuinely utilized as material for continuous improvement, PT BKI (Persero) regularly conducts customer satisfaction surveys to capture perception, experience, and the level of satisfaction with the services provided. The results of this survey serve as a service evaluation instrument used to identify areas for improvement in the Company's future service planning and development.

Every complaint submitted by a customer to PT BKI (Persero), whether through official correspondence, email, or telephone, is recorded, verified, and followed up through an initial verification process to ensure appropriate handling. This mechanism guarantees that every report received obtains confirmation of receipt and is handled in accordance with applicable procedures.

The complaint-handling process at PT BKI (Persero) is carried out transparently. Reports that have been verified and can be handled directly will be responded to by the receiving work unit. Meanwhile, complaints that require cross-unit coordination will be documented through a Customer Complaint Action Request (CCAR) and forwarded to the relevant work unit, with a copy to the Corporate Marketing Division. As part of a periodic control and evaluation mechanism, PT BKI (Persero) also records every reported complaint in a Customer Complaint Log Book, to ensure that customers receive timely updates on the status of complaint handling.

To make it easier for customers to submit questions, input, or complaints, the following is the official contact information of PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero):

|---|---|

| Phone : | 0214301017 |

| Email : | crc@bki.co.id / cs@bki.co.id |

| Website: | www.bki.co.id |
