title: BKI Wins Transportasi Indonesia Award 2026
text:
BKI Wins Transportasi Indonesia Award 2026

BKI received the “Leading Classification and Certification Institution for Maritime Safety” award at the Transportasi Indonesia Award 2026 in recognition of its contribution to strengthening maritime transport safety.

Jakarta, July 30, 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero), or BKI, received an award at the Transportasi Indonesia Award 2026 ceremony held at the Binakarna Auditorium in Jakarta. The award recognises BKI’s contribution to strengthening maritime transport safety through its classification, certification, and compliance assurance services.

The award was presented to BKI’s Director of Classification Business Operations, Arief Budi Permana. BKI received the “Leading Classification and Certification Institution for Maritime Safety” award in recognition of its commitment to advancing Indonesia’s transportation sector and promoting higher standards of maritime safety.

The Transportasi Indonesia Award recognises companies, institutions, and leaders in the transportation sector for their innovation, service quality, and contributions to building a safe, sustainable, and competitive national transportation system. The award also highlights initiatives that contribute to improving the quality, safety, and development of Indonesia’s transportation sector.

Commenting on the recognition, Arief Budi Permana said the award would encourage BKI to maintain the quality of its operations while continuing to contribute to the development of the maritime sector.

“This award is both an appreciation and a source of motivation for BKI to continuously improve the quality of our services. It also reinforces our responsibility to ensure that every process is carried out professionally and in accordance with applicable regulations,” said Arief.

The recognition underscores BKI’s continued efforts to promote maritime safety through services that support compliance with applicable regulations and industry standards. The achievement further reinforces BKI’s role in supporting the advancement of Indonesia’s transportation sector, particularly in the maritime and shipping industries.

title: BKI Signs MoU with ABUPI to Support Port Industry
text:
BKI Signs MoU with ABUPI to Support Port Industry

BKI and the Indonesian Port Business Entities Association (ABUPI) have signed an MoU to explore cooperation in testing, inspection, certification, consulting, classification, and statutory services for the port industry.

Jakarta, September 16, 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero), or BKI, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Indonesian Port Business Entities Association (ABUPI) in Jakarta to explore cooperation in testing, inspection, certification, consulting, classification, and statutory services for the port industry.

![DSC09770.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_09770_cb247738db.JPG)
![DSC09795.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_09795_99fbc92890.JPG)

The MoU was signed at the Mezzanine Ballroom during the ABUPI Consolidation Forum, which brought together port industry stakeholders to strengthen coordination and discuss developments and emerging needs across the sector. BKI took part in the forum as a provider of testing, inspection, certification, consulting, classification, and statutory (TICCS) services.

Representing BKI at the signing was Director of Institutional Affairs and Resources R. Agus Doddy Dwisagita, while ABUPI was represented by Chairperson Liana Trisnawati, accompanied by members of the association’s Central Executive Board. The agreement provides a framework for both parties to explore and develop cooperation based on the agreed scope and requirements.

Doddy said the partnership with ABUPI forms part of BKI’s efforts to strengthen its engagement with the port industry and expand its contribution through integrated TICCS services.

“Through this partnership, BKI can broaden its contribution to addressing the needs of the port industry, particularly through testing, inspection, certification, consulting, classification, and statutory services that comply with applicable regulations,” said Doddy.

Through the MoU, BKI and ABUPI will explore collaborative initiatives that respond to industry needs while promoting quality, regulatory compliance, and the continued improvement of port operations across Indonesia.

title: BKI and PT Mutuagung Lestari Tbk Establish Strategic Cooperation in TICC Services
text:
BKI and PT Mutuagung Lestari Tbk Establish Strategic Cooperation in TICC Services

BKI and PT Mutuagung Lestari Tbk signed an MoU to explore collaboration in Testing, Inspection, Certification, and Consultation (TICC) services, including technical support and sustainability initiatives. The partnership aims to strengthen integrated and sustainable service solutions to support the evolving needs of national industries.

Jakarta, May 12, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with PT Mutuagung Lestari Tbk to explore strategic collaboration in Testing, Inspection, Certification, and Consultation (TICC) services. The signing ceremony, held at BKI Headquarters in Jakarta, marks the beginning of cooperation between the two companies in delivering integrated technical and professional services tailored to industry needs.

![DSC02657.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_02657_3441a523df.JPG)
![DSC02605.JPG](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_02605_8a209e9e6b.JPG)

Representing BKI at the signing were Director of Institutional and Human Resources R. Agus Doddy Dwi Sagita and members of the company’s management team. PT Mutuagung Lestari Tbk was represented by President Director Arifin Lambaga and senior management.

R. Agus Doddy Dwi Sagita stated that the partnership reflects BKI’s commitment to strengthening collaboration and expanding its capabilities amid evolving industry demands. “As a state-owned enterprise undergoing transformation in the TICCS sector—Testing, Inspection, Certification, Classification, and Statutory services—BKI continues to enhance its capabilities and contribution to national industrial development. We welcome this collaboration, which covers testing, inspection, certification, consultation, technical support, human resource development, and potential cooperation on strategic sustainability and government programmes,” he said.

Through this partnership, BKI and PT Mutuagung Lestari Tbk aim to strengthen support for national industries by providing more integrated, reliable, and sustainable testing, inspection, and certification services.

title: BKI Resmikan Kantor Cabang Utama Komersial Jakarta
text:
BKI Resmikan Kantor Cabang Utama Komersial Jakarta

PT BKI meresmikan Cabang Utama Komersial Jakarta pada 3 Februari 2026 untuk memperkuat fokus organisasi dan meningkatkan efektivitas operasional.

Jakarta, 3 Februari 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI meresmikan Cabang Utama Komersial Jakarta melalui acara peresmian resmi yang digelar di Gedung Utama Lantai 5, Kantor Pusat BKI. Peresmian ini dilakukan sebagai bagian dari upaya perusahaan memperkuat fokus organisasi dan meningkatkan efektivitas operasional bisnis.
Peresmian tersebut dihadiri oleh Direktur Operasi Bisnis Komersial BKI, Erwin Ernanto Hoesni, serta Kepala Cabang Utama Komersial Jakarta, Budiman Johansyah.
Direktur Operasi Bisnis Komersial BKI, Erwin Ernanto Hoesni, menjelaskan bahwa pembentukan cabang ini bertujuan memperjelas pembagian fungsi dalam organisasi.
“Fungsi operasi bisnis difokuskan di Cabang Jakarta, sementara fungsi pengembangan diarahkan melalui Center of Excellence (CoE), khususnya pada sektor energi serta transportasi dan logistik. Dengan pemisahan ini, operasional diharapkan berjalan lebih efektif, sementara pengembangan bisnis dan inovasi dapat dilakukan secara lebih terarah dan berkelanjutan,” ujar Erwin.
Melalui pembentukan Cabang Utama Komersial Jakarta, BKI memusatkan kegiatan operasional bisnis di ibu kota, sekaligus memperkuat peran CoE dalam pengembangan layanan di sektor strategis. Pemisahan fungsi ini diharapkan mendorong peningkatan kinerja, efisiensi, dan kualitas layanan perusahaan.
Ke depan, Cabang Jakarta diarahkan untuk memperluas portofolio layanan, memperkuat kolaborasi antar unit kerja, serta meningkatkan respons perusahaan terhadap kebutuhan pasar yang terus berkembang.
Selain itu, dukungan fasilitas kerja yang telah direnovasi juga diharapkan menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang nyaman dan produktif, serta mendorong lahirnya kolaborasi dan gagasan inovatif di lingkungan kerja.
BKI menargetkan Cabang Utama Komersial Jakarta dapat menjadi percontohan cabang komersial, baik dari sisi kinerja, tata kelola, maupun budaya kerja, dalam mendukung pencapaian tujuan perusahaan secara berkelanjutan.

Berlangsung pada 3 Februari 2026 di Kantor Pusat BKI (Gedung Utama Lantai 5), dihadiri Erwin Ernanto Hoesni (Direktur Operasi Bisnis Komersial BKI) dan Budiman Johansyah (Kepala Cabang Utama Komersial Jakarta), dengan penekanan pemisahan fungsi operasi dan pengembangan melalui Center of Excellence (CoE / pusat keunggulan).

Melalui pembentukan Cabang Utama Komersial Jakarta, BKI memusatkan kegiatan operasional bisnis di ibu kota, sekaligus memperkuat peran CoE dalam pengembangan layanan di sektor strategis. Pemisahan fungsi ini diharapkan mendorong peningkatan kinerja, efisiensi, dan kualitas layanan perusahaan.
Ke depan, Cabang Jakarta diarahkan untuk memperluas portofolio layanan, memperkuat kolaborasi antar unit kerja, serta meningkatkan respons perusahaan terhadap kebutuhan pasar yang terus berkembang.
Selain itu, dukungan fasilitas kerja yang telah direnovasi juga diharapkan menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang nyaman dan produktif, serta mendorong lahirnya kolaborasi dan gagasan inovatif di lingkungan kerja.
BKI menargetkan Cabang Utama Komersial Jakarta dapat menjadi percontohan cabang komersial, baik dari sisi kinerja, tata kelola, maupun budaya kerja, dalam mendukung pencapaian tujuan perusahaan secara berkelanjutan.

title: PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) Holds Technical Committee Meeting: Driving Excellence, Defining the Future
text:
PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) Holds Technical Committee Meeting: Driving Excellence, Defining the Future

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero), as the lead holding of state-owned survey services (IDSurvey), held a Technical Committee Meeting under the theme Driving Excellence, Defining the Future on April 24, 2025, at the Nava Building, PT BKI (Persero).

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero), as the lead holding of state-owned survey services (IDSurvey), held a Technical Committee Meeting under the theme Driving Excellence, Defining the Future on April 24, 2025, at the Nava Building, PT BKI (Persero).

The event was attended by Mr. Arief Budi Permana, Deputy Director of Classification Business Management at BKI; Mrs. Anita Puji Utami, Chairperson of Iperindo; Mr. Fredhi Agung Prasetyo, Vice President of Classification & Statutory Research and Development; as well as the members of BKI’s Technical Committee for the 2023–2025 period.

The meeting was organized to validate BKI’s technical regulations as a requirement for the issuance of Rules, which will later serve as BKI’s submission materials to the International Association of Classification Societies (IACS).

The agenda of the Technical Committee Meeting included the validation of seven (7) Draft Technical Rules, divided across three Panel Sessions. In general, the meeting approved the outcomes of the panel sessions from each sub-committee, which had validated the following Draft Technical Rules:
NE July 2025 – Rules for Hull (Pt.1, Vol. II)

NE July 2025 – Rules for Container Ships (Pt.1, Vol. XVIII)

NE July 2025 – Rules for Classification and Surveys (Pt.1, Vol. I)

NE July 2025 – Rules for Machinery Installations (Pt.1, Vol. III)

NE July 2025 – Rules for Electrical Installations (Pt.1, Vol. IV)

NE July 2025 – Rules for Approval of Manufacturers and Service Suppliers (Pt.1, Vol. XI)

NE July 2025 – Rules for Non-Metallic Materials (Pt.1, Vol. XIV)

Following this validation, the drafts will be published by BKI in accordance with applicable procedures, while also taking into account proposals and feedback received during the meeting.

Key entities include Mr. Arief Budi Permana and Mr. Fredhi Agung Prasetyo, plus Iperindo (Mrs. Anita Puji Utami) and the BKI Technical Committee (2023–2025), with outputs prepared for submission to IACS (International Association of Classification Societies / Asosiasi Internasional Badan Klasifikasi).

title: BKI Strengthens Understanding of the Shipbuilding Industry Through KSF Industry Focus Mastery
text:
BKI Strengthens Understanding of the Shipbuilding Industry Through KSF Industry Focus Mastery

BKI participated in a shipbuilding industry forum organized for BSI analysts to strengthen their understanding of maritime financing and risk assessment.

Jakarta, April 10, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) participated in the Knowledge Sharing Forum (KSF) Industry Focus Mastery: Shipbuilding Industry, organized by Primakelola IPB Consulting in collaboration with PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BSI) at The Tower BSI in Jakarta. The forum was designed to strengthen BSI analysts’ understanding of the shipbuilding sector and support more informed financing assessments in the maritime industry.

![Foto 4.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Foto_4_ca3da93fb3.jpeg)
![Foto 3.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Foto_3_1e92dbbfd0.jpeg)
![Foto 1.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Foto_1_293e562f42.jpeg)

Representing BKI at the forum were Director of Classification Business Operations Arief Budi Permana and VP of Research and Development for Classification & Statutory Business Fredhi Agung Prasetyo. During the session, BKI shared insights into its role within Indonesia’s shipbuilding ecosystem and provided an overview of the national shipbuilding industry from a classification perspective.

BKI’s presentation covered the full shipbuilding cycle, from planning and construction to vessel operations. It also highlighted key risks within the shipbuilding industry and outlined the main factors influencing vessel value, using an approach aligned with the needs of financing and credit analysis.

As a classification and survey services provider, BKI offered technical insights to help participants better understand the characteristics and complexities of the shipbuilding sector. The session is expected to broaden analysts’ perspectives in evaluating financing opportunities and risk within the maritime industry.

Through its participation in the forum, BKI reaffirmed its commitment to supporting stronger industry understanding and more informed decision-making across Indonesia’s maritime sector.

title: Direktur Utama BKI Tinjau Kesiapan Pelabuhan Trisakti Hadapi Arus Nataru
text:
Direktur Utama BKI Tinjau Kesiapan Pelabuhan Trisakti Hadapi Arus Nataru

Direktur Utama BKI meninjau Pelabuhan Trisakti, Banjarmasin, untuk memastikan kesiapan infrastruktur dan operasional angkutan laut menjelang puncak arus Natal 2025 dan Tahun Baru 2026, sebagai bagian dari dukungan BKI terhadap keselamatan dan kelancaran transportasi laut nasional.

Banjarmasin, 29 Desember 2025 — Direktur Utama PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI, R. Benny Susanto, melakukan kunjungan kerja ke Pelabuhan Trisakti, Banjarmasin, untuk melihat langsung kesiapan infrastruktur dan fasilitas angkutan laut menjelang puncak arus libur Natal 2025 dan Tahun Baru 2026 (Nataru).
Kunjungan ini dilakukan di tengah meningkatnya mobilitas masyarakat yang memanfaatkan transportasi laut selama periode libur akhir tahun. Pelabuhan Trisakti merupakan salah satu simpul penting pergerakan penumpang dan barang di Kalimantan Selatan, sehingga kesiapan fasilitas menjadi faktor utama dalam menjaga kelancaran perjalanan.
Melalui peninjauan langsung di lapangan, perhatian difokuskan pada kesiapan sarana pelabuhan dan dukungan operasional agar aktivitas bongkar muat, pelayanan penumpang, serta pergerakan kapal dapat berjalan tertib dan aman.
Kegiatan ini merupakan bagian dari upaya bersama antara BKI dan Kementerian Perhubungan untuk memastikan transportasi laut tetap aman dan nyaman selama periode Nataru. Kehadiran pimpinan perusahaan di lapangan diharapkan dapat memperkuat koordinasi serta memastikan setiap potensi kendala dapat diantisipasi lebih dini.
Bagi masyarakat, langkah ini diharapkan memberikan rasa aman dalam menggunakan transportasi laut, sekaligus mendukung kelancaran distribusi logistik yang biasanya meningkat pada akhir tahun.
Melalui pemantauan langsung di pelabuhan, BKI menegaskan perannya dalam mendukung penyelenggaraan transportasi laut yang andal, khususnya pada periode dengan aktivitas tinggi seperti Natal dan Tahun Baru. Upaya ini sejalan dengan komitmen untuk menjaga keselamatan pelayaran serta memastikan layanan transportasi laut dapat dinikmati masyarakat secara aman dan berkelanjutan.

title: Focus Group Discussion on “Safely Transporting Battery-Based Electric Vehicles” by PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)
text:
Focus Group Discussion on “Safely Transporting Battery-Based Electric Vehicles” by PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) / BKI, as the lead of the Survey Services SOEs Holding, comprising PT SUCOFINDO and PT Surveyor Indonesia, organized a Focus Group Discussion (FGD) titled “Safely Transporting Battery-Based Electric Vehicles – Best Practices for Shipowners & Maritime Logistics.”

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) / BKI, as the lead of the Survey Services SOEs Holding, comprising PT SUCOFINDO and PT Surveyor Indonesia, organized a Focus Group Discussion (FGD) titled “Safely Transporting Battery-Based Electric Vehicles – Best Practices for Shipowners & Maritime Logistics.”

The event was held in a hybrid format at the Ali Sadikin Hall, Graha BKI, Jakarta, on Tuesday, May 7, 2025.
This forum served as a concrete form of collaboration in addressing both the challenges and opportunities arising from the rapid growth of electric vehicles (EV) in Indonesia, particularly with regard to the safety aspects of transporting EVs via sea.

The discussion explored strategies for implementing safety standards in EV maritime transport, covering operational and financial perspectives as part of risk mitigation efforts.
The event featured remarks from Arief Nurtjahjo, SVP of Classification Business Operations at PT BKI (Persero); Capt. Hendri Ginting, M.M., Director of Shipping and Seafaring at the Ministry of Transportation of the Republic of Indonesia, who delivered the keynote address; and Alex Nurwahyudy, Marine Investigator at KNKT, who served as the moderator.

Distinguished speakers came from diverse institutions and backgrounds, including:

- Franky Affandi, CTO of PT Fast

- Dimas Yunianto P., R&D Engineer at Gotion High-Tech

- Khoiri Soetomo, Chairman of GAPASDAP

- Amir Makbul, Head of Ship Design and Stability Sub-Directorate, Ministry of Transportation RI

- Mohammad Arif Kurniawan, Senior Manager of Business Research and Development Operations, PT BKI (Persero)

- Yohanes Oscarino, Claim Group Head, PT Tugu Reasuransi Indonesia

title: Load Line
section_path: 1. National Load Line Certificate (PM 29 Tahun 2016)
text:
Load Line > 1. National Load Line Certificate (PM 29 Tahun 2016)

The load line (Plimsoll Mark) is a vital safety standard that marks the maximum depth at which a ship can be safely loaded—maintaining stability, buoyancy, and structural integrity during a voyage. As a Flag State-approved agency, BKI has full authority to conduct surveys, calculations, and certification to ensure your ship's load line markings are accurate and valid.

BKI has a clear and efficient procedure to guide you through the certification process from start to finish.

Regulation:

Every vessel must undergo an annual Load Line Survey. BKI's expert surveyors will perform thorough inspections to confirm compliance with international requirements. Timely completion of this survey is critical—delaying it can lead to detention of the vessel and operational interruptions.

Applicability:

Preventing overloading is key to maritime safety. Proper markings ensure the vessel maintains stability, buoyancy, and an adequate safety margin throughout its voyage.

Issued in accordance with the International Convention on Load Lines (ILLC), 1966.

BKI offers two types of load line certification, depending on your vessel's area of operation and regulatory framework. Both certificates are valid for a period of 5 (five) years, conditional upon successful periodic surveys.

This certificate applies to all convention ships engaged in international voyages. It can also be chosen by ships operating in Indonesian waters that opt for certification under the international convention.

Issued in accordance with the Indonesian Minister of Transportation Regulation No. 29 of 2016.

This certificate applies to ships engaged in Indonesian domestic waters. It also applies to non-convention ships that are engaged in international waters.

title: BKI Retains “High Performance” Status in Tokyo MoU 2025 Report
text:
BKI Retains “High Performance” Status in Tokyo MoU 2025 Report

BKI retained its “High Performance” classification in the 2025 Tokyo MoU Recognized Organization assessment, while Indonesia also maintained its “High Performance” flag state status. The achievement reflects continued collaboration among national maritime stakeholders to strengthen shipping safety, operational reliability, and international compliance standards.

Jakarta, May 1, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) has once again maintained its “High Performance” classification in the Recognized Organization (RO) performance list published in the 2025 Tokyo MoU Annual Report. During the same assessment period, Indonesia also retained its “High Performance” status in the flag state performance ranking, reflecting the country’s continued progress in strengthening maritime safety and fleet quality at the international level.

The Tokyo Memorandum of Understanding on Port State Control in the Asia-Pacific Region (Tokyo MoU) is a regional cooperation framework focused on enhancing shipping safety, marine environmental protection, and seafarer working conditions through inspections of foreign vessels calling at ports across member countries.

The 2025 assessment was based on cumulative inspection and detention data collected over the 2022–2025 period. Throughout the evaluation period, inspections of Indonesian-flagged vessels remained stable, while detention rates showed a consistent decline between 2023 and 2025.

The achievement highlights the strong collaboration among maritime stakeholders in improving national shipping standards. Contributions from the Ministry of Transportation as regulator, shipowners and operators, industry partners, and BKI as a Recognized Organization played an important role in maintaining this performance.

Maintaining “High Performance” status is expected to further support the international operations of Indonesian-flagged vessels while encouraging the continuous improvement of national shipping safety standards and operational reliability.

It cites the Jakarta announcement dated May 1, 2026 and explains that the 2025 assessment covers cumulative inspection and detention data from 2022–2025, involving entities like the Ministry of Transportation (Kementerian Perhubungan) and shipowners/operators.

The achievement reflects continued collaboration among national maritime stakeholders to strengthen shipping safety, operational reliability, and international compliance standards.

Jakarta, May 1, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) has once again maintained its “High Performance” classification in the Recognized Organization (RO) performance list published in the 2025 Tokyo MoU Annual Report. During the same assessment period, Indonesia also retained its “High Performance” status in the flag state performance ranking, reflecting the country’s continued progress in strengthening maritime safety and fleet quality at the international level.

The Tokyo Memorandum of Understanding on Port State Control in the Asia-Pacific Region (Tokyo MoU) is a regional cooperation framework focused on enhancing shipping safety, marine environmental protection, and seafarer working conditions through inspections of foreign vessels calling at ports across member countries.

The 2025 assessment was based on cumulative inspection and detention data collected over the 2022–2025 period. Throughout the evaluation period, inspections of Indonesian-flagged vessels remained stable, while detention rates showed a consistent decline between 2023 and 2025.

The achievement highlights the strong collaboration among maritime stakeholders in improving national shipping standards. Contributions from the Ministry of Transportation as regulator, shipowners and operators, industry partners, and BKI as a Recognized Organization played an important role in maintaining this performance.

Maintaining “High Performance” status is expected to further support the international operations of Indonesian-flagged vessels while encouraging the continuous improvement of national shipping safety standards and operational reliability.

title: BKI Inaugurates Jakarta Main Commercial Branch to Strengthen Business Operations
text:
BKI Inaugurates Jakarta Main Commercial Branch to Strengthen Business Operations

PT BKI (Persero) inaugurated its Jakarta Main Commercial Branch to strengthen organizational focus and improve the effectiveness of its business operations.

Jakarta, February 3, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) officially inaugurated its Jakarta Main Commercial Branch at a ceremony held on the fifth floor of its Head Office. The establishment of the new branch forms part of the company’s strategy to sharpen organizational focus and enhance the effectiveness of its business operations.

The inauguration was attended by BKI Director of Commercial Business Operations Erwin Ernanto Hoesni and Head of the Jakarta Main Commercial Branch Budiman Johansyah.

In his remarks, Erwin Ernanto Hoesni explained that the new branch is designed to clarify functional roles within the organization. Under this structure, commercial operations are centralized at the Jakarta Branch, while business development is managed through the Center of Excellence (CoE), particularly in the energy, transportation, and logistics sectors. This approach is expected to improve operational efficiency and support more focused and sustainable innovation.

Through the establishment of the Jakarta Main Commercial Branch, BKI strengthens its commercial presence in the capital while reinforcing the strategic role of the CoE in service development. The separation of functions is intended to drive higher performance, greater efficiency, and improved service quality.

Looking ahead, the Jakarta Branch is expected to expand its service portfolio, strengthen inter-unit collaboration, and enhance responsiveness to market dynamics. Improved work facilities are also expected to foster a comfortable and productive working environment that encourages teamwork and innovation.

BKI aims for the Jakarta Main Commercial Branch to serve as a benchmark for other commercial branches in terms of performance, governance, and corporate culture, supporting the company’s long-term and sustainable growth.

title: BKI Signs MoU with Jasaraharja Putera to Advance Maritime Safety
text:
BKI Signs MoU with Jasaraharja Putera to Advance Maritime Safety

BKI signed a Memorandum of Understanding with PT Jasaraharja Putera to explore collaboration in technical assurance, education, and knowledge sharing to strengthen maritime safety and service quality.

Jakarta, July 17, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with PT Jasaraharja Putera at BKI Headquarters in Jakarta, marking the beginning of a strategic partnership to explore collaboration in technical assurance, education, and knowledge development aimed at enhancing maritime safety and service quality.

![IMG_3815.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/IMG_3815_c69e1efd27.jpg)

The signing ceremony was attended by BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto, accompanied by Director of Classification Business Operations Arief Budi Permana and members of the company's management team. PT Jasaraharja Putera was represented by President Director Abdul Haris, Marketing Director Imam Hendrawan, and members of its management.

Under the MoU, both organisations will explore opportunities for cooperation in improving technical assurance, strengthening competency development, and promoting knowledge sharing to support higher safety standards and operational excellence across Indonesia’s maritime sector.

Benny stated that the partnership reflects BKI’s commitment to leveraging its technical expertise, independence, and professional capabilities to support improvements in maritime safety, security, and regulatory compliance.

"This Memorandum of Understanding marks the beginning of a strategic collaboration. We hope it will make a meaningful contribution to strengthening the safety and security of Indonesia’s shipping industry for the benefit of the public and the nation," he said.

The partnership also reinforces BKI’s commitment to working closely with strategic stakeholders to build a safer, more reliable, and more sustainable maritime ecosystem while supporting the continuous improvement of national shipping safety standards.

title: BKI Strengthens Integrity Culture Through Anti-Bribery Awareness Programme at Batam Branch
text:
BKI Strengthens Integrity Culture Through Anti-Bribery Awareness Programme at Batam Branch

BKI conducted an Anti-Bribery Management System (ABMS) awareness programme at its Batam Branch to strengthen employees' understanding of compliance, ethics, and integrity.

Batam, June 25, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) continues to strengthen its culture of integrity by conducting an Anti-Bribery Management System (ABMS) awareness programme at its Batam Branch. Held in a hybrid format, the event took place at the BKI Batam Branch Office and was attended both in person and virtually via Zoom.

![IMG_3435.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/IMG_3435_d222a5653e.jpeg)

The programme was opened by Budi Isrofi, Head of BKI’s Batam Main Classification Branch, and Muhamad Yusran Aloahiit, Head of the Batam Commercial Branch. In their opening remarks, both emphasised the importance of fostering a workplace culture built on integrity, compliance, and transparency as the foundation of sustainable business operations.

The programme formed part of BKI’s Corrective Action Plan (CAP) following the findings of the 2026 ISO and HSE audits and was organised by the Legal and Compliance Section of the Corporate Secretary Division.

Kevin Iqbal Rizaldi, Acting Senior Manager of Legal and Compliance, together with his team, led the session, providing an overview of the Anti-Bribery Management System, reinforcing a culture of compliance, and highlighting the responsibility of every employee in preventing bribery and maintaining ethical business practices.

The programme was attended by employees across the Batam Branch, reflecting the organisation’s collective commitment to strengthening understanding of ABMS implementation and reinforcing ethical conduct throughout the company.

Through this initiative, BKI reaffirmed its commitment to embedding integrity, regulatory compliance, and ethical business practices across its operations, while continuing to strengthen good corporate governance and support the company's long-term sustainability.

title: Oversight Program 2025: Sinergi BKI dan Ditjen Hubla Perkuat Daya Saing Maritim Indonesia
text:
Oversight Program 2025: Sinergi BKI dan Ditjen Hubla Perkuat Daya Saing Maritim Indonesia

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)/BKI menyelesaikan kegiatan Oversight Program 2025 bersama Direktorat Jenderal Perhubungan Laut Kementerian Perhubungan RI pada 1–10 Juli 2025.

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) telah menyelesaikan Kegiatan Oversight Program yang diselenggarakan oleh Direktorat Jenderal Perhubungan Laut, Kementerian Perhubungan RI di Kantor Pusat PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) di Jakarta serta Kantor Cabang Utama Klas Samarinda, Batam, dan Tanjung Priok yang dilakukan secara hybrid pada tanggal 1 hingga 10 Juli 2025.

Kegiatan oversight program ini merupakan implementasi dari Perjanjian Kerja Sama (PKS) antara kedua institusi dalam rangka pengawasan terhadap pelaksanaan survey, dan sertifikasi statutori kapal berbendera Indonesia, guna memastikan kepatuhan terhadap pemenuhan regulasi nasional dan internasional.

Acara tersebut dibuka secara langsung oleh Direktur PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero), Arief Budi Permana bersama dengan Direktur Perkapalan dan Kepelautan, Ir. Samsuddin, M.T., M.Mar.E.

Melalui acara ini, monitoring terhadap RO (Recognized Organization) dijalankan dan selanjutnya pemerintah turut mendapatkan gambaran kemampuan armada kapal Indonesia yang berlayar keluar negeri khususnya dalam rangka menentukan arah kebijakan strategis selanjutnya mempertahankan status whitelist Tokyo MoU.

Meskipun kegiatan oversight ini dilaksanakan secara hybrid (daring dan luring), tim oversight program dari Ditjen Perhubungan Laut melakukan evaluasi secara maksimal dan mendalam terhadap proses survey serta implementasi prosedur maupun aturan.

Melalui sinergi yang kuat antara Ditjen Perhubungan Laut dan PT BKI (Persero), kegiatan Oversight Program ini diharapkan dapat terus mendorong peningkatan kualitas pengawasan kapal nasional hingga memperkuat daya saing industri maritim Indonesia. Kolaborasi ini menjadi bukti nyata komitmen bersama dalam mewujudkan pelayaran yang aman, efisien, dan berkelanjutan.

title: BKI Hadiri IPA Convex 2026 dan Tandatangani MoU dengan BPMA
text:
BKI Hadiri IPA Convex 2026 dan Tandatangani MoU dengan BPMA

BKI menghadiri IPA Convex 2026 di Tangerang dan menandatangani MoU dengan BPMA untuk mendukung layanan klasifikasi, pengujian, inspeksi, sertifikasi, dan statutory sektor hulu migas.

Tangerang, 20 Mei 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI menghadiri Indonesian Petroleum Association Convention and Exhibition (IPA Convex) ke-50 yang berlangsung di Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE) BSD, Tangerang. Dalam rangkaian kegiatan tersebut, BKI turut berpartisipasi dalam sesi penandatanganan bersama (signing ceremony) dan menandatangani Nota Kesepahaman (Memorandum of Understanding/MoU) dengan Badan Pengelola Migas Aceh (BPMA) untuk mendukung optimalisasi layanan klasifikasi, pengujian, inspeksi, sertifikasi, dan statutory pada sektor hulu minyak dan gas bumi.

![DSC03080.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_03080_84d8073193.jpg)
![DSC03046.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/DSC_03046_f7bdbfd714.jpg)

Penandatanganan MoU tersebut dihadiri oleh Direktur Utama BKI, R. Benny Susanto, didampingi jajaran manajemen BKI. Dari pihak BPMA, hadir Kepala BPMA, Nasri Djalal.
Selain penandatanganan MoU, Direktur Utama BKI bersama jajaran manajemen juga mengunjungi booth IDSurvey di area pameran. Kunjungan tersebut menjadi bagian dari kehadiran BKI sebagai salah satu entitas yang tergabung dalam holding IDSurvey untuk mendukung penguatan sinergi antarlembaga.
IPA Convex dikenal sebagai salah satu forum industri energi yang menjadi ruang dialog, pertukaran gagasan, dan kolaborasi di sektor minyak, gas, dan energi. Forum ini juga mempertemukan pelaku industri, pembuat kebijakan, investor, dan akademisi dari berbagai negara, hingga mahasiswa untuk membahas isu-isu strategis dan peluang pengembangan sektor energi ke depan.
Melalui kehadiran dalam IPA Convex 2026, BKI menegaskan perannya dalam memperluas jejaring dengan para pemangku kepentingan industri, sekaligus mendukung upaya penguatan sektor energi nasional melalui kerja sama yang lebih terarah dan berkelanjutan.

title: BKI Gelar Pembekalan Risk Officer untuk Mendukung Pengelolaan Risiko yang Lebih Transparan
text:
BKI Gelar Pembekalan Risk Officer untuk Mendukung Pengelolaan Risiko yang Lebih Transparan

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)/BKI menyelenggarakan Program Pembekalan Risk Officer pada 20–21 November 2025 di Bogor untuk memperkuat budaya dan kompetensi manajemen risiko perusahaan.

Bogor, November 2025 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI menyelenggarakan Program Pembekalan Risk Officer untuk memperkuat budaya manajemen risiko dan meningkatkan kompetensi para Risk Officer. Kegiatan yang mengusung tema “Keberlanjutan Organisasi melalui Manajemen Risiko yang Proaktif” ini berlangsung pada 20–21 November 2025 di Bigland Bogor Hotel Int’l & Convention Hall, Bogor.
Program pembekalan ini menjadi ruang strategis bagi para peserta untuk memperdalam pemahaman, berbagi pengalaman, serta menyamakan langkah dalam mengelola risiko secara lebih terstruktur dan selaras dengan arah kebijakan Perusahaan.
Kegiatan ini dihadiri oleh Direktur Keuangan, Manajemen Risiko, dan Dukungan Bisnis BKI, R. Agus Doddy Dwisagita, untuk membuka acara dan menegaskan pentingnya penguatan budaya manajemen risiko bagi keberlanjutan organisasi dan VP Perencanaan Korporat dan Manajemen Risiko BKI, Rima Novedia Bangun, untuk memaparkan bagaimana manajemen risiko diterapkan di BKI sebagai dasar pengambilan keputusan yang lebih akuntabel dan responsif terhadap tantangan industri.
Kegiatan ini turut menghadirkan narasumber eksternal, yaitu Dadan Gunawan, GRC Advisory & Internal Audit Expert, yang menyampaikan sesi berbagi pengalaman terkait Risk Assessment. title: PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) Perkuat Peran di Industri Maritim Lewat Partisipasi di INAMARINE 2025
text:
PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) Perkuat Peran di Industri Maritim Lewat Partisipasi di INAMARINE 2025

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)/BKI berpartisipasi aktif dalam INAMARINE 2025 yang digelar pada 29–31 Juli 2025 di JIExpo Kemayoran, Jakarta, sebagai wujud komitmen memperkuat peran di industri maritim dan offshore.

Dalam mendukung kemajuan industri maritim dan offshore, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI, sebagai bagian dari Holding BUMN Jasa Survei, IDSurvey, turut ambil bagian dalam ajang INAMARINE 2025. Pameran ini menjadi platform strategis bagi pelaku industri maritim nasional dan internasional untuk memperluas jejaring, membangun kemitraan, serta mendorong pertumbuhan sektor maritim di Indonesia secara berkelanjutan. Diselenggarakan pada 29–31 Juli 2025 di JIExpo Kemayoran, Jakarta, pameran ini menjadi momentum penting bagi BKI untuk menunjukkan kontribusi aktifnya dalam mendorong daya saing industri maritim nasional di kancah global.

Sebagai wujud nyata komitmen tersebut, Direktur PT BKI (Persero), R. Agus Doddy Dwisagita dan Arief Budi Permana turut hadir langsung dalam pameran ini. Dalam kesempatan ini, BKI juga menghadirkan booth khusus yang menampilkan berbagai inovasi layanan, termasuk solusi klasifikasi dan sertifikasi untuk sektor maritim dan offshore. Kehadiran booth ini menjadi sarana interaksi langsung antara BKI dan para pemangku kepentingan, baik dari dalam maupun luar negeri, untuk berbagi wawasan, membangun relasi, dan membuka peluang kolaborasi di masa depan.

Selain berpartisipasi sebagai peserta, BKI juga berperan aktif dalam rangkaian acara utama INAMARINE 2025, yakni International Blue Economy Expo and Summit (IBEES) 2025. Dalam forum ini, Direktur PT BKI (Persero), R. Agus Doddy Dwisagita, tampil sebagai pembicara pada sesi kedua yang membahas tema Maritime Standardization & Classification. Forum ini menjadi ajang penting untuk menyampaikan gagasan, bertukar pengalaman, serta mendorong sinergi multipihak dalam mendukung ekonomi biru.

Cuplikan ini menyoroti kehadiran Direktur BKI, R. title: BKI Holds “Safety Riding” Talk to Enhance Employee Road Safety Awareness
text:
BKI Holds “Safety Riding” Talk to Enhance Employee Road Safety Awareness

This program forms part of BKI’s continuous efforts to instill a strong safety culture across the organization. With the increasing mobility of employees in both operational and daily activities, understanding road safety has become essential

To strengthen employee awareness and knowledge on the importance of road safety, PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero), as part of PT IDSurvey (Persero), organized a Safety Talk Session Series with the theme “Safety Riding.” The hybrid event took place at Aula Bhinneka, PT BKI (Persero) Jakarta, on Tuesday, June 24, 2025, starting at 1:00 PM.

This program forms part of BKI’s continuous efforts to instill a strong safety culture across the organization. With the increasing mobility of employees in both operational and daily activities, understanding road safety has become essential. Through this initiative, the company aims to ensure that all BKI personnel are well-prepared to protect themselves and others during every journey.

The session featured FX Sonny Susmana BP, a professional safety driving practitioner with extensive experience in delivering road safety training to corporations and government institutions. Participants gained valuable insights into key aspects of safe driving, including vehicle readiness, driver fitness, and anticipatory driving techniques to mitigate potential hazards on the road. The session also highlighted the importance of cultivating responsible, ethical, and environmentally conscious driving behavior to help create a safe and orderly traffic ecosystem.

In addition to the in-class session, the event included a hands-on safety riding practice held in front of the BKI Mosque. Under the direct supervision of professional instructors, participants applied the techniques they had learned in real-life scenarios, enhancing their practical skills in controlling vehicles safely and recognizing potential risks on the road.

title: BKI Perkuat Budaya Integritas melalui Sosialisasi SMAP di Cabang Batam
text:
BKI Perkuat Budaya Integritas melalui Sosialisasi SMAP di Cabang Batam

BKI menggelar sosialisasi SMAP di Cabang Batam untuk memperkuat budaya integritas, kepatuhan, dan pencegahan penyuapan sebagai bagian dari komitmen penerapan tata kelola perusahaan yang baik.

Batam, 25 Juni 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) terus memperkuat implementasi perusahaan yang berintegritas melalui Sosialisasi Sistem Manajemen Anti Penyuapan (SMAP). Kegiatan ini dilaksanakan secara hybrid dari Kantor Cabang BKI Batam dan diikuti secara daring melalui Zoom.

![IMG_3435.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/IMG_3435_d222a5653e.jpeg)

Acara dibuka oleh Kepala Cabang Utama Klas Batam, Budi Isrofi, bersama Kepala Cabang Madya Komersial Batam, Muhamad Yusran Aloahiit. Dalam sambutannya, keduanya menegaskan pentingnya membangun budaya kerja yang menjunjung tinggi integritas, kepatuhan, dan transparansi sebagai fondasi dalam menjalankan proses bisnis perusahaan.

Sosialisasi ini merupakan tindak lanjut Corrective Action Plan (CAP) atas hasil Audit ISO dan HSE Tahun 2026 yang diselenggarakan oleh Bagian Legal dan Kepatuhan, Divisi Sekretaris Perusahaan.

Dalam kegiatan sosialisasi ini, materi disampaikan langsung oleh Kevin Iqbal Rizaldi selaku PJ Senior Manager Legal dan Kepatuhan bersama tim, dengan pembahasan mengenai penerapan Sistem Manajemen Anti Penyuapan (SMAP), penguatan budaya kepatuhan, serta peran aktif setiap insan BKI dalam mencegah praktik penyuapan di lingkungan kerja.

Kegiatan tersebut diikuti oleh seluruh pegawai BKI Cabang Batam, sebagai bentuk komitmen bersama dalam meningkatkan pemahaman terhadap penerapan SMAP sekaligus memperkuat kesadaran akan pentingnya nilai-nilai etika dan integritas di setiap aktivitas perusahaan.

Melalui kegiatan ini, BKI menegaskan komitmennya untuk terus membangun budaya kerja yang profesional, patuh terhadap peraturan, dan berkelanjutan guna mendukung terwujudnya tata kelola perusahaan yang baik (Good Corporate Governance).

Bagian ini menyoroti pembukaan oleh Kepala Cabang Utama Klas Batam Budi Isrofi dan Kepala Cabang Madya Komersial Batam Muhamad Yusran Aloahiit, serta tindak lanjut Corrective Action Plan (CAP) dari Audit ISO dan HSE tahun 2026 oleh Legal & Kepatuhan. Materi disampaikan oleh Kevin Iqbal Rizaldi (PJ Senior Manager Legal dan Kepatuhan).

title: BKI Showcases Commitment to Maritime Industry at INAMARINE 2025
text:
BKI Showcases Commitment to Maritime Industry at INAMARINE 2025

Representing this commitment, BKI Directors R. Agus Doddy Dwisagita and Arief Budi Permana attended the exhibition, where BKI introduced a dedicated booth showcasing its latest service innovations, including classification and certification solutions for the maritime and offshore sectors.

Jakarta, July 29, 2025 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI), a member of the State-Owned Enterprise Survey Services Holding, IDSurvey, strengthened its role in the maritime sector through active participation in INAMARINE 2025. The exhibition, held from July 29–31 at JIExpo Kemayoran, Jakarta, brought together leading national and international players to expand networks, foster partnerships, and drive sustainable growth in Indonesia’s maritime and offshore industries.

Representing this commitment, BKI Directors R. Agus Doddy Dwisagita and Arief Budi Permana attended the exhibition, where BKI introduced a dedicated booth showcasing its latest service innovations, including classification and certification solutions for the maritime and offshore sectors. The booth served as a hub for direct engagement with domestic and international stakeholders, offering opportunities to share insights, strengthen relationships, and explore future collaboration.

Beyond its role as an exhibitor, BKI also took part in the International Blue Economy Expo and Summit (IBEES) 2025, the flagship event of INAMARINE. In the second session of the forum, BKI Director R. Agus Doddy Dwisagita delivered a presentation on Maritime Standardization & Classification, underscoring the company’s commitment to advancing global best practices and supporting Indonesia’s blue economy agenda.

Through its participation in INAMARINE 2025, BKI reaffirmed its dedication to enhancing the competitiveness of Indonesia’s maritime industry and contributing to a resilient, innovative, and sustainable maritime ecosystem.

section_path: Program Outcomes
text:
Environmental Partnership & Development Program > Program Outcomes

In 2007, the company allocated <bold>Rp. 700,000,000,-</bold> for Environmental Partnership and Development Program. The fund originates from profit appropriation as already mentioned in the resolution of the Shareholders Meeting and from loan returns.

Wider business & work opportunities

Stronger cooperatives & small-scale enterprises

Rational, efficient management systems

Capability uplift: capitalization, people, admin, finance

Entrepreneurship independence

Year 2007

Corporate Social Responsibility

The Environmental Partnership and Development Program is intended to develop and create a sound business climate and maintain the relationship that motivates the growth of mutually supporting conditions between State-Owned Corporations, cooperatives, and private parties, as well as motivates cooperatives and small-scale businesses as people’s economic institutions to implement, increase, and develop their business more effectively and efficiently, delivering the greatest value to their members and surrounding communities.

It is also targeted to create wider business and employment opportunities for small-scale businesses and cooperatives in rural communities, as well as to implement more rational and efficient management systems accompanied by capability improvements in capitalization, personnel, administration, finance, and entrepreneurial independence. The 2007 development prioritized small-scale businesses—individuals, entities, and cooperatives (Rural Unit Cooperatives)—particularly prospective independent Rural Unit Cooperatives.

title: PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) Holds Coordination Meeting on MEPC 83 Follow-Up with the Ministry of Transportation
text:
PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) Holds Coordination Meeting on MEPC 83 Follow-Up with the Ministry of Transportation

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI), as the lead of the Survey Services SOEs Holding (IDSurvey), held a Coordination Meeting on the Follow-Up of MEPC 83 with the Sub-Directorate of Pollution Prevention and Ship Safety & Environmental Protection in Waters (PMKK) – Directorate of Shipping and Maritime Affairs (Ditkapel), Ministry of Transportation, on April 21, 2025.

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI), as the lead of the Survey Services SOEs Holding (IDSurvey), held a Coordination Meeting on the Follow-Up of MEPC 83 with the Sub-Directorate of Pollution Prevention and Ship Safety & Environmental Protection in Waters (PMKK) – Directorate of Shipping and Maritime Affairs (Ditkapel), Ministry of Transportation, on April 21, 2025.

The meeting was attended by Mr. Fredhi Agung Prasetyo, Vice President of Classification & Statutory Research and Development at BKI, and Dr. Capt. Miftakhul Hadi, S.ST, MM, M.Mar, Head of the Sub-Directorate of Pollution Prevention and Ship Safety & Environmental Protection in Waters, Directorate of Shipping and Maritime Affairs.

The purpose of the meeting was to align national policies with the outcomes of the IMO MEPC 83 session (April 7–11, 2025). The discussion focused primarily on reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and lowering carbon intensity in shipping through the GHG Fuel Intensity (GFI) approach, which adopts the Well-to-Wake principle. This approach accounts for emissions across the entire fuel life cycle to ensure effective and sustainable decarbonization efforts.

Through this dialogue, Indonesia is expected to strengthen its readiness in addressing increasingly stringent international regulations, while advancing the transformation of the maritime sector towards a cleaner, more efficient, and sustainable sea transportation system.

Key attendees were BKI VP Fredhi Agung Prasetyo and Dr. Capt. Miftakhul Hadi.

title: Focus Group Discussion “Mengangkut Kendaraan Listrik Berbasis Baterai dengan Aman ” PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)
text:
Focus Group Discussion “Mengangkut Kendaraan Listrik Berbasis Baterai dengan Aman ” PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)/BKI menyelenggarakan Focus Group Discussion bertajuk “Mengangkut Kendaraan Listrik Berbasis Baterai dengan Aman” pada 7 Mei 2025 di Graha BKI, Jakarta, secara hybrid.

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia / BKI (Persero) sebagai Lead Holding dari Holding BUMN Jasa Survei, IDSurvey yang terdiri dari PT SUCOFINDO dan PT Surveyor Indonesia menggelar Focus Group Discussion bertajuk “Mengangkut Kendaraan Listrik Berbasis Baterai dengan Aman - Best Practices bagi Pemilik Kapal & Logistik Maritim.” Acara ini diselenggarakan secara hybrid di Aula Ali Sadikin, Graha BKI, Jakarta, pada Selasa, 7 Mei 2025.

Forum ini menjadi bentuk nyata kolaborasi untuk menjawab tantangan sekaligus peluang dari perkembangan kendaraan listrik (electric vehicles/EV) di Indonesia, khususnya terkait aspek keselamatan pengangkutan EV melalui transportasi laut. Diskusi ini mengulas strategi penerapan standar keselamatan pengangkutan EV di kapal, mencakup aspek operasional dan finansial sebagai langkah mitigasi risiko.

Hadir dalam acara ini Arief Nurtjahjo, SVP Operasi Bisnis Klasifikasi PT BKI (Persero), Capt. Hendri Ginting M.M, Direktur Perkapalan dan Kepelautan Kementerian Perhubungan Republik Indonesia, sebagai Keynote Speaker, serta Alex Nurwahyudy, Marine Investigator KNKT, sebagai moderator. Para narasumber yang hadir berasal dari berbagai lembaga dan latar belakang, antara lain Franky Affandi selaku CTO PT Fast, Dimas Yunianto P selaku R&D Engineer at Gotion High-Tech, Khoiri Soetomo selaku Ketua Umum GAPASDAP, Amir Makbul selaku Kasubdit Rancang Bangun dan Stabilitas Kapal Kementerian Perhubungan Republik Indonesia, Mohammad Arif Kurniawan selaku SM. Riset Dan Pengembangan Bisnis Operasi PT BKI (Persero), dan Yohanes Oscarino selaku Claim Group Head PT Tugu Reasuransi Indonesia.

Forum ini menyoroti strategi penerapan standar keselamatan (safety standards) untuk kapal dan logistik maritim, dengan narasumber seperti Capt. title: BKI Advances SPM Innovation at OTC Asia 2026 to Support Oil and Gas Safety
text:
BKI Advances SPM Innovation at OTC Asia 2026 to Support Oil and Gas Safety

BKI presented collaborative research on Single Point Mooring (SPM) system regulations at OTC Asia 2026, aimed at enhancing offshore safety and mitigating environmental risks.

Kuala Lumpur, March 31, 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) participated in Offshore Technology Conference (OTC) Asia 2026, held at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Center from March 31 to April 2, 2026, joining more than 25,000 industry professionals from 89 countries.

![P07_1307 (watermarked).jpg.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/P07_1307_watermarked_jpg_db8575892b.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-17 at 13.32.38.jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Whats_App_Image_2026_04_17_at_13_32_38_daa1177937.jpeg)

At the international forum, BKI presented its latest research on the development of regulatory frameworks for Single Point Mooring (SPM) systems for operating facilities. The study, conducted in collaboration with SKK Migas and Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS), focuses on evaluating the dynamic behaviour of offloading configurations to enhance safety assurance and mitigate environmental risks, including potential oil spills.

The BKI delegation was led by Eko Maja Priyanto, Senior Manager of Offshore Marketing, and supported by representatives from SKK Migas and ITS. The research was delivered by BKI delegate Hafizh Muhammad Naufal Shidqi, providing technical insights to support the advancement of SPM regulations in the oil and gas sector.

In addition to presenting its research, BKI leveraged the event to strengthen engagement with global energy stakeholders, including Yinson Holdings Berhad, Eni S.p.A., and Petronas.

BKI’s participation in OTC Asia 2026 reflects its continued commitment to advancing safety, reliability, and sustainability standards in the offshore oil and gas industry, both nationally and internationally.

title: BKI Teken MoU dengan Jasaraharja Putera Dukung Keselamatan Maritim
text:
BKI Teken MoU dengan Jasaraharja Putera Dukung Keselamatan Maritim

BKI dan PT Jasaraharja Putera menandatangani MoU untuk menjajaki kerja sama peningkatan kelayakan teknis, pendidikan, dan pengembangan pengetahuan guna mendukung keselamatan pelayaran serta kualitas layanan maritim nasional.

Jakarta, 17 Juli 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI menandatangani Nota Kesepahaman (Memorandum of Understanding/MoU) dengan PT Jasaraharja Putera di Kantor Pusat BKI, Jakarta. Penandatanganan ini menjadi langkah awal kedua perusahaan untuk menjajaki kerja sama di bidang peningkatan kelayakan teknis, pendidikan, serta pengembangan dan pertukaran ilmu pengetahuan guna mendukung peningkatan keselamatan dan kualitas layanan di sektor maritim.

![IMG_3815.jpg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/IMG_3815_c69e1efd27.jpg)

Penandatanganan MoU tersebut dihadiri oleh Direktur Utama BKI, R. Benny Susanto, didampingi Direktur Operasi Bisnis Klasifikasi BKI, Arief Budi Permana, beserta jajaran manajemen. Dari pihak PT Jasaraharja Putera, hadir Direktur Utama Abdul Haris, Direktur Pemasaran Imam Hendrawan, beserta jajaran manajemen.
Direktur Utama BKI, R. Benny Susanto, menyampaikan bahwa kerja sama ini menjadi bagian dari komitmen BKI untuk mendukung peningkatan standar keamanan, keselamatan, dan kepatuhan di sektor maritim melalui kapasitas, kompetensi, independensi, serta keahlian teknis yang dimiliki perusahaan. “Nota Kesepahaman ini adalah langkah awal. title: Sertifikat Pemeliharaan Kelas
section_path: Daur Ulang atau Pembongkaran
text:
Sertifikat Pemeliharaan Kelas > Daur Ulang atau Pembongkaran

Pelajari tentang proses pemeliharaan klasifikasi kapal.

Sertifikat Pemeliharaan Kelas (CMC) adalah dokumen resmi yang diterbitkan oleh Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (BKI) yang secara formal memverifikasi status klasifikasi kapal selama periode historis tertentu seperti yang diminta oleh pemilik. Ini berfungsi sebagai pernyataan otoritatif yang menegaskan bahwa kapal dipelihara dalam kelas dan sesuai dengan Peraturan BKI untuk durasi tersebut.

Meyakinkan calon pembeli tentang riwayat pemeliharaan dan survei kapal.

Memenuhi permintaan uji tuntas dari bank, penyewa, atau pemangku kepentingan lainnya.

Pemilik sepenuhnya bertanggung jawab atas penggunaan CMC yang diterbitkan dengan benar. BKI tidak bertanggung jawab atas kerugian, kerusakan, atau perselisihan yang timbul dari penyalahgunaan sertifikat oleh pemilik atau pihak ketiga mana pun.

Memberikan bukti status kepatuhan kapal pada saat insiden atau kecelakaan.

Mengonfirmasi status kelas kapal sebelum pelayaran terakhirnya.

Tanggung Jawab Pemilik

Jika informasi yang diberikan oleh pemohon kemudian ditemukan palsu atau tidak akurat, CMC yang diterbitkan akan dianggap batal dan tidak berlaku. Ini termasuk, tetapi tidak terbatas pada, bukti bahwa kapal dioperasikan di luar batas navigasi yang disertifikasi selama periode yang dimaksud.

Validitas dan Pencabutan

BKI akan segera memperbaiki dan menerbitkan kembali CMC tanpa biaya tambahan jika ditemukan kesalahan administrasi yang dibuat oleh BKI selama proses penerbitan.

title: Pastikan Kesiapan Infrastruktur, Dirut BKI Tinjau Posko dan Fasilitas Pelabuhan
text:
Pastikan Kesiapan Infrastruktur, Dirut BKI Tinjau Posko dan Fasilitas Pelabuhan

Direktur Utama BKI meninjau Posko BKO Ciwandan dan Pelabuhan BBJ Bojonegara untuk memastikan kesiapan infrastruktur dan layanan angkutan laut jelang Natal 2025 dan Tahun Baru 2026, sebagai komitmen BKI mendukung keselamatan dan kelancaran transportasi laut nasional.

Merak, 24 Desember 2025 – Direktur Utama PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI, R. Benny Susanto, melakukan kunjungan ke Posko Bantuan Kendali Operasi (BKO) Perhubungan Ciwandan dan Pelabuhan PT. Bandar Bakau Jaya (BBJ) Bojonegara, Banten, untuk meninjau kesiapan fasilitas dan layanan angkutan laut menjelang libur Natal 2025 dan Tahun Baru 2026.

Kunjungan tersebut dilakukan untuk memastikan kesiapan infrastruktur dan dukungan operasional dalam menghadapi peningkatan mobilitas masyarakat selama periode Natal dan Tahun Baru (Nataru). Dalam kegiatan ini, Direktur Utama BKI didampingi oleh Kepala Cabang Utama Klas Banten BKI, Suwandi, dan Kepala Cabang Pratama Komersil Banten BKI, Muh Arafah.

Direktur Utama BKI menegaskan bahwa peninjauan ini merupakan bagian dari komitmen BKI dalam mendukung Pemerintah dan Kementerian Perhubungan guna memastikan kelancaran serta keselamatan penyelenggaraan angkutan Natal dan Tahun Baru 2025–2026.

“Melalui peran aktif dalam pemeriksaan, pengawasan teknis, serta pemastian kelaiklautan kapal dan sarana pendukung transportasi laut, BKI berkomitmen menghadirkan layanan transportasi yang aman, nyaman, dan terpercaya bagi masyarakat,” ujar R. Benny Susanto.

Sebagai lembaga yang berperan dalam keselamatan dan keandalan transportasi laut, BKI terus berupaya meningkatkan kualitas layanan, khususnya pada periode dengan tingkat mobilitas tinggi. Upaya ini dilakukan untuk memberikan rasa aman bagi masyarakat yang melakukan perjalanan selama libur Natal dan Tahun Baru.

title: BKI Raih Indonesia Logistic Innovation Award 2026
text:
BKI Raih Indonesia Logistic Innovation Award 2026

BKI meraih Indonesia Logistic Innovation Award 2026 di Jakarta atas inovasi transformasi digital Maritime Cloud Platform (MCP) pada kategori Digital Transformation.

Jakarta, 5 Juni 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI meraih Anugerah Penghargaan Indonesia Logistic Innovation Award 2026 yang diselenggarakan oleh Tender Indonesia melalui Forum Sinergi dan Inovasi Industri (FSII) di Jakarta International Expo (JIExpo) Kemayoran. Penghargaan tersebut diberikan atas inovasi BKI dalam pengembangan transformasi digital melalui Maritime Cloud Platform.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 15.12.35 (1).jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Whats_App_Image_2026_06_05_at_15_12_35_1_471ca2dbc3.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 15.12.36 (1).jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Whats_App_Image_2026_06_05_at_15_12_36_1_522f656056.jpeg)

Penghargaan ini diterima langsung oleh Direktur Kelembagaan dan Sumber Daya BKI, R. Agus Doddy Dwi Sagita. BKI memperoleh penghargaan pada kategori Digital Transformation Through Maritime Cloud Platform Innovation.
Maritime Cloud Platform (MCP) merupakan solusi ekosistem digital yang mengintegrasikan berbagai layanan maritim dalam satu platform. Inisiatif ini dirancang untuk mendukung efisiensi dan kemudahan akses layanan di sektor maritim melalui pendekatan digital yang lebih terhubung dan terintegrasi.
Forum Sinergi dan Inovasi Industri (FSII) merupakan wadah kolaborasi antara peneliti, akademisi, dan dunia usaha untuk mendorong lahirnya inovasi yang berkelanjutan. Dalam forum tersebut, inisiatif BKI dinilai menjadi salah satu contoh penerapan transformasi digital di bidang layanan logistik dan maritim.

Melalui penghargaan ini, BKI menegaskan komitmennya dalam mendukung transformasi digital serta pengembangan inovasi layanan di sektor maritim nasional.

title: BKI and Sea Transportation Directorate General Conclude 2025 Oversight Program to Boost Maritime Competitiveness
text:
BKI and Sea Transportation Directorate General Conclude 2025 Oversight Program to Boost Maritime Competitiveness

The program is part of an ongoing cooperation agreement between BKI and the Directorate General of Sea Transportation to oversee surveys and statutory certifications, ensuring compliance with both national and international maritime regulations.

Jakarta, July 10, 2025 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI), in collaboration with the Directorate General of Sea Transportation of the Ministry of Transportation, has concluded the 2025 Oversight Program. The initiative, held from July 1–10 in a hybrid format across BKI’s Head Office in Jakarta and its branch offices in Samarinda, Batam, and Tanjung Priok, aimed to strengthen supervision of Indonesian-flagged vessels.

The program is part of an ongoing cooperation agreement between BKI and the Directorate General of Sea Transportation to oversee surveys and statutory certifications, ensuring compliance with both national and international maritime regulations.

The program was officially opened by BKI Director Arief Budi Permana and Director of Shipping and Maritime Affairs Ir. Samsuddin, M.T., M.Mar.E. As part of the oversight, the government monitored Recognized Organizations (ROs) and evaluated Indonesia’s overseas shipping fleet capabilities—an effort critical to maintaining Indonesia’s position on the Tokyo MoU whitelist and shaping future strategic policies.

Despite its hybrid format, the oversight team conducted a thorough evaluation of survey processes, procedures, and regulatory implementation.

Through this synergy, BKI and the Directorate General of Sea Transportation reaffirm their shared commitment to advancing the quality of ship supervision, strengthening Indonesia’s maritime competitiveness, and supporting safe, efficient, and sustainable shipping.

The initiative, held from July 1–10 in a hybrid format across BKI’s Head Office in Jakarta and its branch offices in Samarinda, Batam, and Tanjung Priok, aimed to strengthen supervision of Indonesian-flagged vessels.

The program is part of an ongoing cooperation agreement between BKI and the Directorate General of Sea Transportation to oversee surveys and statutory certifications, ensuring compliance with both national and international maritime regulations.

The program was officially opened by BKI Director Arief Budi Permana and Director of Shipping and Maritime Affairs Ir. Samsuddin, M.T., M.Mar.E. As part of the oversight, the government monitored Recognized Organizations (ROs) and evaluated Indonesia’s overseas shipping fleet capabilities—an effort critical to maintaining Indonesia’s position on the Tokyo MoU whitelist and shaping future strategic policies.

Despite its hybrid format, the oversight team conducted a thorough evaluation of survey processes, procedures, and regulatory implementation.

Through this synergy, BKI and the Directorate General of Sea Transportation reaffirm their shared commitment to advancing the quality of ship supervision, strengthening Indonesia’s maritime competitiveness, and supporting safe, efficient, and sustainable shipping.

title: Class Maintenance Certificate
section_path: Scrapping or Recycling
text:
Class Maintenance Certificate > Scrapping or Recycling

Learn about the process for maintaining a vessel's classification.

The Class Maintenance Certificate (CMC) is an official document issued by Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (BKI) that formally verifies a vessel's classification status during a specific historical period as requested by the owner. It serves as an authoritative statement confirming that the vessel was maintained in class and in compliance with BKI Rules for that duration.

The CMC is a vital document for various commercial and administrative processes. It is typically requested to support:

Assuring prospective buyers of the vessel's maintenance and survey history.

Fulfilling due diligence requests from banks, charterers, or other stakeholders.

The owner is fully responsible for the proper use of the issued CMC. BKI is not liable for any losses, damages, or disputes arising from the misuse of the certificate by the owner or any third party.

Providing evidence of the vessel's compliance status at the time of an incident or accident.

Confirming the vessel's class status prior to its final voyage.

Owner's Responsibility

If information provided by the applicant is later found to be false or inaccurate, the issued CMC will be considered null and void. This includes, but is not limited to, evidence that the vessel was operated outside its certified navigational limits during the period in question.

Validity and Revocation

BKI will promptly correct and re-issue a CMC at no additional charge if any clerical errors are found to have been made by BKI during the issuance process.

title: BKI Receives 2026 Indonesia Logistic Innovation Award for Maritime Cloud Platform
text:
BKI Receives 2026 Indonesia Logistic Innovation Award for Maritime Cloud Platform

BKI received the 2026 Indonesia Logistic Innovation Award for its Maritime Cloud Platform, recognising its role in advancing digital transformation in the maritime sector

Jakarta, June 5, 2026 – PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) has been honoured with the 2026 Indonesia Logistic Innovation Award, presented by Tender Indonesia through the Industrial Synergy and Innovation Forum (FSII) at Jakarta International Expo (JIExpo) Kemayoran. The recognition was awarded for BKI’s innovation in advancing digital transformation through its Maritime Cloud Platform (MCP).

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 15.12.35 (1).jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Whats_App_Image_2026_06_05_at_15_12_35_1_471ca2dbc3.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-05 at 15.12.36 (1).jpeg](https://cms.bki.co.id/uploads/Whats_App_Image_2026_06_05_at_15_12_36_1_522f656056.jpeg)

The award was received by BKI Director of Institutional and Human Resources, R. Agus Doddy Dwi Sagita. BKI was recognised in the category of Digital Transformation Through Maritime Cloud Platform Innovation.

The Maritime Cloud Platform (MCP) is an integrated digital ecosystem designed to consolidate maritime services into a single, connected platform, improving efficiency and service accessibility across the maritime sector.

The Industrial Synergy and Innovation Forum (FSII) serves as a collaborative platform bringing together researchers, academics, and industry players to promote sustainable innovation. At the forum, BKI’s initiative was highlighted as a strong example of digital transformation in the logistics and maritime services sector.

Through this recognition, BKI reaffirms its commitment to driving digital innovation and strengthening service transformation within Indonesia’s maritime industry.

title: BKI Strengthens Ferry Safety Through Workshop in Banyuwangi
text:
BKI Strengthens Ferry Safety Through Workshop in Banyuwangi

The workshop brought together key stakeholders, including representatives from BKI’s board of directors, the National Transportation Safety Committee (KNKT), the Ministry of Transportation, GAPASDAP, and ferry operators from the Ketapang–Gilimanuk crossing.

Banyuwangi, August 8, 2025 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) took a strategic step to enhance passenger safety on the Ketapang–Gilimanuk ferry route by hosting a Ferry Safety Workshop at the Illira Hotel, Banyuwangi.

The workshop brought together key stakeholders, including representatives from BKI’s board of directors, the National Transportation Safety Committee (KNKT), the Ministry of Transportation, GAPASDAP, and ferry operators from the Ketapang–Gilimanuk crossing.

The event aimed to identify concrete solutions for strengthening maritime safety systems, with a strong emphasis on professionalism and compliance in ferry operations. Participants engaged in technical discussions and received training materials covering life-saving appliances, cargo securing and lashing, vessel stability, and case studies on safety best practices. The session was met with high enthusiasm, with participation exceeding expectations.

BKI Director Arief Budi Permana highlighted the importance of ship classification and certification in supporting the theme “Safe Crossing, Comfortable Travel.” He emphasized that classification and certification establish critical safety parameters—such as maximum load capacity, vessel dimensions, and the adequacy of safety equipment—that operators are required to follow.

Through this collaborative initiative, BKI reaffirmed its commitment to building a culture of safety and ensuring safer, more reliable ferry services for communities that depend on the Ketapang–Gilimanuk route.

title: BKI Kunjungi Otoritas Maritim Cina, Perluas Layanan Global
text:
BKI Kunjungi Otoritas Maritim Cina, Perluas Layanan Global

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI melakukan kunjungan resmi ke Maritime Safety Administration of the People’s Republic of China pada 20 Januari 2026 sebagai bagian dari rencana pembukaan layanan BKI di Cina.

Beijing, 20 Januari 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) atau BKI melakukan kunjungan resmi ke _Maritime Safety Administration of the People's Republic of China_ sebagai bagian dari rencana pembukaan layanan BKI di Cina. Kunjungan ini bertujuan memperkuat kerja sama di bidang survei dan sertifikasi kapal serta meningkatkan dukungan bagi pengguna jasa BKI yang beroperasi di pasar internasional.
Direktur Utama BKI, R. Benny Susanto, hadir dalam kunjungan tersebut bersama delegasi dari BKI. Kunjungan ini membahas persiapan pembukaan unit layanan BKI di Cina, termasuk peluang kerja sama dalam penyelenggaraan layanan klasifikasi dan penguatan dukungan terhadap keselamatan maritim. Inisiatif ini menjadi bagian dari strategi BKI untuk memperluas jangkauan layanan serta mendekatkan dukungan teknis kepada pelanggan di kawasan Asia dan pasar global.
Pembukaan layanan di Cina diharapkan memperkuat peran BKI dalam mendukung keselamatan maritim sekaligus meningkatkan kualitas dan kemudahan akses layanan bagi pengguna jasa internasional. Kehadiran BKI di pusat aktivitas maritim global penting untuk memastikan layanan yang responsif dan sesuai kebutuhan industri.
Langkah ekspansi ini menegaskan komitmen BKI dalam meningkatkan kredibilitas dan daya saing di tingkat global, termasuk dalam proses menuju keanggotaan _International Association of Classification Societies_ (IACS). Upaya tersebut diharapkan memperkuat posisi BKI sebagai badan klasifikasi nasional yang mampu bersaing dan berkontribusi dalam industri maritim internasional.

title: PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) mengadakan Sidang Komite Teknik: Driving Excellence, Defining the Future
text:
PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) mengadakan Sidang Komite Teknik: Driving Excellence, Defining the Future

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero)/BKI menggelar Sidang Komite Teknik bertema Driving Excellence, Defining the Future pada 24 April 2025 di Gedung Nava BKI.

PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) sebagai lead holding BUMN jasa survei / IDSurvey, mengadakan Sidang Komite Teknik dengan tema Driving Excellence, Defining the Future, pada 24 April 2025 di Gedung Nava PT BKI (Persero). Acara ini dihadiri oleh Deputi Direktur Manajemen Bisnis Klasifikasi BKI, Bapak Arief Budi Permana, Ketua Iperindo, Ibu Anita Puji Utami, VP Riset & Pengembangan Klasifikasi & Statutoria, Bapak Fredhi Agung Prasetyo, serta Anggota Komite Teknik BKI periode 2023 - 2025

Acara ini diselenggarakan guna melakukan validasi peraturan teknik BKI sebagai persyaratan penerbitan Rules yang nantinya akan menjadi bahan submisi BKI menuju IACS

Adapun agenda sidang Komite Teknik yaitu melakukan validasi 7 (tujuh) Draft Aturan Teknik yang dibagi dalam 3 Sidang Panel.

Secara umum menyetujui hasil sidang panel per sub komite yang telah melakukan validasi 7 (Tujuh) Draft Aturan Teknik, yaitu:
1. NE July 2025 - Rules for Hull (Pt.1, Vol.II)
2. NE July 2025 - Rules for Container Ships (Pt.1, Vol.XVIII)
3. NE July 2025 Rules for Classification and Surveys (Pt.1, Vol.I)
4. NE July 2025 - Rules for Machinery Installations (Pt.1, Vol.III)
5. NE July 2025 - Rules for Electrical Installations (Pt.1, Vol.IV)
6. NE July 2025 - Rules for Approval of Manufacturers and Service Suppliers (Pt.1, Vol.XI)
7. NE July 2025 - Rules for Non - Metallic Materials (Pt.1, Vol.XIV)

Dan selanjutnya draft tersebut akan dipublikasikan oleh BKI sesuai prosedur yang berlaku dan memperhatikan usulan dan masukan yang ada

Fokusnya pada validasi 7 (tujuh) draft rules teknis (NE July 2025) sebagai persyaratan penerbitan Rules untuk submisi BKI menuju IACS / International Association of Classification Societies, dengan melibatkan Deputi Direktur Manajemen Bisnis Klasifikasi BKI, Ketua Iperindo, VP Riset & Pengembangan Klasifikasi & Statutoria, dan Anggota Komite Teknik BKI periode 2023–2025.

title: BKI Holds Official Visit with Chinese Maritime Authority to Support International Operations
text:
BKI Holds Official Visit with Chinese Maritime Authority to Support International Operations

PT BKI (Persero) conducted an official visit to the Maritime Safety Administration of China to discuss cooperation and preparations for establishing BKI services in the country.

Beijing, January 20, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) conducted an official visit to the Maritime Safety Administration of the People’s Republic of China as part of its strategic plan to expand service operations in China. The visit aimed to strengthen cooperation in ship survey and certification activities while enhancing support for BKI clients operating in the international maritime market.
The visit was led by BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto, accompanied by a delegation from BKI. Discussions focused on preparations for the establishment of a BKI service unit in China, including potential collaboration in classification services and initiatives to further support maritime safety.
The planned expansion is intended to reinforce BKI’s role in promoting shipping safety while improving the accessibility, responsiveness, and quality of its services for international stakeholders. Establishing a presence in China—one of the world’s key maritime hubs—will enable BKI to provide closer technical support aligned with the evolving needs of the global shipping industry.
This initiative also reflects BKI’s continued commitment to strengthening its international credibility and competitiveness, including its ongoing efforts toward membership in the International Association of Classification Societies (IACS). Through this expansion, BKI aims to further position itself as a national classification society capable of contributing meaningfully to the global maritime industry.

PT BKI (Persero) conducted an official visit to the Maritime Safety Administration of China to discuss cooperation and preparations for establishing BKI services in the country.

Beijing, January 20, 2026 — PT Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia (Persero) (BKI) conducted an official visit to the Maritime Safety Administration of the People’s Republic of China as part of its strategic plan to expand service operations in China. The visit aimed to strengthen cooperation in ship survey and certification activities while enhancing support for BKI clients operating in the international maritime market.
The visit was led by BKI President Director R. Benny Susanto, accompanied by a delegation from BKI. Discussions focused on preparations for the establishment of a BKI service unit in China, including potential collaboration in classification services and initiatives to further support maritime safety.
The planned expansion is intended to reinforce BKI’s role in promoting shipping safety while improving the accessibility, responsiveness, and quality of its services for international stakeholders. Establishing a presence in China—one of the world’s key maritime hubs—will enable BKI to provide closer technical support aligned with the evolving needs of the global shipping industry.
This initiative also reflects BKI’s continued commitment to strengthening its international credibility and competitiveness, including its ongoing efforts toward membership in the International Association of Classification Societies (IACS). Through this expansion, BKI aims to further position itself as a national classification society capable of contributing meaningfully to the global maritime industry.
